<meta>This page continues the mystical discourse on the sanctity of the Land of Israel and the metaphysical barriers between the holy and the unholy. It specifically addresses why the "gates" of holiness remain closed during the exile and how the soul's departure from the body is affected by geography.</meta>

# Terumah

## Main Text (Zohar)

...to descend below. Because sins caused it, that opening was made for this side and for that side <note>referring to the sides of holiness and the "Other Side" or evil</note> until the <term>Klipa</term> <note>literally "husk" or "shell"; the mystical representation of evil or impurity that conceals divine light</note> became mixed together as one. Once the Klipa descended to the "Brain" <note>the inner essence or intellectual realm of holiness</note>, then that Klipa ruled over them and pushed them out from that place. It created a partition that forced them outside. However, that powerful Klipa cannot rule within that holy place itself, for it is not its rightful place. 

And if you should say: since that powerful Klipa cannot rule in that holy place, why does the gate remain standing? For that gate exists in the world only from the side of that powerful Klipa. But certainly, when the mixture occurred, it only mixed from that lower side that comes toward the Brain. And the **Holy One, Blessed be He** <note>original: "Kadosh Baruch Hu"</note> ensured that the powerful Klipa would not rule over that holy place. 

When He pushed Israel out from there, that Klipa returned and opened as before. Because the holy people were no longer there, a covering of the holy curtain spread over that opening toward the outside of that place, so that the powerful Klipa would not open it, and He took hold of it on all sides. And the authority of the "Crusher" <note>a destructive spiritual force</note> was on the land as before; it could not enter because that holy covering held fast so that it would not descend below, for the holy people were not there. For this reason, the gate has remained desolate since the day of the destruction of the Temple. The powerful Klipa is unable to rule there because that holy covering holds it on all its sides, like an opening where it cannot rule, and the "Brain" is not blocked by that covering of the holy curtain. It is from the goodness of the holy curtain above that the place was nullified. 

Because of this, all those souls that dwell in the lands surrounding the Land of Israel, when they depart from this world, they are not received [immediately]. They are pushed outside and they go wandering and revolving through many cycles <note>transmigration or wandering of the soul</note> until they leave the surroundings of the Holy Land entirely, following their usual path. 

But all those souls of Israel that depart *there* <note>within the Land of Israel</note> ascend, and that holy covering receives them, and they enter into the Supernal Holiness, because everything that is pure goes to its purity. As for the souls of Israel that depart outside the Land, it is known that the powerful Klipa goes and purifies and revolves them until they are brought to their place and enter the location that is fitting for them. There are many divisions of souls that depart through the holy mysteries in that opening of the Holy Land. 

What is the status of a soul that departs in the Holy Land? My brother, it draws near on that very day, and the spirit of impurity does not rule over it at all. And so it is written in the Prophet: 
> "You shall surely bury him on that day... so that you do not defile your land." <note>Deuteronomy 21:23</note> 

This is because at night, permission is given [to the impure forces] to roam. And when they descend, they are given permission, but they do not enter the Holy Land—except for one instance we find there. Friends and individuals who join in a circle for a woman, and the friends are ready, not to look at the land or to do good in the land, but so that the **Other Side** <note>original: "Sitra Achra"; the realm of evil</note> shall not rule within the land and shall not be found entering there. 

Because of this, the blue thread <note>likely referring to the mystical properties of the Tekhelet/blue fringe</note> would rise from them in its pain and revolve outward, going and strengthening in the congregation until it reached the stars of the North, for there are the dwellings of all the "Other Sides," and there the blue entered and all of them were cut down there. The blue of the day would rise to its place in a straight path, and they would see from that opening how all the sides of the powerful Klipa that are outside the Holy Land were cut down. And from that blue, it emerges as we have established. 

The souls of the righteous, who were not drawn in this world after the powers of that powerful Klipa to turn their eyes toward the spirit of impurity at all—for they did not participate with it at all in this world—just as the breath is strengthened in this world after that powerful Klipa and its powers and its responses are prepared for it, so it ascends after the soul departs from it. The bodies of the righteous, who do not take pleasure in this world...

<meta>This page continues the mystical discourse on the departure of the soul and the sanctity of the body, specifically contrasting those who die in the Holy Land versus those abroad, using the archetypes of Joseph and Jacob.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

This world is but a fraction—one sixtieth—of the soul’s delights. That spirit of impurity <note>The *Sitra Achra* or "Other Side," representing unholy forces.</note> cannot rule over those souls, for they did not derive any pleasure from its domain at all. Since they took nothing from it—much like a flame that does not catch—it has no authority over them whatsoever. Blessed is their portion, for they did not strengthen themselves from anything belonging to it. 

When a person’s soul departs outside of the Holy Land and their lower soul <note>original: *Nefesh*</note> remains there, it is found that the spirit of impurity dwells within them until they return to the dust. When that lower soul, in which the spirit of impurity is found, is brought up to be buried within the Holy Land, concerning this it is written: **"But when you entered, you defiled my land and made my inheritance an abomination"** <note>Jeremiah 2:7</note>. 

The hint here is that the spirit of impurity does not rule over your body if it was not corrupted by that spirit in life. For when they die and are brought to be buried in the Land, we have learned that the Land rejects them unless <term>the Holy One, Blessed be He</term> <note>original: *Kadosh Baruch Hu* (the standard Hebrew name for God)</note> provides a remedy for the Land. For as soon as that body is present, the Holy One, Blessed be He, commands a wind to blow and casts that spirit of impurity outside, for it has no standing in His land. 

Regarding Joseph, the spirit of impurity never ruled over his body, and the hint is that his soul departed in a different manner. This was because he did not follow the ways of the spirit of impurity. For this reason, he did not ask for his *body* to be brought up for burial in the Holy Land immediately, but rather said: **"And you shall carry up my bones"** <note>Genesis 50:25</note>, and not "my body." 

Jacob did not die <note>A famous Talmudic/Zoharic concept that "Jacob our forefather did not die" because his spiritual influence remains eternal.</note>; his body remained in its constant state of existence. He did not fear the "Other Side" <note>The realm of evil.</note> because his bed was perfect, complete with the supernal light, surrounded by the twelve tribes and seventy souls. Because of this, he did not fear the Other Side, and it could not rule over him. Furthermore, his body was the image of the Supernal Form <note>The *Adam Kadmon* or Divine Image</note>, a beauty that takes hold of all sides. All the features of the First Man <note>Adam</note> were contained within him. Regarding this, it is written of him: **"I will lie with my fathers"** <note>Genesis 47:30</note>, and his body was found to be perfectly preserved. Even when **"the physicians embalmed Israel"** <note>Genesis 50:2</note>, his body and spirit remained in their state of existence, as was necessary. 

However, when those whose souls depart in the Holy Land die, the lower soul of the body is saved from everything. There are three names for the levels of the human soul: <term>Nefesh</term> <note>the vital/animal soul</note>, <term>Ruach</term> <note>the spirit/emotional soul</note>, and <term>Neshamah</term> <note>the highest/intellectual soul</note>. They are all included within one another, and life is found in these three levels. 

The **Nefesh** remains within the grave until the body is consumed in the dust. During this time, it wanders in this world to find life and to know the suffering of the living; at such times, the living need to ask for mercy for them. 

The **Ruach** is that which goes toward the Garden that is on the earth. It is awakened there in the form of the body of this world, clothed in a garment worn there. It resides there among the delights and the radiance of His <term>Shekhinah</term> <note>The Divine Presence, often viewed as the feminine aspect of God.</term>. At appointed times, it ascends above, is present there, and then returns to its place. Concerning this it is written: **"And the spirit returns to God who gave it"** <note>Ecclesiastes 12:7</note>—it returns certainly at those times we mentioned. 

The **Neshamah** ascends immediately to its place, to the source from which it emerged. It is because of the Neshamah that the light is found within to prepare it for above. This level never descends below; through it, the soul is perfected there and included from all sides, above and below. 

Until the body is brought to burial in its proper form, the Ruach is not crowned in the Garden, and the Nefesh does not settle in its place. Once the body is raised, they all find rest. When the people of the world are in distress and go to the gravesites, the Nefesh stands to be awakened, and it goes and wanders and awakens the Ruach. The Ruach then goes and awakens the Patriarchs <note>Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.</note>, and then the Holy One, Blessed be He, has compassion on the world. This we have established. 

Even though these matters of the soul have been awakened for your sake, they all ascend in this balance <note>original: *matkala* (the mystical scale of judgment/alignment)</note>, and this is the clarity of the matter; it is all one. When the Neshamah is found and ascends to its place, the Ruach goes and stands at the gate of the Garden of Eden, but the gate is not opened for it...

<meta>This page continues the discussion of the soul's structure from the previous folio, specifically focusing on the mystical relationship between the three levels of the soul—Nefesh, Ruach, and Neshamah—and their locations after the death of the physical body.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

...and the host and Metatron <note>The supreme archangel and celestial scribe</note>, and there is no one to be found in it. For the **Nefesh** <note>The lowest level of the soul, associated with vitality and the physical body</note> goes and wanders through the world at the beginning of the body's decay, when the worms rise. At that time, she is found over them, as we have established, for it is written: <note>Job 14:22</note> **"But his flesh upon him shall have pain, and his soul within him shall mourn."** And all of them are visible to his eyes until the **Neshamah** <note>The highest level of the soul, the divine spark of intellect</note> is bound in her place above. Then all of them are bound in their respective places, because these three are one bond, in the likeness of the Supernal pattern, according to the secret of Nefesh, Ruach, and Neshamah—all are one and one bond.

The **Nefesh** has no light of her own at all; she is the one who shares in the **Ruach** <note>The middle level of the soul, associated with emotions and spirit</note> of the body for her benefit and sustenance, providing all that is needed, as it is said: <note>Proverbs 31:15</note> **"She giveth meat to her household, and a portion to her maidens."** "Her household" refers to the body, which she sustains. "Her maidens" refers to the limbs of the body, all of them.

The **Ruach** is the one who rides upon that Nefesh and rules over her, illuminating her with all that is necessary. The Nefesh serves as a throne for that Ruach. And how much does she <insert>the Neshamah</insert> knock for that Ruach, ruling over it and illuminating it with that light that shines? For that Ruach depends upon this **Neshamah** and is illuminated by her like a sparkling light. The Nefesh depends on the Ruach, is illuminated by it, and is nourished by it—and all are one bond.

And because the **Neshamah** is supreme, she only ascends into the "Hidden Path" of the *Ancient of Ancients* <note>Atika de-Atikin, the most hidden aspect of the Divine</note>, the most concealed of all hidden things, and is filled from Him. Because she never ceases, this Ruach enters into the Garden of Eden—this is the Nefesh <note>The text here describes the hierarchy of placement</note>.

The Ruach never dwells anywhere but in the Garden of Eden, and the Neshamah is above. The Nefesh is found in her place within the body below. In this manner, they are all below, yet they separate once the person dies, even though they are one bond. The Neshamah ascends above into the hidden place of the Throne; the Ruach enters the Garden of Eden in the Supernal likeness; and the Nefesh is found in the grave.

And if you should say: "The Nefesh is above, to be found in the body as in a grave—where is the grave?" Rather, it is within that "strong shell" <term>Kelipah: a spiritual husk or force of impurity</term>, and the Nefesh is like this below, and all of them are in this manner. Therefore, three levels are separated, yet they are one bond and one spirit.

And at all times when the children of Adam are found in the grave, a connection is found there. Here, the Ruach is for the wise who know the "whisper of the small bird" <note>A metaphor for esoteric communication or divination</note> that goes and sins. At the hour when the Neshamah is crowned above in the holy crown, and the Ruach stands like a supernal light in the Garden during months and seasons—this Nefesh, at the hour when the Ruach descends from the supernal light to visit the Garden of Eden, shines and protects it while it stays in the grave. It appears in the image that it had in the former body, and all those bones that are upright rise and find and see it before them. This is what is written: <note>Psalms 35:10</note> **"All my bones shall say: Lord, who is like unto Thee?"** This matter is written, but it shall be clarified.

And if you say that the one who is above sees before his eyes, as it is written: <note>Ecclesiastes 9:11</note> **"I returned, and saw..."** and who is it? They see the images upon the graves and find the Nefesh. But the foolishness of human beings hinders them, for they do not know and do not observe upon what they stand in this world. They do not care to be found in the glory of the Supernal King in this world, nor to be found in the glory of that world, or how these things are separated.

On the night of **Rosh Hashanah** <note>The Jewish New Year</note>, when the service is judged, they stand before the Supernal King to judge the world. Each and every Nefesh wanders and seeks mercy for the living. On the night of **Yom Kippur** <note>The Day of Atonement</note>, the day of judgment, they go and wander to see and know who will be merit life in the world. Sometimes they inform the living in a vision, as in a dream-vision, as it is learned: "In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falleth upon men..." <note>Job 33:15-16</note> **"Then he openeth the ears of men, and sealeth their instruction."** What is "their instruction"? This is the Nefesh that stands in distress and returns to those who are to receive instruction. On the night of the **Festival** <note>Sukkot</note>, the decrees of the King go out and are opened, and they go to all their witnesses... the Nefesh of the living goes and wanders...

<summary>This page explains the mystical hierarchy of the soul (Nefesh, Ruach, Neshamah), detailing how they separate after death while remaining spiritually linked, and how the Nefesh interacts with the living during the High Holy Days.</summary>

## Main Text (Zohar)

->**Terumah <note>The Torah portion "Offering" (Exodus 25:1–27:19)</note>**<-

Metatron <note>The supreme Archangel and "Prince of the Presence" in Jewish mysticism</note> and one appointed official are engraved in the spirit with a seal, like the explicit script of *Dumesis* <note>A cryptic angelic name or power associated with recording deeds</note>, who is appointed over the script of God, engraved and within a supernal vision. How many hosts of living beings, and how many thousands upon thousands and tens of thousands of crowns are merited by that "All" <note>A mystical term for a collective spiritual grade</note> from each one. They raise it upward, and that soul <term>Nefesh: the lowest level of the soul, associated with vitality and the physical body</term> of which we spoke goes and wanders, resting in that "All" and returning to its place within its grave. And behold, a herald proclaims: "Tomorrow, so-and-so the son of so-and-so is coming to us!" If he is good, they all rejoice, and he is a companion to all of them. When that "All" ascends, they raise it to that faithful servant whose name is Metatron, and he takes that "All" to himself and ascends to his place. It is all like the servant of Isaac <note>Referring to Eliezer, who acted as a faithful intermediary</note>; "All" went out and "All" came in. From that hour, it goes and is prepared according to the merit of that soul. When it rests, there is merit for the spirit <term>Ruach: the middle level of the soul, associated with emotions and moral virtues</term> in the Garden of Eden, and merit for the soul <gloss>Nefesh</gloss> to descend and be strengthened by the "taste" of Metatron. It goes about because there is no soul that does not have a place of standing, and there is no soul that remains with the body <insert>unless it is one</insert> that has no standing, of which it is written: **"And the soul of your enemies, He shall sling it out as from the hollow of a sling"** <note>1 Samuel 25:29</note>, for it shall have no rest, but wanders and rolls through the whole world and has no standing at all. And from this lack of rest, the punishment is greater than all. And if it should remain with the body, it is that of which it is written: **"I will cut off that soul from among her people"** <note>Leviticus 17:10</note>, so that it shall have no memory at all. And there is no soul that does not remain with the body and move from place to place, as it is written: **"That soul shall be cut off from before Me; I am the Lord"** <note>Leviticus 22:3</note>. What does "from before Me" mean? That the spirit <gloss>Ruach</gloss> does not dwell upon it. And when the spirit does not dwell upon it, it has no partner at all in the Sanctuary above, and it knows nothing of the matters of the world at all. 

But if it is a soul <gloss>Nefesh</gloss> of the "beasts" <note>Meaning a soul that lived purely instinctively or without merit</note>, it is a soul without standing. And when it goes and wanders, it encounters that *Dumesis* and his officials; they take it and cover it at all the gates of the Garden of Eden, and they show it the glory of the righteous and the glory of its own spirit <gloss>Ruach</gloss>. It then cleaves to it in the Garden within that "garment" <note>The spiritual body or *Tzelem*</note>, and then it knows all the matters of the world. And when that spirit <gloss>Ruach</gloss> ascends to be crowned within the Supernal Tabernacle above, that soul <gloss>Nefesh</gloss> is bound to that spirit and is illuminated by it like the moon when it is illuminated by the sun. And the spirit is bound to that breath <term>Neshamah: the highest level of the soul, associated with the intellect and Divine spark</term>, and that breath is bound within the "End of Thought" <note>A reference to the Sephirah of Malchut or the ultimate destination of Divine emanation</note>, which is the mystery of the Soul Above. Thus, that soul <gloss>Nefesh</gloss> is bound to that supernal spirit, and that spirit is bound within that Supernal Tabernacle, and that Tabernacle is bound to those "Ends." Then there is rest for all, and a binding of all, above and below—all in one spirit and one hidden place. Then this is the rest of the soul below. Concerning this it is written: **"The soul of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of life with the Lord your God"** <note>1 Samuel 25:29</note>, in one rest, in one spirit. For this is not in rest when the side of the spirit of the Soul Above descends; it shines from all sides, it shines from all the "Chariots" and "Enclosures," making them into one complete body, as it is written: **"And it shall be like a watered garden"** <note>Isaiah 58:11</note>. Just so, when it descends, if the lower soul <gloss>Nefesh</gloss> shines from all sides from the light of the Tabernacle and from the light of the spirit, it shines to all those Chariots and Enclosures which are the "drops" and "bones," making them a complete body that shines like the radiance of the Holy. **"And He will satisfy your soul in drought"** <note>Isaiah 58:11</note>—literally the soul <gloss>Nefesh</gloss>—**"and make strong your bones,"** for He makes from the rest a complete body that shines with radiance. It then stands and rejoices and praises the Holy One, Blessed be He, as it is said: **"All my bones shall say: Lord, who is like unto You?"** <note>Psalm 35:10</note>. This is certainly the rest of the soul from all sides. These are the righteous who provide satisfaction to their Master in this world, to merit the three rests in the World to Come. Rabbi Shimon opened the discourse while riding with Rabbi Abba. Rabbi Shimon said: "And those who are my children, and those who are before me, how many places have they stood in?"

<meta>This page continues the mystical discourse of the Zohar on the Torah portion of Terumah (Offerings), focusing on the spiritual construction of the Tabernacle and the Temple. It follows themes of divine light and the merit of the righteous.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

...that the supernal merits are prepared for us and shine for us in the World to Come. He opened his discourse and said: **"A Song of Ascents: Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion, which cannot be moved, but abides forever"** <note>Psalm 125:1</note>. The companions have established this verse as referring to Mount Zion, the praise uttered by those holy supernal levels from the side of the Supernal Male. These are their assembly, and they are "ascents"—levels upon levels—who serve within the mystery of faith <term>Raza de-Meimanuta: The inner kabbalistic understanding of the divine unity</term>. They merit and sustain their life. "A Song of Ascents: Those who trust in the Lord"—this is because they are established through Him according to all their deeds, for "the righteous are as bold as a young lion" <note>Proverbs 28:1</note>.

And if you say that the righteous are not established by their deeds at all, and are always as fearful as a mustard seed—as it is written of Abraham: **"And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt..."** <note>Genesis 12:11; Abraham feared for his life</note>, and as it is written of Isaac: **"For he feared to say, 'She is my wife'"** <note>Genesis 26:7</note>, and of Jacob it is written: **"Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed"** <note>Genesis 32:8</note>. If so, they were not established by their deeds, and certainly not the rest of the righteous in the world! Why then do you say "the righteous are as bold as a young lion"?

Rather, it is certainly written "as a young lion" <note>Hebrew: *Kefir*</note>, for of all the names for a lion, it does not say *Aryeh*, *Shachal*, or *Shachatz* <note>Various Hebrew terms for lions of different strengths</note>, but specifically *Kefir*, which is the weakest and smallest of them all, not yet established in its full, mighty strength. So too, the righteous are not established by their deeds except as a "young lion." Even though they know the strength of their deeds is mighty, they only establish themselves as a young lion and no more. Because of this, "those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion"—not like a young lion or a mature lion, but they all lean upon Mount Zion. They established: Just as Mount Zion is strong and never falters, so too does He support and rest them like Mount Zion, except in that they only establish themselves as a young lion who fears and does not overpower with his own strength. And the High Holy Ones wept: "Your mercy is truly like Mount Zion! Fortunate are you, holy people, in this world and the World to Come."

See, when they reached the city, night grew strong. Rabbi Shimon said: "Just as this day was given to us to recognize our portion in this world and to achieve the World to Come, so too the night is given to us to achieve the World to Come and to crown the matters of day and night before the Ancient of Days <term>Atik Yomin: An aspect of the Divine representing the most ancient, hidden root of Will</term>. For in this time, perfection is found that is not found in any other generations—our merit and our portion in this world and the World to Come." They served in the assembly of Rabbi Shimon, Rabbi Eleazar, Rabbi Abba, and Rabbi Yose with them, and they sat until midnight.

When it was midnight, Rabbi Shimon said to the companions: "It is the time to crown the Holy Throne above, now that it is midnight." Rabbi Yose said to him: "We are indebted to you; we have heard from you this day such merit! Let there be a preparation for its place this night, for now is the time of favor to testify above and below."

Rabbi Yose opened and said: **"A Song of Ascents; of Solomon"** <note>Psalm 127:1</note>. This song was not awakened until King Solomon built the Holy Temple and all the worlds were perfected in service below in the proper manner. And even though the companions differ on this, this song was only said at the time the Sanctuary was built... The Temple was built in the likeness of the Supernal Realm. Through the Wisdom <note>Da'at</note> with which the Temple was built below, there was no joy before the Holy One, Blessed be He <term>Kadosh Baruch Hu: The standard rabbinic name for God</term>, from the day the world was created like that day.

The Tabernacle <term>Mishkan</term> that Moses made in the wilderness was to bring the Divine Presence <term>Shekhinah</term> down to the earth. On that day, another Tabernacle was raised with it above, as we have established from the verse "The Tabernacle was raised" <note>Exodus 40:17</note>—the repetition implies another Tabernacle was raised with it, and that is the Tabernacle of the Youth, Metatron <term>Metatron: The highest archangel, often associated with the celestial Tabernacle</term>, and no more. But when the First Temple was built, the First House was said to be established with it, and it was sustained in all worlds to be remembered for all worlds. The world was bound together and all the supernal windows were opened to shine. There was no joy in all the worlds like that day. Then those above and below opened and said a song, and that is the "Song of Ascents"—the song of those who are built to be a dwelling for the Holy One, Blessed be He.

## Main Text (Zohar)

->**Terumah (Offering)**<-

King David said, "A Song of Ascents," but King Solomon said, "The Song of Songs." These are songs of the musicians <note>The Levites who sang in the Temple</note>. What is the difference between this one and that one, since it sounds as if they are all one? Indeed, they are all one. However, in the days of King David, all those musical arrangements were not yet established in their proper places to draw down blessings and joy, etc., because the Sanctuary was not yet built. For this reason, they were not yet established Above in their proper places. For just as there are arrangements on the outside in joy, so too there are arrangements in the heavens, and they stand facing one another. On the day the Holy Temple was completed, they were all established in their proper places, and a blossom <note>a spiritual flowering</note> emerged like no other song. This song was established for the Supernal King, the King to whom Peace belongs <note>A wordplay on 'Solomon' (Shelomo) and 'Peace' (Shalom)</note>, and this addition is superior to all previous praises. On the day this praise was revealed in the world, perfection was found in everything, and it entered the Holy of Holies. As it was written in the Book of Adam the First: "The day they were established..." it is found that this song awakens both Above and Below. Therefore, it is found to be a song from the great lower ones, and these are the ones who awaken those musicians; rather, they awaken toward the Above, as it were, a song for those great songs that are appointed over all the worlds.

And we have learned: On that day, Jacob the Perfect arose and entered the Garden of Eden with joy to his place. Then the scent of Eden surrounded the Garden, and all those spices of the Garden spoke this song. And who said it? I would say it was Jacob, who went as far as the Garden of Eden and said the song of the Garden. This song is a song that is the crown of all freedom, a song that awakens both Above and Below. A song that is in the likeness of the World Above, which is the Sabbath. A song of praise to the Supernal Holy One who is crowned with His splendor and enters the Holy of Holies. Why? Because all its paths are in love and joy. Rather, it is because the <term>Cup of Blessing</term> <note>A ritual cup of wine over which grace or sanctification is said, symbolizing the vessel for Divine bounty</note> was given in his days. Once it was given in his days, then all joy and all permanence were found.

Therefore, in love and joy are all its paths. At the time this day is arranged to be spoken before the lack of the Right <note>The side of Mercy/Hesed</note>, then the Cup of Blessing is not given even in the washing <note>referring to ritual hand washing or the 'mayim acharonim' before grace</note>. Once it is given, sweetness rests upon the upper and lower worlds to open the cup for it. And what do they say? "Pity." By the life of the Cup of Blessing, which sits within after the World to Come, it is withheld and exacted from you. Because of this, the Song of Songs, which is from the side of the Right, all its paths are love and joy. Pity is from the side of the Right, and sweetness is found; all its paths are connections and foundations.

And if you say: "Behold, all joy and all gladness and all song come from the side of the Left <note>The side of Judgment/Gevurah, associated with the Levites' singing</note>, and therefore the musicians of the song should be from the side of the Left?" Even all the joy found on the side of the Left is only found when the Right is attached to the Holy. When the Right awakens and attaches to it, then that Holiness from the days is what sweetens the wrath. When the wrath is stilled and measured from the side of the Right, then perfect joy comes from this side. But when the Right is not found, the wrath of the Left overpowers and does not subside, does not improve, and does not rejoice. Then "Pity." By the life of the Cup of Blessing, what will become of it? For it sits in the Left, and wrath overpowers and does not subside, and groans and laments are awakened.

But the Song of Songs is for the life of the Cup of Blessing that is given to the Right and is drawn out in its splendor, and all love and all joy are found in it. Therefore, all its paths are in love and joy, and it is not found like this among all the songs of the world. Because of this, this song awakens from the side of <term>Wisdom</term> <note>Hokhmah, the highest spark of intellect</note>. On the day this song was revealed, that was the day the <term>Shekhinah</term> <note>The Divine Presence</note> descended to the earth, as it is written:

> "And the priests could not stand to minister..." <note>1 Kings 8:11</note>

What is the reason? "Because the glory of the Lord filled the house of the Lord." On that very day, this praise was revealed.

## Main Text (Zohar)

This <note>the Song of Songs</note> was grasped by Solomon through the **Holy Spirit**. This praise of the Torah is the life of all, the life of every world, and the life of the entire Work of Creation; everything is within the spirit of wisdom. Everything is within the garden of the **Matron** <note>The Shekhinah, the feminine aspect of the Divine</note>. When Israel went out from Egypt and sang the praise of the Song, it was all for them and for the standing at Mount Sinai. And when they sinned and were driven into the wilderness until they entered the Land and the Holy Temple was built, it was all through the adornment of the **Holy Name** upon her in love and joy. All the exiles of Israel among the nations and their redemption; all the resurrections of the dead until the day that is the Sabbath to the Lord <note>original: יהוה</note>. It gives life to what was, life to what is, and life to what is destined to be. And after the seventh day, when it shall be a Sabbath to the Lord, everything is contained within the **Song of Songs**.

Regarding this, we have learned: anyone who sees a verse from the Song of Songs and treats it like a common drinking song <note>using sacred text for secular entertainment</note>, the life of that song ascends and rises before **the Holy One, Blessed be He** <note>original: קב"ה</note> and says before Him: "Your children have made me like a common tavern song!" And the life-force of the song ascends and speaks thus because it is necessary to guard and raise the crown upon the head of every single word of the Song of Songs. And if you say it is a living thing among the Scriptures, it is indeed so; it pushes back against the pressure of the "Heh" <note>the letter representing the Shekhinah</note>. The praise of the Assembly of Israel is crowned above, and because of this, all the praises of the world do not rise in favor before the Holy One, Blessed be He, like this praise.

Thus we have learned: "Song" is one, "of the Songs" is two—behold, three. And this is the mystery of the seal of the Cup of Blessing, which is held between the right and the left, and everything is awakened toward the King whose peace is His <note>A play on the name Solomon/Shelomo, meaning "His peace"</note>. All desire ascends in a spirit that pushes to the ultimate height, the **Holy Chariot** <note>term: Ratika - the celestial vehicle of Divine manifestation</note> of "Koh" <note>the number 25 or a Divine name</note>, which joins them together. The chariot of King David is joined with them, and they are the four who make up the mystery of the Supernal Holy Chariot. Because of this, there are four words in this first verse <note>Song of Songs 1:1</note> corresponding to the spirit of the complete Holy Chariot.

Furthermore, this mystery: "Song" is the spirit of King David, which is a spirit that ascends the mountain. "Of the Songs" refers to the wise ones, the spirits appointed over the great and complete Chariot as is fitting. <term>Which is to Solomon</term> <note>original: אשר לשלמה</note> is the spirit of the visionaries who ride upon this complete chariot. In this verse is found the perfection of the spirit from world to world, the mystery of all faith. It is all a complete chariot, to see what is known and to see what is not known, for there is no one who can stand to know Him. Therefore, this verse is stated in four words: the spirit of the complete chariot from all sides. From here onward, the spirit of prophecy is transmitted.

<term>Song</term> in a dream: one sees a living creature of its kind. One who sees a **spider** <note>original: עכביש</note> in his dream sees visions; they are good visions. Sometimes they are good, and when they are not in their proper time, they require mercy. It shows good visions and shows wisdom; it shows good in its time and shows good out of its time. Furthermore, we have learned: dreams that involve wisdom are a guarantee that he is a son of the World to Come. Behold, we have learned that the **spider** is what the First Adam sinned with; they were spiders, as it is written: <note>Isaiah 59:5</note> > they weave the spider's web <. And these are "wise spiders" because the life of a spider is wisdom, and the life of a spider is visions. Good visions, for they atone for the life of those wise ones who require mercy, for they are from the side of death. In their time they are good—what is the reason? Because we have written that the visions rule with strength, for at that time they all need strength, and everything is beautiful, and all strength is a matter of wisdom and vision. But in a time when visions do not rule and the wise are below, let it be known that he is caught in the judgment of death and needs mercy. For the power through which the First Adam sinned brought death to him and to all the world he saw. Here one must look: is there not life here? We have learned that this world is in the likeness of the world above, and in the world above, everything that exists in this world exists there as well. The power that caused death here below, its power above is life, if you say...

## Main Text (Zohar)

->Contribution<-

If you say that below, because the <term>moon<note>original: *sihara*; refers to the Shekhinah or the feminine aspect of the Divine</note></term> diminishes, she diminishes at times, and at that time she is like death, while the <term>masculine<note>original: *dkhura*; the active, giving force</note></term> takes hold. And see how much the moon suffers because of that "sin" <note>referring to the primordial diminishment of the moon mentioned in Midrash</note>, like death in her diminishment; but we have learned that it was not because of "how much" [sin] it was. Rather, the moon spoke before the <term>Holy One, blessed be He<note>original: *Kudsha Brich Hu*; the standard reference to God in the Zohar</note></term> and so on—it was not because of that. And if you say that in the world it is so, see that the diminishment is above. Rather, all these are secrets of the Torah, and how they all established the diminishment. Come and see, for so we have learned: everything that the Holy One, blessed be He, made above and below is all like the spirit of male <term>and female<note>original: *nuqba*; the receptive aspect</note></term>. And there are many <term>levels<note>original: *darghin*</note></term> above that end one in the other, and from level to level is this spirit. And those levels that are female, the Holy One, blessed be He, made them in the likeness of a single body until they ascend like this spirit. And we learned: on the second day of the Work of Creation, in which Gehenna [Hell] was found, a single breath of this spirit was made, and those drops are appointed ones who draw near to these and die, and return as before. And this is because they drew near to this "brain" <note>a metaphor for a high level of divine consciousness</note>, and they said that it opened within the poverty of this brain, and because of this, their death causes him a death that shall be near to him. And in every place, it is male and female. But Adam, who is a high holiness, he established the plantings over all this; he gives sustenance and life to all. And he acted like the whole, striking like that powerful brain. When the female—who is Adam—is found to be worn out, as it says, she died, and the male died, and they ascend as at first; all this is in the likeness of that which is above. But those "spiders" <note>original: *akhbin*; likely referring to the *akhavish* or spider, representing forces of the "Other Side" or husks that entangle</note> dry it out, for it is so in the World to Come, because they are many and rule over that place, and pass over it and are crushed like the whole, and made thin. Once that powerful <term>shell<note>original: *qlipah*; the "husk" or "peel" of evil that conceals holiness</note></term> is removed, behold, it draws near to the World to Come, and there is none to stay his hand. And because of this, the seers who see in their dreams those "wise spiders" eating and crushing. In this manner, there was no song in the House of David until those "wise spiders" were removed and they ascended over them, and then it is said: <term>A Song of Ascents<note>original: *Shir HaMa'alot*; the title of Psalms 120–134</note></term>, as it is said. And even in this place, it is called a "spider," all like a spider as it says, etc. And these are other "spiders." This song is superior to all other songs that preceded it. All the songs that preceded it, they said them to raise the joy of the King's birds <note>metaphor for angels or souls</note> over him; they said "passed over," for behold, they established it, as it is written:
> A Song of Ascents of David <note>Psalms 122:1</note>
This spirit was said. Rather, "A Song of Ascents"—a song that the high King's [angels] say over them; others say "ascents and levels." For whom? For David, to seek prey and sustenance from Him. Furthermore, "A Song of Ascents" is like "upon the maidens" <note>a play on *al-almot* (maidens) and *ama'alot* (ascents)</note> a song:
> Therefore the maidens love you <note>Song of Songs 1:3</note>
For David, because David is a high king, he is always found with the high King. Since the hidden King rested, a brother, a brother <note>possibly a rhythmic or ecstatic repetition</note>, this song which is high above, upon which the world's paths are set, they say to the high King, for she is His bride. All those who say song did not ascend in that song to say [it], but rather they say that song of the high King. Except for King Solomon, who ascended in that song to that which the pillars of the world are set upon, they say. All the people of the world [ascend] in lower <term>chariots<note>original: *ratikhin*; divine vehicles or structures</note></term>, but the King ascends in the chariots above him. And if you say Moses, who ascended as a level to Might (*Gevurah*) and we waited for the Holy One, blessed be He, more than all the people of the world—that song which he said was in the lower chariots and did not ascend further. Come and see: the song that Moses said ascended above and not below. But he did not say a song like King Solomon, and there was no man who ascended in the song of the soul [like him]. Moses ascended in his praise above, and his praise was to take praises and bring them to the high King, who brought them to Israel and performed for them miracles and mighty deeds, as he said, "and upon my life." But King David and Solomon his son said song in the likeness [of the upper world].

<meta>This page continues the mystical discourse on the Tabernacle (Terumah), focusing on the spiritual preparations for the union of the Divine Couple. It transitions from the roles of David and Solomon to the hidden wisdom in the Book of Ecclesiastes and the story of Joseph.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

In the proper manner, David strived to prepare the maiden <note>The "maiden" or *almeta* refers to the lower manifestation of the Shekhinah</note> and to adorn her as the Matronita <note>The Noble Lady/Queen, the Shekhinah in her glory</note>, so that the Matronita and the maiden would appear in beauty. Because of this, he strived with those songs and praises toward Him until all the maidens and the Matronita were prepared and adorned. Once King Solomon arrived, the Matronita was already adorned and the maiden was in beauty; he then strived to bring her to the Groom <note>The Holy One, Blessed be He</note>. One part was bringing the Groom to the wedding canopy (*Chuppah*) with the Matronita, and the other part was bringing them to the chamber of love between them, in order to bless them as one and so that both would be in perfect completion and perfect affection.

Regarding this, Solomon’s song rose higher than all the people of the world. What David did was lead the Matronita in this world below, so that she would be in this world in a perfect manner below. Solomon united the Matronita in a perfect union above and below. Therefore, first the Groom goes to the canopy, and afterward he brings them both into this world and invites them to the dwelling of the Holy Temple to rejoice as one.

And if you say: How did he bring the Matronita in her form into this world, for surely separation was decreed? <note>Referring to the "diminishing of the moon" or the exile of the Shekhinah</note> Come and see: The Holy One, Blessed be He, first united her with Moses, and she became "the Bride of Moses," as has been stated. Once she was united with him, she almost descended into this world in the manner of this world, and she was established in this world in a way she had not been previously, and she was never in separation.

But there was no man in the world, from the day Adam was born, who arranged the love, affection, and matters of union above except for King Solomon. He prepared the union above first, and then invited them together into the House <note>The Temple</note> that he prepared for them. All of them—David and Solomon his son—were for the sake of preparing the union above. From the day the Holy One, Blessed be He, said to the Moon, "Go and diminish yourself," she was not united in a perfect manner until King Solomon arrived.

*The Song of Songs* <note>original: *Shir HaShirim*</note>: Here there are five levels to cleave to the World to Come. *Song* (*Shir*) is one. *The Songs* (*HaShirim*) is two—making three. *Which* (*Asher*) is four. *To Solomon* (*Lishlomo*) is five. This corresponds to when joy ascends, for the fiftieth day <note>Pentecost/Shavuot</note>, the spirit of the Jubilee, is joy.

Come and see: Solomon could not have prepared the union above unless a union was found below previously. And who is the union below? <unclear>textual variant</unclear> The union was not established above [without the below], and all is through the Supernal Spirit; let this be known to the wise. It is written: *And God remembered Rachel* <note>Genesis 30:22</note> and *his song was a thousand and five* <note>1 Kings 5:12</note>. For if the verse of wisdom proclaims to all, *And God remembered Rachel*, then for every single word he spoke, there were three thousand parables, like the Book of Ecclesiastes <note>original: *Kohelet*</note>, which is in the Supernal Spirit and is of a single "constellation" <note>*Mazal*, referring to a specific divine flow</note>. There is no verse in it that is not in the Supernal Wisdom. Even a small verse in it reaches everything.

Rav Hamnuna the Elder said: This verse is hidden: *Remember your Creator in the days of your youth* <note>Ecclesiastes 12:1</note>. Therefore, *in the days of your youth* is established <unclear>textual variant</unclear> and this is the "constellation." And who can perform an interpretation like this? There is no interpretation in it like those we see in common matters. It is Wisdom itself—who can know it?

Immediately he returned and said: It is written, *These are the generations of Jacob: Joseph, being seventeen years old...* <note>Genesis 37:2</note>. And this verse from Ecclesiastes is placed within the wisdom of this verse regarding "youth," and this is the "constellation," for he was not simply a "youth" in his childhood. Rather, *he was a youth* <note>Genesis 37:2</note>—and your goodness is thus. *He was shepherding his brothers with the flock... in the days of your youth... with the sons of Bilhah and the sons of Zilpah, his father’s wives.* *And know that for all these* <note>Ecclesiastes 11:9</note> *Joseph brought an evil report of them.* *And God will bring you into judgment* <note>Ecclesiastes 11:9</note>. *These are the generations of Jacob: Joseph.* Joseph was included in Jacob, and the secrets of the hidden Torah—who can know them? And if the "constellation" spreads into three thousand parables, they are all as one.

<meta>This page continues the mystical discourse on the Tabernacle offerings (Terumah), focusing specifically on the symbolic numerology of King Solomon’s "thousand" and the union of the divine masculine and feminine principles (Yesod and Malchut).</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

-> **Terumah** <note>The portion of "Offerings"</note> <-

In this constellation <note>original: *mazala*</note> of the constellation of Joseph, it is included as the heel. Three thousand are like the levels of Isaac and Jacob, for all of them are in this constellation as the spirit of wisdom. And here, how many travelers <note>original: *tayayin*, often referring to wandering merchants or hidden masters</note> are among the errors that are hidden within them; they dwell in exile and have no presence among the hidden things of wisdom. "And there were five thousand" <note>referring to 1 Kings 5:12 regarding Solomon's songs</note>—so we have established it. "And there was a closing" <note>original: *vayehi soger*</note> toward the constellation, and all are one between life and matter. Solomon’s "closing" is similar to the "closing" toward the constellation; they are all one and all speak of the same thing. This "closing" is the Secret of Secrets.

And are five thousand indeed the Secret of Secrets? Certainly, it is so. Five are the gates and openings that open within the King to whom peace belongs <note>A common Zoharic wordplay: *Shelomoh* (Solomon) is read as *She-ha-shalom shelo*, "The King to whom peace belongs," referring to the Sefirah of Yesod or Tiferet</note>. And these are the five hundred thousand merits that go forth to the life of the fifty merits of the Jubilee <note>The Sefirah of Binah</note>. And this "thousand" is that which goes from the life of the Bridegroom <note>The masculine principle</note> who emerges from his side, and he inherits all those five to show them to the Bride. And he who receives a thousand merits is he; and this is the river that flows and goes out from Eden.

Joseph merited to be called "Righteous" <note>original: *Tzadik*</note> after the name of the Moon <note>original: *Siahra*</note>, as it was said of him by the Holy One, blessed be He. And because of this, the Secret of Secrets is the Holy of Holies. And there is no interruption in the Secret of Secrets, for there is no spirit of sin within it. And "thousand" is certainly the Secret of Secrets; certainly it is so. Five hundred levels are those that cease, as it has been said.

And if you say the "Thousand" is brought back to be mentioned here—certainly that Thousand is hidden, and it remains hidden until it is found below like a husband. And for this reason, Solomon strived to bring that Thousand to the Bride in the secrecy found in the Higher Wisdom. Once he made the Holy of Holies below, he concealed and hid it, and brought the spirit of the Holy of Holies into there to create a hidden concealment, ascending above and below as is fitting.

The Holy of Holies is above, the spirit of the Higher Wisdom of the Jubilee. In this manner, the Bridegroom and Bride inherit the inheritance of the Father and Mother <note>original: *Abba ve-Imma*, the Sefirot of Chokhmah and Binah</note>, and they are crowned with the estate, an inheritance like the other. The inheritance of the Father is inherited by the Daughter <note>Malchut</note>, who rises to the holy brain of all, and is thus also called "Holy Wisdom." The inheritance of the Mother is inherited by the Son <note>Zeir Anpin</note>, and he is called "Holy" because he takes all those upper holies and gathers them into himself, and afterward gives them and brings them to the Bride.

And for this reason, the Secret of Secrets is a secret regarding the Holy of Holies, regarding the holy ones, so that the Bride may become the Holy of Holies as one spirit, as has been said. Regarding Solomon—this has been said of "the King to whom peace belongs." And if you say this path is his own—do not say so; it is generally after the Higher One that it ascends. For all is the spirit of all that is prepared, male and female.

When the hope of the Higher King is present, then that King ascends above and is filled with all holiness and all blessings that flow downward; he is filled and pours out below. And this is the benefit of the Higher King: when he is filled with holiness and blessings and pours them below. And this is the prayers and supplications of those below, and that higher storehouse is filled because it is prepared as is fitting. From his appearance and the vision of that preparation, the lower world and their prayers are prepared.

And this is why the lower world needs to be prepared by the Higher One. The Moon has no light of her own at all except when she is prepared by the Sun <note>The masculine principle, Tiferet/Yesod</note> and shines; and the vision of the Sun and his preparation is the repair that allows her to endure. Where prayers and supplications from below are needed, that place from which they emerge is prepared in the secret; for once that place is prepared, all that is below is prepared from its appearance. And because of this, it is found that Solomon strived only for the sake of "the King to whom peace belongs," that he might be prepared. Once he is prepared by his own appearance, the Bride is prepared. And if he is not prepared, there is no preparation for the Moon forever. And because of this: "For Solomon"—that he may be prepared and filled as is fitting, as in the beginning, as it was said.

And they shall take... <note>The start of the next verse, Exodus 25:2</note>

## Main Text (Zohar - Secrets of the Torah)

->**Secrets of the Torah**<-

**"And they shall take** for Me an offering from every man..." <note>Exodus 25:2</note> This is a secret of secrets for those who know wisdom. Everything is taken through the desire of the commerce of all the "Crowns" <note>The Sefirot or divine emanations</note> to bring honor to the honor of this High Ancient Spirit <note>original: *Ruacha Atika*, referring to the highest, most hidden aspect of Divinity</note> which is concealed from above to below, so that its arrangements may be established in this world. See, because this world does not take the essence and root, it does not take from the whole to share with this world at all. And if it did not pour into this world, the world would immediately be destroyed and could not stand for even a single moment. But because its arrangements are such, the lower world testifies before it to pour into this world; and from the side of the "Calling," to pour into the world, and all of them were established through it in this. The perfection of the strength of this Spirit rests upon the righteous. In this world, this Spirit is for praise. Through this, they descend and praise increases in the world. But the guilty of the world caused that perfection to be removed from it. Later, they restored it to Him as it was and uplifted it. During the generation of the Tower of Babel <note>original: *Dor HaPelagah*</note>, they removed that perfection from it and came to destroy and debase it. Then Abraham came from the south and uplifted it below; Isaac came and perfected it. The Philistines came and stopped up the wells and removed it from him. Jacob came and his sons increased the perfection and perfected it. They were suppressed by the Holy Land and went down to Egypt, and their children were delayed there. Because Israel was enslaved there to masters who suppressed them, that perfection was removed until they went out from Egypt and came to build the Tabernacle <note>original: *Mishkana*</note>. The Holy One, Blessed be He, said: "It is My will to dwell among you, but I cannot until you prepare that Spirit of Mine which is spread out for your sake." This is what is written: "And let them make Me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them." <note>Exodus 20:8</note> And this is the secret of what is written: "And they shall take for Me an offering." Moses said to the Holy One, Blessed be He: "Who can take this and do this?" He said to him: "Moses, it is not as you think, but rather 'from every man whose heart prompts him' <note>Exodus 25:2</note>—from their own will and spirit you shall take and perfect it." The whole world comes to repair that Spirit of perfection above, for from the day it was perfected below in the days of Jacob, that perfection was not removed from it until the time of Solomon. When Solomon came, he strove to perfect it above and began to prepare the vision of the upper world to be repaired from the vision of the lower world, and this is the place of Solomon.

**"And this** is the offering..." <note>Exodus 25:3</note> It has been said that the Holy One, Blessed be He, was revealed on Mount Sinai when the Torah was given to Israel in Ten Utterances <note>original: *Eser Amiran*, the Ten Commandments</note>. Each and every utterance produced a voice, and that voice was divided into three voices, and they were all radiant <note>original: *nehorin*</note> and gathered before the eyes of Israel so they could see the vision of His glory. This is what is written: "And all the people saw the voices." <note>Exodus 20:15</note> They literally "saw." And that voice would warn each and every one of Israel and say to them: "Will you accept Me upon yourselves with such and such commandments of the Torah?" and they would say, "Yes." Then it would return to his head and be crowned upon him. Then it would warn him again and say: "Will you accept Me upon yourselves with such and such punishments of the Torah?" and he would say, "Yes." Afterward, that voice would return and kiss him on his mouth; this is what is written: "Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth." <note>Song of Songs 1:2</note> And then, everything that Israel saw at that time, they saw within one light that included all those other lights, and they were worthy to see it. The Holy One said to them: "That light which you saw on Mount Sinai, which includes all those colors and lights—as an addition for you, you shall receive it and take it to yourselves." And those colors that it receives, these are: "gold, and silver, and brass, etc." <note>Exodus 25:3</note> This is "Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth." King Solomon divided the lower portion into the dark light of the love between the upper world and the lower world, and the throat of praise of love that enters between them... But they have established it, and so it is, that there is no love like the cleaving of spirit to spirit.

<meta>This page continues the mystical exploration of the celestial Palaces (Heichalot), specifically focusing on the Palace of Love (Heichala de-Ahava). It follows the thematic ascent of the soul and the unification of divine names through the metaphor of breath and romantic longing.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

In the spirit, there is a movement of inhalation and exhalation <note>original: "netika ve-setika"</note> like the appearance of springs of spirit that emerge from it. And as they emerge, they cleave one to another; these spirits merge with those spirits and become one. Then, a vision of a single love appears, like a breath to the heart of the labyrinth. A wise man of old used to say regarding this verse that the movement <note>original: "ketika"</note> of love spreads into four spirits, and these four spirits are as one, and they dwell within the spirit of faith. They ascend like four letters, and these are the letters of the Holy Name <note>The Tetragrammaton: Y-H-V-H</note> upon which all things depend; the upper and lower worlds hang upon them, and the praise of the *Song of Songs* hangs upon them. And what is this? It is Love. These constitute the Supernal Chariot, and they are the fellowship, the cleaving, and the perfection of all. These are the four spirits, and they are spirits of love and joy for all the limbs of the body. All matters are included in these four spirits; they are like a movement where each one is included in its fellow. All of this spirit is included in the other, and from this one to the other it is included in this one. They become two and two as one, and when they join in a single cleaving, they are four in perfection, mirroring one another and integrated into one another. 

When they separate, a single power is made from those four spirits—a vision and a single spirit comprised of four spirits. This spirit ascends and pierces the firmaments until it rises and dwells within a certain Palace called the **Palace of Love**. This is the vision of the Palace where all love depends, and there stands the pure spirit called Love. When this spirit ascends, it awakens that Palace to be joined above. There are four letters corresponding to the four spirits, and they are "Love" <note>The Hebrew word A-H-V-H (Love) has the same numerical value as E-Ch-A-D (One)</note>. Regarding that love, when they join with one another, immediately this side awakens toward that side, and that side toward this side. The letter *Aleph* (א) immediately brings forth the *He* (ה) and joins with it; the *He* cleaves to the *Aleph* in a perfect bond. Then two other letters are made in the *He*, and spirits are integrated with spirits in a cleaving of love. These fly, and some of them are in that spirit which ascends, becoming crowned in it as is fitting. 

When he beholds that perfect love, comprised of all those four spirits, he encounters a great celestial appointee <note>original: "memana"</note> who is appointed over one thousand three hundred and ninety firmaments. This appointee has the appearance of the "Son of the Era" <note>A cryptic title</note>. Twelve rivers of pure balsam flow from the Supernal Spirit above, and that "Son of the Era" is called M"S Rekis. When he encounters that **Great Metatron** <note>The Prince of the Presence and highest of angels</note>, he acts as an accuser <note>original: "kateg"</note> against him, yet he cannot hinder him or pass through him until he enters the Palace of Love. Regarding this, Solomon said in the scripture:

> Many waters cannot quench love <note>Song of Songs 8:7</note>

"Many waters" refers to those supernal waters that flow in the upper world, "neither can the floods drown it"—these are the twelve rivers of pure balsam. For the appointee stands outside, he who ascends from before the Lord <note>original: "Y-H-V-H"</note>. This is the Great Metatron who accuses in two ways to destroy the spirit of Katriel <note>An angelic name meaning "Crown of God"</note> who wreaths crowns to destroy, as we have engraved from the scripture and this secret. As soon as he beholds the Palace of Love, the Beloved is awakened by the supernal "striking" <note>A mystical term for the interaction of divine lights</note>, as it is written:

> And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept <note>Genesis 29:11</note>

This is a supernal love <note>original: "rehimu ila'ah"</note> as is fitting. These are the movements and turnings that are awakened from all the love of cleaving and the bond above. They are like the sum of the turnings of the praise of the song... the letter *He* (ה) which is hidden within the supernal hiddenness. This is the hiddenness of all hidden things; upon it depend the movements, and it yearns for what is below. The third is the hiddenness of all hidden things; no one knows it. A vision of light comes from it like a single thin, hidden point that is not revealed except as a single thin path that spreads out—a concealed treasure that illuminates all. From this, all the supernal secrets are awakened. The vision is hidden; sometimes it is hidden and sometimes it is revealed. Even when it is revealed, it is not revealed fully. The perfections of the movements depend upon it. Because it is hidden, the turning of the praise is hidden together with its power, and this depends upon it. What does Jacob seek here? These movements depend upon him. Rather, it is certainly so; he stands as a witness to that which is hidden above, as explained in the secret...

Because of this, the supernal one always ascends toward the Supernal King. When Israel is meritorious, they all elevate her through their intention and bring her down below. That offering is joy, hovering over them, and the cloud stands over them, and from its vision above them comes the rectification—the rectification for her through intention from below. By what power is this? These are the seventy who were created in all the structures and dimensions to perform the commandments of the Torah. Just as there are colors to be seen below in the likeness of those above in the external services, those colors are found below in that offering. Colors emerge below that correspond to the colors above—physical forms in colors that reveal the supernal ones, sparking into one another. These were made into a "body" for this time, a rectification from below, as it is written:

**Gold**, which is included in *Gevurah* (Strength/Judgment). Give to the world *Gevurah* as it is weighed out, and the "taste" of gold spreads below from this.

**Copper** for the world, which emerges from gold because of its flame. These stand and dwell in the Holy Spirit. "Copper" (*Nechoshet*) is like the lower realm. From *Hod* (Splendor) and its strength, they are empowered in the binding of the "claws of the palm" from below. Therefore, copper is included in *Hod* and is included in the angel Huriel, and this becomes a body for that.
**Blue** (*Tekhelet*), this is like a throne in the Assembly [of Israel]. It is given so that all may be strengthened on two sides. Blue is powerful, and there is none who can drip upon it to arm the flash of the net to ensnare it, for it is powerful. This is in the strength of the name *E"L*, as it is written:
> And God (*E"L*) is indignant every day.
<note>Psalms 7:12</note>
And when weeping returns in this way, with the desire of weariness, the hidden arrangement of the soul for this decree—their dream comes from that judgment.

And **purple** <note>Hebrew: *Argaman*</note> refers to the male and female principles that are joined as one, emerging from the inclusion of the **blue** <note>Hebrew: *Tekhelet*</note> below. They do not separate from one another, and regarding this it is written that He "works in secret in His heights." Because they are joined together, they become one body. And **scarlet wool** <note>Hebrew: *Tola'at Shani*</note> is above and is included as one <note>Exodus 25:4</note> etc. First, to show their attachment to the blue and within the purple; it takes their life-force and is included in the Kingdom <note>The Sephirah of *Malkhut*</note> through the spirit that enters below, which is represented by **silver and gold**. Here, this spirit refers to the pillars <margin>my house</margin> above—the prophets and the righteous ones below. It is a shell within a shell to protect them. And we have established that those who gaze upon the "marrow of the marrow" <note>The innermost essence</note> see that this is the shell for the marrow.

## **And Skins**
## **And Skins**
**Ram skins** <note>Hebrew: *Orot Eilim*</note> that are strengthened: these are the masters of shields, with eyes flaming with drops of fire. They are all "eyes" in the expansion of blood and are called the "firmaments of the male," like a shell. **Dolphin skins** <note>Hebrew: *Tachashim*</note>: these are within the holy side and are lowered into holiness. This is seen in what we said regarding the connection to the cycle of the "other beasts" <note>The *Sitra Achra* or "Other Side"</note>—a beast below and a beast below. These are the beasts of Ishmael, according to their laws; just as there is a beastly level in Esau, so too there is a beastly level in Ishmael. The heat of Ishmael is for the secular world below, and from the side of the connection of the "thin shell" <note>Hebrew: *Kelipah Dakah*</note> that was in the first light. From here comes the claim that lights go out to all sides. Once that first light was subdued, the Holy One, blessed be He <note>Original: *Kudsha Brich Hu*</note>, hid it; and from then on, He hid it for the Righteous. And who are they? **The Righteous and Righteousness** <note>The divine masculine and feminine principles, *Tzaddik* and *Tzedek*</note>, because through that first light, He made "smiles" for the world. And those smiles are the life-breath for the world. For it was necessary to create "smiles" and "lamps," as it is written: "The beast of wisdom..." Esau lacked "the lattice" <note>Cf. Proverbs 12:27: "The slothful man roasts not that which he took in hunting"</note>. Just as they made a lamp on the side of holiness, so too they made a lamp on the "Other Side" to show that it is the awakening from below. In the "Other Side," the decrees were not agreed upon in the world at all.

## **And Wood**
**Acacia wood** <note>Hebrew: *Atzei Shittim*</note>: This is what we have established—that they are the "leaves" of the pillars, all of them the leaves of the pillars of <margin>Levi</margin> the appointee, Levi. Why is Levi the appointee? He is appointed over that shell. And if you say this verse was originally below, it was said: "And the creeping things of the beasts descended." A beast in this manner is what is written in the verse: "And they sent angels to the Temple," specifically to humble that shell. Since he mentioned the spirit of that shell, it is written: "leaves of the pillars," and Levi is appointed over that shell. **And oil for the light**: this is the supernal mystery of the lower world from the higher. There are two "times." And they are two that are one: one above, which is called the **Time of the Cycle** <note>The eternal, unchanging divine rhythm</note>, and one below, which is called **Time for the Cycle** <note>The temporal world of change</note>. The "Time of the Cycle" is the supernal one that stands within itself and never ceases; it shines from the mystery of holiness, and all blessings, all lights, and all stars are blessed and illuminated from there. The "Time for the Cycle" sometimes shines and sometimes does not. Furthermore, we have learned it is written:
> And God made the two great lights <note>Genesis 1:16</note>

And so on. And it is considered that we have established the Holy One, blessed be He, etc. The "Great Lights" refer to the Time of the Cycle and the Time for the Cycle—the Upper World and the Lower World. One is male and one is female. And all the times of the male and the stars come as one, and we call them the "vessels of the gaze" of the male. Like the children of the Upper World, it is called "Great" in its construction. The Lower World, when it is joined with the Bride, is called "Great." But once they are separated from one another—the male specifically—each one is seen as is fitting: this one is called "Great" and this one is called "Small." Because of this, the ancients said that there are times for freedom and times where there is no room for union; for as long as they stand in freedom, they are not called by individual names but are included in the generality of freedom. And when they move toward the spirit of freedom, they are alive without separation. Like those who carry, the head is hidden for them.

## Main Text (Zohar)

The Head. The head of the mountain <note>referring to a high spiritual level or "Sefirah"</note> exists without iron and is called "the call." Since it was not separated from the Above, as it were, to perceive the "scent of the mountain," it was then called "the small call." And because of this, the time of the Luminary never ceases and stands in a supernal ascent; but when the time of the Luminary ceases, it is called "the small call," and the Exile is revealed. Truly, these times are like husks <note>original: "klipot," the shells of impurity</note> within time, and they are not one life but two, yet all are one. *Costly stones, etc.* <note>1 Kings 7:9</note> All these thirteen aspects are the preparation of the dwelling place and a testimony to the primordial words.

Gold is here below, and the dwelling of these lives is certain. And if you say gold is for the living spirit and silver is for the sweetness above silver—it is not so, for the spirit that ascends is greater than all. Woe, for they are as one, and the Supernal did not give the seventh of all these lives; and it was gold, but not the gold that shines and is hidden from the eyes. Nor was it the gold that, when it bends toward the world, bends whoever clings to it, hiding him within it; from there they bend, and all the days of gold are found.

Its wrath is called gold. Who is called gold? When the life of the children ascends as a glory to life, and life is in a supernal pressure to be seen below. And all life is in pressure when it changes from that color to the color of blue, black, and red; then life is under powerful pressure. Woe, gold is in the fullness of life, and in the ascent of the life of the nest it stands, and in the furnaces of knowledge.

And silver is below, a spirit for the desire of the Right Hand <note>the attribute of Mercy/Chesed</note> which possesses the supernal scent and life, as it is written: <term>the hook of the line</term> <note>original: "chakat kua," a difficult term likely referring to the "hooks of the pillars" in the Tabernacle</note>, a scent for the path. The refined parts and the arms are of silver below, and when silver changes, then the power of the lamps is revealed: <quote>Like apples of gold in settings of silver</quote> <note>Proverbs 25:11</note>. The engraving of silver was carved for the heart, and then it was completed in two; and because of this, <term>the eyes of gold</term> <note>original: "vini zahav"</note> are prepared.

And copper is a bent ring and was changed to the diminishment of the Left Arm <note>the attribute of Judgment/Gevurah</note>. And blue, purple, and scarlet wool are the softness of the Right, and the Left is revealed. And this is the river that flows and goes out to life, encompassing all six sides in this manner below, and the law was established and guarded. The pure one is seven who eat, and the support goes to those six; they are thirteen, and the seventh of life is the scent upon them. These thirteen are the scent that stands over the whole body below, the scent that stands over all the drops of the body, and so on. What is the difference between this and that? Supernal gold is life in a hidden spirit; its time is "closed gold" <note>original: "zahav sagur," referring to 1 Kings 6:20</note>. It is gathered and closed off from all, and it is called "closed" because the eye has no power over it. But lower gold is life when it is more revealed.

And if you say Samuel was not a pious one in the priesthood, rather he was the "wine" <note>the strength</note> that was supported in the priesthood, and who is he?

...their bodies were such, for it is written "from the priests" <note>original: *min ha-kohanim*</note>, lacking in his service, he ate from the priests. And Aaron—whoever nullifies this burning and merits it, merits those high degrees where the staff stands. And Aaron, they are entwined. And see how far they are, because they emerge from the side of this **Gold**, it was made into **Silver** for them, and not another color. Nor is it the color of yellowish gold like the Accuser <note>Satan</note>. The colors of gold and silver mingle to become a vision, to become a spirit above in one chamber, to stand with them and to flow between them on all sides, to be found complete as one, as it is written: **Gold, Silver, and Copper**. This is gold and silver: gold that is made into silver and silver into gold, and all is included as one, like male and female as one. The colors were spoken of; all is needed to sweeten the Garden of Judgment. **Gold** is when it is needed for Mercy; **Silver** is when it is needed for Strength in Judgment; **Copper** <note>original: *Nechoshet*</note> is for the power of Judgment. And concerning this, Moses looked into the act of the Copper Serpent, as it is written: **"And Moses made a copper serpent"** <note>Numbers 21:9</note>. And he knew the hidden place of Gold, which is Copper, because it is written "all of it is for him." And he knew its place, for the Holy One, Blessed be He, said to him: "This is the place of the sweeping," and he came and made a copper serpent, as it is written: **"And Moses made a copper serpent."** What is this? Rather, he knew the place, and the root of the matter was that initially it is written: **"And the Lord sent fiery serpents among the people"** <note>Numbers 21:6</note>, and it is written "a fiery serpent" <note>original: *nachash saraf*</note>. Their root is the Serpent. And because Moses knew the root, the source, and the foundation of that place, he made a serpent. And it was said of him: Why? Because Israel sinned with their tongues, as it is written: **"And the people spoke against God and against Moses"** <note>Numbers 21:5</note>. Therefore, "the Lord sent fiery serpents among the people." And Moses only went after the root, and he made a serpent out of copper, in the same manner that was required for it, for its place is Copper. And the Female <note>The Shekhinah/Divine Presence</note> did not tell him from what it should be made, but Moses looked and made it from copper as was required for its place above all, as it is written: **"And Moses made a copper serpent and set it upon a pole."** What is "upon a pole" <note>original: *al ha-nes*</note>? Upon that hint which is above. And we have learned: in every place where there is a serpent, it follows the spirit to provide strength, explanation, and clarity, to find the bodies in its own color. And the "Woman of Valor" <note>Proverbs 31</note> could not—that sign and its living creature is the "lap" <note>original: *cheyk*</note>, and the letter *He* (ה). And so she appeared as a woman, and the clarity of that hint and what belongs to her is in that manner. And it was not prepared to be in her lordship; the letter *Qof* (ק) and her living creature *Chet* (ח) were strengthened by the repair of the letter *He* (ה), in the likeness of an ape <note>original: *kofa*</note> among all human beings, which follows after human beings. And it was not prepared to do so except in the way Moses made that serpent, upon that hint, to repair it and to always be prepared to weaken [the evil]. Therefore, it was received and broken from the bite of the goats, which is the place of the dwelling, like the dwelling above.
