## Pekudei

->**Pekudei**<-
<note>The title of the Torah portion, meaning "Accountings" or "Records."</note>

**These** are the accountings of the Tabernacle, the Tabernacle of Testimony. Why "Testimony"? Rather, the word "Tabernacle" is written here twice: one for the above <note>the celestial realm</note> and one for the below <note>the physical world</note>. And the "Tabernacle of Testimony" is one. What is this "Testimony"? As you have said <note>Psalm 122:4</note>: **The tribes of Yah, a testimony for Israel.** This Name <note>Yah</note> is itself a testimony for Israel. In this same manner <note>Psalm 81:6</note>: **He ordained it as a testimony in Joseph.** Testimony is a witness and a source of permanence; certainly, these "Testimony" are the two Tablets of Testimony, a witness at all times, and here it is a Testimony. Because of this, the Tabernacle of Testimony is found to be a witness. And upon this, glory is found upon the holy spirit that surrounds it. And this is what is written: "And my redemption," which is the Root as mentioned. It is a place of hiddenness and concealment for all. "Which was counted at the mouth of Moses"—until now I did not know if "counted" was found to be a testimony or not. Rather, "counted" is certainly a testimony. For from the day the Patriarchs departed from the world, and all those tribes, the sons of Jacob, and Israel was left in exile <margin>Chapter 3, Page...</margin> in the refinement of troubles below, the gathering and knowledge of the spirit of the Holy Name was upon them; this is the Name of Testimony, of the permanence of the hiddenness and the land, for those two Tablets established the upper and lower worlds and all sides of the world. Once it reached below, it was "counted" <note>or "remembered"</note> and this Name was mentioned in the world. For everything that was in the Book immediately gave birth to the Name <margin>The Father of this</margin> as it is written <note>Exodus 3:13</note>: **And they shall say to me, "What is His name?" What shall I say to them?** And there, this Name was counted/appointed by the mouth of Moses. <margin>As it is said</margin> "The service of the Levites." What is the service of the Levites? Rather, this spirit of which it is written <note>Numbers 18:23</note>: **But the Levite, he shall perform the service.** "He" refers to the spirit of the Holy Name which is called "The Levite" and is not called so elsewhere. And because of this, it is certainly the "service of the Levites." Another interpretation: the service of the Levites refers to those who are masters <note>of song/burden</note> found carrying upon their shoulders, as it is written <note>Numbers 7:9</note>: **But to the sons of Kohath he gave none, because the service of the sanctuary belonged to them; they bore it on their shoulders.** <margin>Rabbi P. M. T.</margin>

**These** are the accountings of the Tabernacle, the Tabernacle of Testimony, etc. Rabbi Isaac opened <note>Isaiah 11:10</note>: **And it shall come to pass in that day, that the root of Jesse, etc.** "And it shall come to pass in that day"—in the manner that they established that the Holy One, blessed be He, will bring peace into the world, and the Root of the Tree of Life will be established; from that Root, the other roots below will be sustained, and all of them will take root and be sustained from it. **Which shall stand as a banner for the peoples.** For He is the permanence of all, and the spirit of the Holy Name descends. **To him shall the nations seek.** There is the spirit of the permanence of the Holy Name, and because of this, "to him shall the nations seek." As you have said <note>Isaiah 2:3</note>: **And many peoples shall go and say, "Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, etc."** And regarding this, "to him shall the nations seek." **And his resting place shall be glorious.** "His resting place" refers to the Sanctuary of Glory, for so it is called as they established, and from the power of Glory of which it is written <note>Isaiah 30:26</note>: **And the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold.** <margin>Another version</margin> And his resting place—that Root shall take the crowns of the Glory of the Lord, which shall not be erased and shall not stand in the [ordinary] measure of the world <margin>Rabbi M.</margin> [who] strikes the reason. Because everything that stands in this measure, the blessings of our God dwell there. And blessings dwell [only] where there is no [human] measure. As in the former time, it stood in the measure as it is written: "These are the accountings of the Tabernacle." You find that this stood in a measure. And because of this, it was necessary to count below so that blessings would dwell upon it, as it is written <note>Exodus 39:43</note>: **And Moses blessed them.** And what blessing did he bless them with? "May it be the [Divine] Will that the blessing rests upon the work of your hands." And blessings do not rest upon these accounts until Moses bound it above, as it is written: "These are the accountings of the Tabernacle, the Tabernacle of Testimony, which was counted at the mouth of Moses." For if the thought had not been enslaved <note>dedicated</note> by the hand of Moses, they would not have been able to make the accounting, as it is written: "which was counted at the mouth of Moses." He opened and said <note>1 Kings 17:9</note>: **Arise, go to Zarephath... behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain you.** Did the Holy One, blessed be He, not command her? Rather, until the prophet saw her, the Holy One, blessed be He, commanded by His decree above regarding those who are guarantors to bring sustenance to those, and He appointed below to give him sustenance, as it is written: "And she said."

<meta>This page continues the mystical commentary on the Torah portion Pekudei (Accountings), focusing on the spiritual construction of the Tabernacle. It connects the physical labor of the artisans to the divine emanations (Sefirot).</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

And come and see, "What is the Lord your God" <note>original: "Mah Hashem Elohecha"</note>—Heaven forbid—but rather "if salt" <note>original: "im melach"</note>, just as the flour, whenever it descends, etc.
And here it is from the secret of that flour which had nothing in it but salt; when the flour is like this, it is its bitterness, and it appears that blessings of light and holiness do not dwell within it. As it is said, what is written? "For thus says the Lord, the God of Israel: The jar of flour shall not be exhausted and the jug of oil shall not fail until the day the Lord sends rain." <note>I Kings 17:14-16</note> Come and see, what is the reason? Because the entire generation was not found to have a matter that would merit them, and they were all below. And regarding this it is written, "You give truth" <note>Micah 7:20</note> and "He gives rain upon the world" because merit was abundant. And it is written, "The jar of flour was not exhausted and the jug of oil did not fail, according to the word of the Lord which He spoke by the hand of Elijah." <note>I Kings 17:16</note> And "if it is" <note>im</note> refers to the flour that stands in the "Arm" <note>the Sefirah of Gevurah/Strength</note> which was salt; when the jar of flour did not cease from its blessings, it was because of the word that is written: "The jar of flour shall not be exhausted." And it is written of the Tabernacle of Testimony <note>Mishkan HaEdut</note> that even though it stands in accounting <note>calculation/number</note>, we have learned that he appointed <note>the word 'Pekudei' implies both counting and appointing</note> over the lower moon <note>the Shekhinah</note> at every time that blessings dwell in it. And regarding this it is written: "These are the accounts of the Tabernacle, the Tabernacle of the Testimony, as they were counted at the bidding of Moses."

**These** are the accounts of the Tabernacle. Rabbi Hezekiah opened and said: "Do not come closer; take your sandals off your feet, etc." <note>Exodus 3:5</note> This verse has been established by the colleagues, but come and see: they established that the Holy One separated him from below because he was found with the Divine Presence <note><term>Shekhinah: the feminine, indwelling aspect of God</term></note>, as it is written: "For the place where you are standing is holy ground." "Holy ground" refers to the Shekhinah, who is called "Holy," who is attached to the "Staff" <note>the masculine principle</note> above. And when the Holy One, blessed be He, bound him to His Shekhinah, then the Great Appointee was placed over the House, and he decrees and appoints and acts, as it is written: "And the earth opened its mouth, etc." <note>Numbers 16:30</note> and it is written: "And it was, as he finished speaking... the ground split." <note>Numbers 16:31</note> And it is written: "Rise up, O Lord... Return, O Lord." <note>Numbers 10:35-36</note> What is the reason it is written "at the bidding of Moses"? By the mouth of Moses all the accounts of the Tabernacle were prepared and appointed, because he stood as the appointee over the lower moon, as it is written: "I have surely remembered <note>original: 'Pakod Pakadeti'—using the same root as 'Pekudei'</note> you." <note>Exodus 3:16</note> And he gave a voice to bring forth that male principle and draw down the appointment to go out from the Garden, and the side that was appointed to find holiness from above to below, as it is said: "And let them make Me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them." <note>Exodus 25:8</note>

**And Bezalel** son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, etc. <note>Exodus 38:22</note> Rabbi Judah said: Come and see, it has been said that Bezalel was from the side of the Right <note><term>Chesed: the attribute of Lovingkindness</term></note>, and they prepared the preparation of everything. Furthermore, behold Judah is the ruler and king over all the other tribes, and from him came the one who prepared the entire Tabernacle, as they established in every gift. He is Bezalel, who is the Right, and furthermore, from this side he prepared everything and inherited <term>Wisdom</term> <note>Hokhmah</note> to perform all the work. And furthermore, he was joined by Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan—this one is from the side of the Left <note><term>Gevurah: the attribute of Judgment/Strength</term></note>, which is the side of harsh judgment. And the colleagues established that from these two sides the Tabernacle was made, to be prepared in all things and to be bound together, to place a balance between the Right and the Left. And it was all said and established. He opened and said: "Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, in the far north, the city of the great King." <note>Psalms 48:3</note> Come and see, the entire path of holiness of the world proceeds: one precious Wisdom <note>Hokhmah</note> from beneath the precious Throne, and it goes out until the abyss. And the head of the holy Wisdom is in fifty abysses, and the other head is above. And that other supernal head is a single supernal <term>Point</term> <note>Nekudah: a reference to the concentrated beginning of creation</term> that stands in the Thought of the world. And from there the world spreads to the Right and the Left, and is sustained by that middle point. And that Wisdom is called "Tanya," from which the world was planted in all directions. Furthermore, you have opened with "Yah" <note>the first two letters of the Divine Name</note>; the Holy One, blessed be He, set it as the foundation and the secret of the world and the hiddenness of everything in all colors.

<meta>This page continues the mystical discourse on the Tabernacle (Mishkan) from the Zohar, Parashat Pekudei. It focuses on the relationship between the central "Point" of creation and the physical structures of the Temple and the world.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

-> Pekudei <-
<note>The title of the Torah portion: "Accounts of"</note>

Colors for the expansion of the Will from the Chariot <term>Chariot: Merkabah, the divine vehicle or structure of the spiritual realms</term> of that Point. In the first expansion, like the color of that Point, all light and purity that exists below stood there and was there. And this stands above all the earth from the Chariot of that Point. In the second expansion from the Chariot of that first expansion, there was light and purity and radiance like that first one, but it was thinner and took on the light of the dust more than any other dust. In the third expansion, it was dark and took on more dust than all of them, and from the Chariot of this one, the spirits stand to sustain all the world below. It is found that that Point stands in the middle, and all the colors of the expansion of the world are in its Chariot.

The first expansion was the Holy Temple and all those insights and fruits and all its arrangement: Jerusalem and every city and fortress and garden. The second expansion was all the Land of Israel, which is sanctified with holiness. The third expansion was all the rest of the lands of other nations, which are found to be for the sustenance of the priests of all of them <note>original: "chamra," likely referring to the external forces or "husks" that sustain the nations</note>. And this is the secret of the colors of the eye that surround that Point in the center of the eye, which is the life of the whole eye. Just as that Point in the center, which we said is the life of everything, and there stands the House of the Holy of Holies and the Ark-Cover <term>Kapporet: the gold lid of the Ark of the Covenant</term> which are the life of everything. It is found that this Point is the life of the whole world, and regarding this it is written: 
> "Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion..." <note>Psalm 48:3</note> 
"Beautiful" refers to that life and refinement of everything. "Elevation" <note>original: "Nof," also meaning branch</note> is the branch of the tree that was the beauty of everything.

Come and see: the beauty of the world and the life of the world were not established in the world until they dwelt and were established in the Tabernacle. From 그 moment, the life of everything was established and the world was repaired. And see, that Tabernacle moved until it reached that Point which was "beautiful in elevation," the refinement of everything. Once they reached there, then He opened to the Spirit and said: 
> "This is My resting place forever; here I will dwell, for I have desired it." <note>Psalm 132:14</note> 
Rabbi Yose said: The Assembly of Israel <term>Knesset Yisrael: the Shekhinah or Divine Presence</term> said this verse to Him at the time the Holy Temple was completed and the Spirit ascended beneath it. Rabbi Hezekiah said: The Holy One, Blessed Be He, said it concerning the Assembly of Israel when Israel does His will. For then the Holy One, Blessed Be He, sits upon His throne of glory and stands over the world, and blessing, peace, and love for all are found, and redemption. He says, "This is My resting place forever."

And come and see: at the time when all the craftsmen gathered to do the craftsmanship, that which was truly in the power of their labor was completed on its own. How could they labor and the work be completed? It was truly from the Whole, as it is written: 
> "Thus all the work of the Tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting was finished." <note>Exodus 39:32</note> 
In this same manner: 
> "And the heavens and the earth were finished." <note>Genesis 2:1</note> 
And you might say: 
> "And on the seventh day God finished..." <note>Genesis 2:2</note> 
And so it is, for all the world—even though all the works were finished individually—the world as a whole was not complete in its existence until the seventh day arrived. For when the seventh day arrived, then all the works were completed, and the Holy One, Blessed Be He, was revealed in it to the whole world. "And on the seventh day God finished His work which He had made." In this way, all the work He did was completed in its existence. And regarding this: "And on the seventh day God finished."

And so it was in the completion of the Holy Temple: all the work that was done was done on its own. The craftsmen labored, and the work appeared to them to be done, but it was completed before them; it completed itself on its own. And they have already established this, as it is written: 
> "And the house, when it was in the building..." <note>1 Kings 6:7</note> 
Regarding the House of Solomon, it does not say "Rabbi Banaiah <note>The builder</note> built it," but rather "when it was in the building," for it was completed on its own. Indeed, Solomon spent the money. "He built it" is not written, but rather "with money"—it was built from itself. And so, in every work that was holy, it was completed on its own.

## Main Text (Zohar)

->**And Bezalel**<-
son of Uri, son of Hur: This verse is a teaching of the Holy Spirit <note>original: *Ruach HaKodesh*</note> to proclaim him before the eyes of all Israel, to see that he—the son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah—performed all that the Lord commanded Moses. "And with him was Oholiab, son of Ahisamach": Why does it say "and with him"? It is a teaching that the Holy One, blessed be He, does not perform work alone, but rather with Bezalel, and with him He performed all that was done. And behold, "and with him"—he was not alone. From here we learn that the Left should always be included within the Right. Regarding this it is written <note>Exodus 31:6</note> **"And I, behold, I have appointed with him Oholiab"**; this one represents the Right and that one represents the Left <note>In Kabbalistic thought, Bezalel (Judah/Right/Mercy) and Oholiab (Dan/Left/Judgment) must work in balance</note>.

->**These**<-
are the accounts of the Tabernacle, the Tabernacle of the Testimony, as they were counted according to the commandment of Moses, etc. Rabbi Yose said: Since all the wise-hearted had completed the Tabernacle, it was necessary to return an accounting of all they had done and all the labors performed therein. What is the reason? Because whenever an accounting and a numbering is performed, a "visitation" <note>The word *Pekudei* means both "accounts" and "visitation/remembrance"</note> occurs, and thus that work is sustained and everything is established in its proper repair. And all of Israel, just as they were willing in their hearts at the beginning <note>when donating materials</note>, so too were they willing during this accounting. Then all the work was established in holy will, and therefore an accounting was needed here, for through this the work is sustained. However, it is written "These" and not "And these," to show that this accounting nullifies all other worldly accountings; this one is sustained more than all of them, for through this the Tabernacle was sustained and not through any other.

He opened and said: <note>Isaiah 33:6</note> >And the stability of your times shall be a hoard of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge; the fear of the Lord is His treasure.< The companions have already established the meaning of this verse. But we have learned: every person who occupies himself with the Torah in this world and merits to "fix times" for it, must—out of the desire of his will—aim toward the Holy One, blessed be He; he must aim for the sake of Heaven, for the desire should be directed there. "A hoard of salvation" refers to including Mercy within Judgment. "Wisdom and knowledge" refer to these two which flow one into the other; this one is hidden and concealed to bestow upon the other. "And the fear of the Lord is His treasure": this is the treasury for all of them, because it holds all those vessels and the radiance of the work that was made into a treasury for them all. And when all those hidden things emerge from it, they all emerge by count. How do we know this? As it is written <note>Song of Songs 7:5</note> >Your eyes are like the pools in Heshbon<—certainly "by account" <note>A wordplay on *Heshbon*, the city, and *heshbon*, meaning "account/calculation"</note> He acts, and He brings forth those blessings from the hidden place to bring everything out by count. Therefore it is called "Faith" <note>original: *Emunah*</note>. Everything is called Faith, and this has been established. And if here, in this world, such faithfulness is required to illuminate the matters of the world, how much more so in the higher realms. Therefore, the Holy One, blessed be He, made known to all Israel the spirit of their faithfulness in everything they did, and all was declared.

Rabbi Yose and Rabbi Isaac were walking on the road. Rabbi Yose said: Certainly the Holy One, blessed be He, was pleased with Bezalel for the work of the Tabernacle more than all of Israel. Why? He said to him: Come and see, and take wisdom: because the Holy One, blessed be He, placed a support on the earth to be crowned like the one above, and to perform work in the world like the work above, for it lacked nothing of the sixty-six names <note>A mystical reference to the divine names governing the structure of reality</note>. He said to him: A spirit of strength is here. Judah was from the side of the Left, but he turned and cleaved to the Right. Therefore, on this side, the Tabernacle was made. Rabbi Yose said: From the side of the Left he cleaved to the side of the Right, and afterwards they were included one in the other, and everything became Right. In this same manner, the Torah circles from the side of the Left and cleaves to the Right, and they are included one in the other, and everything becomes Right. The Merciful One <note>God</note> flows from the Right and inclines to the Left, and all the other tribes are with Him as a support, for they circle from the Right and incline to the Left. Judah flows from the Left and inclines to the Right. He flows from the Left because he comes from the side of the Left, but he cleaves to the Right. Therefore, they all followed him in making the Tabernacle, and it was prepared through him. It has been established that the Holy One, blessed be He, was pleased with him and chose him from all of them for the work.

<meta>This page continues the discourse on the Torah portion of Pekudei, focusing on the mystical interpretation of the Tabernacle's construction and the spiritual nature of the metals used. It transitions from a discussion on Moses' actions in Egypt to the symbolic meanings of gold and silver.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

->**Pekudei (Accounts)**<-

And the eye of faith <note>original: *mehemanuta*</note> is seen in the vision of this world and like the vision of the world to come. And the radiance of beauty emerges from the spirit of faith, as it is written <note>Psalms 72:16</note> *and they shall blossom out of the city.* And it is written <note>Isaiah 26:1</note> *God has not destroyed the city.*

**And he looked this way and that:** <note>Exodus 2:12, referring to Moses in Egypt</note> He looked backward to see if there was any turning back <note>repentance</note> or where it might lead.
**And he saw that there was no man:** He looked into them to see if any righteous person was destined to emerge from them who could bring comfort.
**And he saw that there was no man:** The sages established that when there is no one to atone for sin, then immediately **he buried him in the sand** <note>Exodus 2:12</note> and the spirit shall be according to this verse.
**And he looked this way and that:** He saw them and they were punished for their deeds and turned to filth. Then **he turned to Aaron** <note>Numbers 12:11</note> to be turned away from his youth; everything was turned away from their punishment.
**And he saw that there was no man:** For they were destined later to do many evil things in Israel.
**And he turned to Aaron:** Everything was turned away from the "tongs." What are the "tongs"? The distance from the Divine Presence <note>original: *Shekhinah*</note>. Everything was turned, **and he turned to Aaron** to look away from the back of the Divine Presence, and they all descended. For just as there is a curse upon the atonement of their sins, they were found to be bread for them, immediately **and he cursed them in the name of the Lord.** <note>2 Kings 2:24</note> **And the bears came out of the forest.** <note>referring to the story of Elisha</note> They were crushed and broken, for he was angry with them. What is "crushed and broken"? Their wealth and their kin were humbled. And it struck the wicked and the pure and the scoffers. This was established as corresponding to the sacrifices of Balak.

**And the gold of the wave offering was:** <note>Exodus 38:24</note> See and investigate: it says "the wave offering" <note>original: *tenufah*</note> but it does not investigate "the silver of the wave offering" in the same way. Rather, there are two that are investigated thus: "the gold of the wave offering" and "the copper of the wave offering." Why are they investigated this way? Because it is meant to be elevated upward, for there is such a thing below. **And the gold was** like the manner of an elevation <note>original: *charimuta*</note>, and in every place "wave offering" refers to an elevation above and not a descent below. And there is a spirit found in all those levels <note>original: *dargin*</note> and chariots, all of them standing in this elevation. "And the gold was an elevation," and this is the principle of everything: whatever spreads downward, its vision, goodness, and desire are hidden. And when it is in a state of elevation, then it is "good gold" because of its masculine aspects. And everything below is the refuse of that "gold of the wave offering."

**And the silver of the accounts of the congregation:** <note>Exodus 38:25</note> Because this is everything that spreads downward, it is equally good, even though it is not like this elevation. The principle of everything is that whatever spreads downward can spread toward good or toward evil. Therefore, that [the gold] needs to be set apart as an elevation and to ascend above. But this [the silver] needs to spread below and to all sides because all of it is taken for good. He opened and said <note>Psalms 84:12</note> **For the Lord God is a sun and a shield etc.** "Sun" refers to the Holy One, Blessed be He, and "shield" refers to the Holy One, Blessed be He. "Sun" is the spirit of the Holy Name that dwells here, where all the inner levels stand. And "shield" is the spirit of the holy covering that investigates peace, and this spirit is as it is written <note>Psalms 84:12</note> *the wise are a shield to you,* and a throne and a shield—this is the spirit of the Perfect Name. **Grace and glory the Lord will give:** to those who are counted as one spirit. **No good thing will He withhold from those who walk uprightly:** This refers to the spirit of which it is written <note>Job 38:15</note> *And from the wicked their light is withheld.* And this is like the Primordial Light <note>original: *nehor kadmita*</note> that the Holy One, Blessed be He, hid and concealed, as the sages established. And from the beginning He hid it and withheld it in this world and in the world to come for the righteous. What is written? *He will not withhold good from those who walk uprightly.* This is the Primordial Light of which it is written <note>Genesis 1:4</note> **And God saw the light, that it was good.** And because of this, it does not need to be elevated and raised up [like the gold], but rather to spread and be revealed, unlike the other which is hidden. And for this reason, they investigate that wave offering and the hidden vision. And therefore: **And the silver of the accounts of the congregation was a hundred talents, etc.** <note>Exodus 38:25</note> Come and see: the right side <note>associated with Silver/Mercy</note> is always standing to sustain the whole world and to be blessed and to bless.

<meta>This page continues the mystical commentary on Parashat Pekudei from the Zohar. The previous context likely dealt with the construction of the Tabernacle and the counting of the Israelites. Here, the focus shifts to the spiritual mechanics of the Priestly Blessing and why the census silver was immune to the "Evil Eye."</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

And to bless Him; and when the Priest, who is from the **Right side** <note>The side of Chesed/Mercy</note>, is always prepared to bless the people. For from the Right side come all the blessings of the world. And the Priest lifts his hands <note>original: "krisih" - likely a variant for "kappav" (palms)</note>, and because of this, he is appointed to bless above and below. Come and see: at the time the Priest spreads his hands to bless the people, the **Shekhinah** <note>The Divine Presence</note> comes and rests upon him. He sees his hands and pushes from the Right side, raising it above the left hand, in order to elevate the Right over the Left. Because of this, all the levels that the Priest spreads his hands over are all blessed from the **Source of All**. And who is the Source of All? This is the **Righteous One** <note>The sefirah of Yesod, the foundation</note>. The Source of All is the life of the World to Come, the source for all thousands and tens of thousands of lights from there; for it is the wellspring and the source of all, and all the lamps and lights below are kindled in this manner. The source and wellspring of all, all the strengths of the lamps below, are all illuminated and filled with light from it. And this stands corresponding to that. And for this reason, at the time the Priest spreads his hands and turns to bless the people, then blessings flow <note>original: "tardan" - flow/draw</note> from the Supernal Source to kindle the lamps and to illuminate all faces <note>original: "agpayin" - likely "anpin" (faces)</note>. And the **Assembly of Israel** <note>Knesset Yisrael/Malchut</note> is crowned with supernal crowns, and all those blessings flow and are found from above to below.

Come and see: "The staff of the accounting" <note>referring to the census</note>, and all this is done to be entirely within the **Mystery of the Body**. The completion of the Body is the **Sign of the Holy Covenant** <note>Brit Milah</note>, to be bound <note>original: "itkanpa" - to be tied/connected</note> to life and the bond of Unity as is fitting. And everything is done within the Mystery of the Right. And because of this, in every place where the Right side is found, the **Evil Eye** <note>Ayin Bisha</note> has no power over it. And for this reason: *“And the silver of those who were numbered of the congregation”* <note>Exodus 38:25</note>—because that silver comes from the Right side, and therefore the counting was not considered a finished tally <note>original: "kmekhincha" - in a count that brings a plague</note>.

Rabbi Isaac asked Rabbi Simeon, saying to him: "Behold, they have established that a blessing does not rest upon a thing that is measured and stands as a measurement, or on a thing that stands in a count. Here, it seems they were counted as a total!" He said to him: "Behold, it has been said that any place where the side of **Holiness** rests, even if that count comes from the side of Holiness, a blessing rests upon it always and is never removed from it. From where do we know this? From the **Tithe** <note>Ma'aser</note>. Because it comes from a count for Holiness, a blessing is found in it as long as the vision of Holiness is found and shines from the side of the Holy. But all other matters of the world that do not come from the side of Holiness, a blessing does not rest upon them once they are in a count, because the 'Other Side' <note>Sitra Achra/Evil</note> and the vision of the Evil Eye can have power over them. And since it can have power over them, a blessing is not found there. But because it was from the side of Holiness, and the counting of Holiness, and the **Tabernacle** <note>Mishkan</note> of Holiness, blessings were always increased in it."

And therefore: *“And the silver of those who were numbered of the congregation”*—the numbering of the congregation was for the vision of the count, in a way that was unlike any other counting, for blessings from above surrounded them. And come and see: the **Seed of Joseph** is not ruled by the Evil Eye because he comes from the Right side. And for this reason, the counting was not done by a [direct] tally <note>original: "bnlehl" - by number/head</note>, for he labored in the Mystery of Joseph, which is the vision of the Spirit of the Holy Covenant. And because of this: *“And the silver of those who were numbered of the congregation”*—and that calculation is the dwelling place of the levels of blessings appointed to be found from the Right side. And about this it is written: *“Once God has spoken...”* <note>Psalm 62:12</note>.

Rabbi Hiyya, Rabbi Aha, and Rabbi Yose were walking from the desert to Naphori. While they were walking, they saw Rabbi Eleazar coming, and Rabbi Hiyya was with him. Rabbi Aha said: "Surely now the arrangements of the **Shekhinah** are here!" They waited for them until they reached them. Once they reached them, Rabbi Eleazar said: "Surely it is written: *'The eyes of the Lord are toward the righteous, and His ears toward their cry'* <note>Psalm 34:16</note>. This verse is difficult for me, because regarding the providence <note>original: "asnachuta" - supervision/providence</note> of the Holy One, blessed be He, over them—it is not found for them in this world! For we see how many righteous people are in this world, and even basic sustenance they are not able...

<meta>This page continues the discussion of the spiritual mechanics of the Tabernacle and the people of Israel from the previous section of Parashat Pekudei. It focuses on the metaphysical protection afforded to Israel through their connection to holiness.</meta>

# Pekudei

## Main Text (The Zohar)

To be cleaved <note>original: *le-adbaka*; referring to the soul's attachment to the Divine</note>. See here, what is the meaning of the affliction of all these righteous ones? These are the spirits here. Come and see: all the creatures of the world are known above, whether from the side of the Torah or from the "Other Side" <note>original: *Sitra Achra*; the realm of spiritual impurity or evil</note>. Those who belong to the side of holiness are known above for good, and it is known what is said from the [Supernal] Side concerning them. Those who belong to the side of impurity are known as strangers, and his [the Sitra Achra's] mark is always upon them. And in the place where that [holiness] rules, it is known that the side of holiness is not ruled over by the Other Side; it shall never approach him, nor can it see any evil thing in him, just as a physician acts. And concerning this: *The eyes of the Lord are toward the righteous...* <note>Psalm 34:16</note> because the Other Side cannot rule over him. *And His ears are open to their cry*—for their voice is heard, and all good recognition from above is here, and no "Other Side" or evil word can rule over them.

Rabbi Eleazar said: We have learned that in every place where the side of holiness dwells, even though it stands within Thought <note>original: *Machshavah*; a high level of divine emanation/consciousness</note>, blessing is not withheld from there. Rabbi Eleazar said: Certainly it is so. But come and see: they are "Holy" and they come from the side of Holiness, as it is written: *Israel is holy to the Lord* <note>Jeremiah 2:3</note> and it is written: *You shall be holy, for I the Lord am holy* <note>Leviticus 19:2</note>. See, when David applied "thought" <note>i.e., a census or calculation</note> to Israel, he [the Accuser] became envious of them and they were struck, as it is written: *So the Lord sent a pestilence upon Israel from the morning even to the time appointed* <note>2 Samuel 24:15</note>. He said to him: Because he did not take from them a ransom <note>original: *purkana*; a redemption or atonement payment</note>, as it is written: *Then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul... that there be no plague among them when you number them* <note>Exodus 30:12</note>. This is because "Holy"—which refers to the Priests—is required to give the ransom of holiness, and because the ransom of holiness was not taken from them [in David's time, the plague occurred]. Come and see: Israel is "Holy," standing without a numerical count of their own, and for this, the ransom of Michael <note>The Archangel Michael, protector of Israel</note> is required. He raises the ransom that stands in Thought, for they [Israel] do not stand in [human] thought. What is the reason? Because "Holy" is the supernal secret of all levels; just as that Holiness rises above all, it descends to the "Outer Holiness" below which stands beneath it and exists in Thought and measure. So too, Israel are "Holy," as it is written: *Israel is holy to the Lord*, and they give the ransom of the tongue <note>referring to the spoken word or prayer</note> which stands in Thought, and this spirit is Israel, those who stand for us. Another ransom stands outside and rises to Thought, and they go one above the other.

And they go. Rabbi Eleazar opened and said: *Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered...* <note>Hosea 2:1</note>. What is the meaning of "as the sand of the sea"? There are two aspects here: "as the sand of the sea" because when the waves of the sea rise in foam and anger, and those waves rise to wash over the world, as soon as they reach and see the sand of the sea <note>original: *chola de-yama*</note>, they immediately subside and are broken, returning backward and being humbled; they are unable to wash over and flood the world. Because of this, Israel is the "sand of the sea." When the waves of the sea—those masters of anger, those harsh levels—seek to wash over and flood the world, they see Israel, who are bound to the Holy One, Blessed be He, and they subside and are broken before them, unable to rule over the world. Another aspect: just as the sand of the sea has no count and does not stand in [human] thought, so too Israel have no count and do not stand in thought. Not by measurement and not by thought, as it is written: *which cannot be measured nor numbered*. Come and see: there is a measurement that remains hidden and concealed, and there is a count that stands in a hidden, secret place, and it stands as a measurement and it stands in Thought. This is the Spirit and the sustenance of all above and below, for this measurement is never known—upon what the Spirit of that measurement stands. And upon what does the Spirit of that measurement stand? This is the Spirit of Faith of all. And Israel below do not stand in [human] calculation/thought, but rather on the side of the "Other Word" of the ransom that stands in [Divine] Thought. And because of this, when Israel enter into a count [they require the ransom].

<summary>This passage explains that Israel's holiness protects them from the "Other Side" and compares them to the sand of the sea, which acts as a boundary against the "waves" of divine judgment. It also discusses the spiritual danger of counting Israel without a ritual ransom, as human calculation interferes with their status in the realm of Divine Thought.</summary>

## Main Text (Zohar)

In the accounting, everything is directed toward redemption, as we have said. And because of this, in the days of David, when he conducted an accounting <note>a census</note> of Israel and there was no redemption <note>atonement money</note> taken from them, there was wrath, and the camps were divided into many forces and many guards. And for this reason, it is written regarding the act of accounting: **"Everyone who passes among those who are numbered..."** and **"The silver of those numbered of the congregation... for everyone who passes among those who are numbered."** <note>Exodus 30:13-14</note> And all of them were numbered for the work of the Tabernacle, and not to establish crowns from this accounting. This is a new kind of counting. Because there is no redemption upon them to raise them to the Supernal Accounting, and even others who rise to a different thought. This one is above and that one is below. And for this reason it is written: **"Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab..."** <note>1 Chronicles 21:4 / 2 Samuel 24:4</note> and it is written: **"And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people to the king: and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword; and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men."** <note>2 Samuel 24:9</note>

Because in the Sanctuary and the light of the Tabernacle, he saw that the work was to be established exactly, and the cup of measure was filled from their light. Then others of whom it is said—Heaven forbid—"the house shall not be covered," etc. This is the secret of what is written: **"Make haste, my beloved"** <note>Song of Songs 8:14; original: "Berach Dodi"</note> and the portion of the Holy One, Blessed be He, fled and was established in a supernal place with everything needed for that house. In the end, they labored for coins, etc. And these are the spirits of life like moons that go out and enter, all of them like this house, to establish it with all that is needed. And even though all of them stood below to be established to make a repair, and pushed—Heaven forbid—the life-force of the supernal world to be established and to conceive the house as is fitting; and those thorns to strike that "weasel" <note>a metaphor for a destructive force or impurity</note> which the life-force made and established. Heaven forbid it should be said again, as it is written: **"The eyes of the Lord your God are always upon it, from the beginning of the year even unto the end of the year"** <note>Deuteronomy 11:12</note> and they established it. And in this accounting, life is exempt on all sides.

And even though it is written: **"Behold his bed, which is Solomon's; threescore valiant men are about it, of the valiant of Israel. They all hold swords, being expert in war: every man hath his sword upon his thigh because of fear in the night."** <note>Song of Songs 3:7-8</note> This is the fear of Gehenna <note>Purgatory/Hell</note> which stands opposite it in order to push it away. And because of this, they all surround it.

And even though they all stand in the likeness of the Thought that is not known. And then, this is like that Thought which is not known, in the likeness of a curtain, and they shine as one and are made into nine "intelligences" <note>original: *sochletanu*</note> that contemplate those lights. These are the spirits and these are the visions, and there is no one who can stand within them. The Will <note>original: *re'uta*</note> of all nine lights that stand, all of them like a pressed Thought, one directed in the accounting of all of them to pursue—Heaven forbid—those who err, who stand like Thought but do not cleave and are not known. These do not stand in Will nor in the Supernal Thought. They grasp it, yet do not grasp it. All of them stand in all the secrets of faith, and all those lights from the secret of the Supernal and Lower Thought, all of them search the shore of the end.

Until here the lights reached, yet did not reach, and were not known. Here is Thought but not Will. When Thought shines and is not known from what it shines, then it is clothed and hidden within a precious longing for that which shines. And above this, then, until they are all included as one and established. And in the secret of the sacrifice, when everything ascends and is bound one to another, and this longs for that, then they all stand in ascent, and Thought is crowned in the <term>Ein Sof</term> <note>The Infinite; the primordial, unknowable aspect of God before emanation</note>. That light which shines from within the Supernal Thought is called <term>Ein Sof</term>. Once it shines and forces spread out from it, that Thought—it is written: **"and its stones, and he knew not"**—and from there the spreading spreads to all sides. And one spreading of life spreads from it, which is the Supernal World that does not stand in accounting, and it is called <term>Supernal Thought</term> <note>original: *Machshava Ila'ah*</note>. And they established what they searched out, as it is written: **"Lift up your eyes on high, and behold who hath created these."** <note>Isaiah 40:26</note> The "Who" <note>Hebrew: *Mi*</note> is the one who created "These" <note>Hebrew: *Elech*</note>. Afterward it spreads and becomes the secret of the end of all levels of life below, and from there and further to enter below. And everything is made in that same likeness of what is above.

<meta>This page continues the mystical commentary on the Tabernacle (Pekudei). The previous sections likely dealt with the spiritual garments and the revelation at Sinai. This page specifically contrasts the state of the world during the Flood with the revelation at Sinai, and then transitions into a numerical and symbolic analysis of the silver "hooks" (Vavim) of the Tabernacle pillars.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

The "fragrance" <note>referring to a spiritual scent or essence</note> is the **Assembly of Israel**, because the Israelites said, "All that the Lord has spoken, we will do and we will obey" <note>Exodus 24:7</note>. "Their garments" <note>referring to a change in spiritual state</note> refers to the vision of the Supreme King and His majesty. Come and see: when the generation of the Flood brought destruction upon the world because they corrupted everything, the **Holy One, blessed be He**, said to Noah: "Go, hide yourself, so that you do not present yourself before the Destroyer <note>the angel of death/destruction</note>, so that he does not gain power over you," because there was no one to plead for mercy. One who is brought as an offering <note>referring to Noah's later sacrifice</note> causes the world to become sweetened <note>mitigated by mercy</note>. However, the world was not fully sweetened until Israel stood at Mount Sinai. Once Israel stood at Mount Sinai, the world was sweetened, and death was abolished from the world. The children of the holy priesthood were worthy to remove that Destroyer from the world. But all of Israel turned away at that time and made the Golden Calf. And then, what is written?
> And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments from Mount Horeb. (Exodus 33:6)
These "ornaments" were the secrets of the **Holy Name** with which the **Holy One, blessed be He**, had crowned them, and they were taken away from them. Then the Destroyer gained power over the world again, and it returned to its former state, where the Accuser rules the world and executes judgment. Rabbi Yose said: In the time of the Flood, who placed the Destroyer there? For it was the waters that prevailed! Come and see: there is no judgment in the world—even when the world is struck by judgment—where that Destroyer is not found among them, walking within the judgments found in the world. So too here, there was a Flood, but the Destroyer walked within the Flood, and that is the "vision" mentioned. For this reason, the **Holy One, blessed be He**, said to Noah: "Go and hide yourself," so that you are not seen in the world <note>by the Destroyer</note>.

->And come and see<-

Rabbi Yose said: The world was not settled, nor was the earth atoned for its sin, etc.

<note>The following small-print section contains cross-references and additional notes integrated into the text block.</note>

Regarding this, "Israel is a holy people," in the portion of *Pinchas* page 262 and 232, etc. The exchange of "garments" is mentioned both here and there on page 63b. The "female" <note>the moon/Shekhinah</note> was castrated <note>diminished</note> and darkened so as not to illuminate the world after it was written "and it was the month of Sivan," and Issachar served. And it has been said: He castrates many worlds, all the "waters." Come and see, Rabbi Eleazar said:
> And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five shekels he made hooks for the pillars. (Exodus 38:28)
To show that "hooks" <note>Hebrew: *vavim*</note> is written deficiently <note>missing a letter</note>, corresponding to the numerical value of the letter *Vav* <note>6</note>. Their heads were covered as it says here, and they were all of silver, and their heads were bound as it says here. This is because all "hooks" <note>the letter *Vav*</note> come from the **Side of Mercy**, and they were all found above in the calculation. Because they come from the Side of Mercy, they were engraved as hooks. And all the surroundings hang upon them, and there are no hooks that are not here, and the silver is as one. Therefore, all those engraved hooks were for those pillars. What are these "pillars"? As it is said, "and the pillars round about," etc. Because they were outside the main body <note>of the Tabernacle</note>, standing below. Come and see, Rabbi Isaac said: I do not know if this work was **Holy** or **Secular** <note>common/profane</note>, because it is written "and the thousand," and it is written elsewhere simply:
> The thousand is for you, Solomon. (Song of Songs 8:12)
Just as there "the thousand" is secular <note>referring to a literal number or a king</note>, so here perhaps it is secular? He said to him: It is not so! For the secular cannot be made into "hooks" <note>divine connectors</note>. Furthermore, there it is written "the thousand" and no more, but here it is written "the thousand seven hundred seventy and five." "The thousand" <note>on its own</note> is secular, as it is written "The thousand is for you, Solomon." And that is secular because the secular has no part in the **Side of Holiness** at all. The secular is from the **Other Side**, the **Impure**. Therefore, you must distinguish between the Holy and the Secular, because we are required to separate the Holy from the Secular. And the secret of the verse is this:
> To distinguish between the holy and the secular, and between the impure and the pure. (Leviticus 10:10)
And a servant <note>the "Other Side"</note> who is at the beginning has no portion from the Secular in the Holiness.

For example: >And the Lord [**ו**יי'] rained upon Sodom< <note>Genesis 19:24</note>. >And the Lord [**ו**יי'] said to Abram< <note>Genesis 13:14</note>—this is Mercy and a mystery as we have said. For why is it so frequent in the pattern that it is written *Elohim* <note>The name of God associated with Judgment; transcribed here as *Aldis* to avoid writing the holy name</note> in every place? Why is it not written as the Tetragrammaton [YHVH]? Rather, in every place, the Tetragrammaton [YHVH] refers to Him and His law court <note>Mercy tempered by judgment</note>. *Elohim* alone is Judgment by itself. However, when the Holy One executes judgment, it is not to overpower the world. And because of this, the bosom of the Chaldeans was mixed. But in the pattern, the whole world is like Sinai, and all those who are found in the world. And if you say: how deep is this, hidden from the eye so that it was not seen? And because of this, everything found in the world is sufficient for the Lord [YHVH] when it is revealed, and it is not seen without the *Aleph* houses etc., to be guarded, for behold, all is Sinai. And because of this, *Adonai* <note>The Name associated with the Shekhinah/Kingdom; transcribed here as *Ados*</note> is alone, and this is the mystery of the Lord [YHVH] for the assemblies. What is "it was good"? If the verse were not written, they would not be able to say "good, good" alone, for it did not come with the male principle. It is written here "good," and it is written there "only good," and this mystery is a holy curtain—it is hidden and revealed. It is revealed when the male principle is below. It is hidden in the place where all blessings go out from there. Because of this, all the words of a person that are in secrecy, blessings rest upon him. And all those that are like the conditions, that place of the male house rests upon it because it is a place of conditions. And everything is in the Supernal Spirit, in the likeness of that which is above. ## And the Copper...

**And the copper** of the offering was seventy talents <note>Exodus 38:29</note>. Rabbi Yehuda said: All of this descends below in the likeness of the supernal model, the Spirit of Faith. In this same manner, Nebuchadnezzar <note>the King of Babylon</note> acted out a specific detail, for he represents the "snake" <note>The Hebrew word for copper, *Nechoshet*, shares a root with *Nachash*, snake</note> of the lower realms. Rabbi Yose said: Did he not do this for all the Children of Israel? For so it was spoken to him in his dream: the head was of gold, and afterwards silver, and afterwards copper <note>Referring to the statue in Daniel 2, representing the succession of empires</note>. And if you say there was also iron and clay, look—those are not the same. Because those [iron and clay] are not meant to enter the Sanctuary, as they represent "Other Gods" <note>Idolatry or unholy forces</note>. 

And we find three colors prepared [in the Tabernacle], and in fear <note>or awe</note> there are four: blue, purple, scarlet wool, and fine linen—and also goats' hair. There are four rows of stones. Rabbi Yehuda said: From here, they are in threes. Some of them are in one group of four <note>referring to the four rows of stones on the High Priest's breastplate</note>, and from here in twos. For every single station and rank, it is three within three. There are three orders that are divided for every side of the four sides of the world. Every station that belongs to a side consists of three orders, as we have established. 

The first order, which is on the East side, consists of three orders; and these are nine orders in total, because every station has three orders within it, and thus they are found to be nine, just as those beneath them are. And so these nine orders are all gathered into the "marked dragons" <note>A mystical term for celestial currents or formations</note>. Every order gazes toward those hinted-at dragons, as we have established. And so it is for every station and order; they are all marked letters, and these have kings over them, standing one above the other. 

And when they are below, they fly through the air of that Spirit which rests upon them all; then they all move, as we have established. And there is one [letter/force] now from below, and through it there is an ascent and descent, and two "dragons" fly over them. And if this one from below ascends from the bottom to the top, it connects with them and they become three letters, all according to the "letters of the hands" which are three within the cupped palms of the Priest <note>A reference to the configuration of the fingers during the Priestly Blessing</note>. 

These are divided into three orders, and they are two letters, and that [third] one ascends and connects with them, and they become three. Come and see: the two higher letters ascend in whiteness, and they are like one another—Mercy and Judgment <note>The balance of the sefirot *Chesed* and *Gevurah*</note>. Because of this, they are two, and they are from the Upper World in the "Male Spirit" <term>Dechura: the masculine, giving principle</term>. And that which ascends and connects with them is the "Female" <term>Nukba: the feminine, receiving principle</term>, and she is included within both of them, just as the "heel" is included in the two sides of right and left and connects with them. So too, this one is the Female, and she connects with the two other letters which are on the two sides—these are upper and those are lower, and they are all one: Male and Female. 

Except that all the "strangers" of the world <note>external forces</note> are letters from the Upper World in a vision of merit, and they gave birth to all the deeds below exactly in their likeness. Therefore, one who knows them and is careful with them hints at the Beloved Name below. The secret of these letters is that they are all Male and Female, to be included as one in the spirit of the Upper Waters and the Lower Radiance, and all is one. This is the secret of the **Holy Unification** <note>The *Yichud*, a central goal of Kabbalistic prayer</note>. Therefore, one who knows them and is careful with them—everything is for the preservation of the world, and he merits a portion in the World to Come. Because he is the essence of the Unification, ascending as is fitting. Three and three from this side and from that side. In one likeness, as the conclusion of all. And all are the spirit of the Upper Order as is fitting, in the likeness of the Above, which is an order of three and three in one Spirit.

The second order is on the South side, which is the Spirit of Silver. There are three orders for every single side. And every single order is three and three, and they are nine, as has been said. And the letters are divided thus for every side, and everything is connected as one, because there are letters in the "Female Spirit" and letters in the "Male Spirit." And they all connect as one and become one in the Spirit of the Holy Anointing that ascends. And next to them are appointed orders, three and three, as has been said. And everything is according to their order Above, as the order that is to be prepared.

And when that voice is heard, every abyss calls to its fellow and says: "Divide your waters and I will take this much."

Just as the lights of the stars are in the firmaments, so below, the "sons of light" are the hooks in the Tabernacle. And in every placement, these are the hooks; and below, they are like the stars to sustain, to protrude, and to be within. They are the extensions of gold and the attachments of copper, and these correspond to those. And when this purple struck that light of the dwelling, then another color emerged that was not glowing, and they mixed with one another. In this same manner, once <unclear>Moses</unclear> <note>Probably 'משה' (Moses)</note> "entered into the midst of the cloud and went up into the mount" <note>Exodus 24:18</note>. ## Accountings (Pekudei)

Holiness is here, as it is written: > Israel is the Lord’s hallowed portion, the first fruits of His harvest < (Jeremiah 2:3). Israel is called "holy" because it is written below that all the colors <note>In Kabbalah, "colors" often refer to the different divine emanations or Sefirot</note> are gathered within Israel. And these are the colors below, corresponding to those above. For when the soul is aroused, it does not ascend below before the Holy King until the Community of Israel <note>Hebrew: *Knesset Yisrael*, a term for the Shekhinah or the Divine Presence</note> merits it, so that she may be both above and below. In this same manner, she does not descend below until the Community of Israel in this world is like the holy angels above. Of them it is written: > He makes the winds His messengers, fiery flames His servants < (Psalms 104:4). When they perform a mission in this world, they descend below until they are clothed in the garments of this world. All of them take the form of the place to which they go.

And we have established that the soul only ascends when clothed in a **garment of light**. Come and see this secret: when Adam was in the Garden of Eden, he was clothed in a garment like the one above, called the "supernal garment of light" <note>original: *Ketnot Or* (spelled with the letter Aleph, meaning light)</note>. Once he was driven out of the Garden of Eden and needed the colors of this world, what is written? > And the Lord God made for Adam and his wife garments of skin and clothed them < (Genesis 3:21). Originally, they were garments of **light**. This was the light of that supernal radiance that Adam used in the Garden of Eden. Because in this Garden of Eden, a supernal light shines and is utilized. Therefore, anyone who enters the Garden is first clothed by the Holy One, blessed be He, in a garment of that light, so that he may be fitting for that place. If he were not first clothed in that light, he could not enter. Once he was driven out from there, he required a different garment. Then: > And the Lord God made for Adam and his wife garments of skin < <note>original: *Ketnot Oar* (spelled with the letter Ayin, meaning skin/leather)</note>. Everything was as it was needed.

And here, in this same manner, they made the "woven garments" <note>original: *Bigdei Serad*</note> to minister in the Sanctuary above. And in the Sanctuary—we have established that the good deeds a person performs in this world draw down a garment from that supernal image to be prepared for the World to Come before the Holy One, blessed be He. And in the Sanctuary, there is a garment for the Community of Israel, and we have seen the "Mirror that does not shine" <note>A Kabbalistic term for the Shekhinah, which receives light from the higher realms</note> facing the wings of the Lord and seeking in His palace. Therefore, she descended below into sixty worlds to achieve her perfection in this world below, just as the structure is above. Regarding this it is written: > Surely the righteous shall give thanks to Your name; the upright shall dwell in Your presence < (Psalms 140:14). "Surely the righteous shall give thanks to Your name" in this world; "the upright shall dwell in Your presence" in that world.

**And he made** the Ephod of gold. This we have established. Rabbi Yose said: The Ephod and the Breastplate <note>original: *Choshen*</note> were as one, and their form was as one. For there stood all those twelve stones, all of them according to the names of the children of Israel. And all of them represent twelve supernal boundaries, all within the spirit of the Divine Presence <note>original: *Shekhinah*</note> that rests upon them. This secret is written: > The tribes of the Lord, a testimony for Israel, to give thanks to the name of the Lord < (Psalms 122:4). "There the tribes went up"—these are the twelve tribes that ascend above, for these tribes are the "Name," a testimony for Israel.

He said to him: The verse mentions "tribes" twice! Rather, "There the tribes went up" refers to the tribes below. "The tribes of the Lord" refers to the tribes above. "A testimony for Israel"—this is the spirit of the Holy Supernal Shekhinah, which is called "Testimony," as you say, "This is my testimony." And those twelve tribes stand upon her; they are the twelve holy stones. Therefore, they stand below in the likeness of those above, and all those names of the twelve tribes are engraved on those stones, and they are all one secret together.

Come and see: when Jacob was going to Haran, what is written? > And he took from the stones of the place and put them under his head < (Genesis 28:11). These were the twelve holy stones, and they all became one stone, as it is written: > And this stone, which I have set for a pillar < (Genesis 28:22). The Sages called them "the taste of wisdom," because all twelve stones were included as one, a single supernal holiness that exists above. From here we know it is written, "And this stone..."

## Main Text (Zohar)

Fifty precious keys <note>original: "חמשין מפתחן" - referring to the Fifty Gates of Understanding (Binah)</note> rule within it. And because of this, everything is as one hidden mystery regarding the Male <note>the divine masculine aspect, Zeir Anpin</note> toward His daughter <note>the Shekhinah</note>, to be with you always, as it is written: **"And you shall place the names of the children of Israel upon his heart before the Lord continually"** <note>Exodus 28:29</note>. And because of this, they are all within the Spirit of the Ancient One <note>Atika, the highest primordial level of Divinity</note>.

Twelve hidden worlds exist above to be built within the Holy Supernal Spirit; these are the spirit of the Torah, and they emerge from a single thin voice, as has been established. Twelve other hidden ones exist below, corresponding to them, and they emerge from another voice which is Wisdom <note>Chokhmah</note>, as it is written: **"The wise in heart will receive commandments"** <note>Proverbs 10:8</note>. And regarding this, they established it through the secret of the verse that is written: *And he saw, and behold, three flocks of sheep... and they rolled the stone* <note>Genesis 29:2-3</note>. This "stone" is the Shekhinah <note>the Divine Presence</note> which is the root of Wisdom, just as the Supernal Wisdom illuminates her and enters her in like manner. And it is written: *And they put the stone back upon the mouth of the well in its place.* Because of this name, they are all called "wise." And how many levels of wisdom are there within wisdom? There are the "wise ones" who are the foundations of the House, as it is written: **"Through wisdom a house is built"** <note>Proverbs 24:3</note>, and through wisdom the great wise ones move, the precious wise ones for the foundation of the House, the wise ones of the dwelling. And there are the precious Supernal Wise Ones, and they are twelve. Four orders, three by three for each side, toward the four winds <note>directions</note> of the world. In this same manner were the four banners <note>the tribal camps</note> that traveled in the desert. And they are the twelve tribes, three by three for each side, toward the four winds of the world. And all is one Spirit, as has been established.

And come and see: at the time when the High Priest would place these twelve stones—which prophesy to them—into the Breastplate and the Ephod, then the Shekhinah would dwell upon them. And these twelve stones were engraved with the names of all the tribes. Each and every tribe was revealed upon a single sunken stone, sustained by the "wise ones." And when the lights were nourished, the Male and Female <note>the divine aspects</note> would shine upon the defense <note>the legal "advocate" in the heavenly court</note>, and all of them—none were missing—were nourished by the letters *Mem* and *Tet* <note>the letters totaling 49, representing the gates of understanding</note>, because no interruption was found among them.

Rabbi Hezekiah said: If so, the letter *Mem* caused the name, and the seal of all is the letter *Tet*, which is a "good" letter <note>the word "Tov" (Good) starts with Tet</note>. For we have learned: one who sees the letter *Tet* in a dream, it is a good sign for him, because with it the Torah opened the word "Good," as it is written: **"And God saw the light, that it was good"** <note>Genesis 1:4</note>. Since it is a "good" letter, why was it not written among the names of the tribes? He said to him: Because two letters are supported by one another, and furthermore, the voice of the letter *Tet* is hidden and concealed. And if it were to shine, its radiance would be the radiance of all of them, for this letter is the radiance of everything. And it is not a radiance for restoration except for that which is written: *And God saw the light, that it was good.* This is the radiance of that light which is hidden and concealed. And regarding this it is written: **"He will not withhold good from those who walk in integrity"** <note>Psalms 84:12</note>. This is the light of all the tribes, and because of this, it was not revealed within them. Furthermore, all twelve emerge from within this hidden chamber <note>Exedra</note> which is in the spirit of the letter *Tet*, and therefore it is hidden and concealed and does not appear within them.

Come and see: all these stones stand in the spirit of the letters... and when they would all shine, then the High Priest’s face would shine, and the letters would appear bulging or sunken to be recognized from the outside. And when the face of the Priest would shine, then all those below would know that it was for good. And thus it was known if the Priest was meritorious or not. And regarding this, all is as one... as has been established.

Rabbi Abba was present before Rabbi Shimon. He said to him: That which is written: **"And you shall put in the Breastplate of Judgment the Urim and the Thummim"** <note>Exodus 28:30</note>—we have learned that these are the "Lights" <note>Urim</note> that shine with the word to protect you. The "Perfections" <note>Thummim</note> are those that complete their words. Furthermore, we need to know their meaning. He said to him: Certainly, for this reason there are the Breastplate and the Ephod corresponding to the Urim and Thummim, and this is the spirit of the Tefillin <note>phylacteries</note> and the knot of the Tefillin corresponding to these two. He opened and said: And this spirit shows... and this other spirit, we have established that the Holy One, blessed be He, sees it to hand over the knot of the Tefillin. And these are literally the Tefillin. And these Tefillin are a Supernal Secret, which is another holy level.

This is the mystery of the hour when the Priest <note>original: *Kahana*</note> spreads his hands; then the supernal Spirit is awakened and goes forth, and all the lights shine and circle, and are drawn and bound to one another until they illuminate the face of the Assembly of Israel <note>original: *Knesset Yisrael*; the mystical personification of the Jewish people, identified with the Shekhinah</note>, and all of this is by the hand of the Primordial Priest, who is the Priest. And when the Priest is awakened below, the Priest is awakened above. And since this one below is awakened, there is rest above.

And concerning this: "The mountain of the Lord's house shall be established at the top of the mountains..." <note>Isaiah 2:2</note> because there, all the other nations have an appointed minister in the heavens over them, and at that time, the Holy One, Blessed be He <note>original: *Kudsha Brich Hu* (Aramaic) / *HaKadosh Baruch Hu* (Hebrew)</note>, will consume them and cast them down from their dominion, as it is written: "The Lord will punish the host of the high heaven on high" <note>Isaiah 24:21</note>. And then there will be light, and they shall all see all the hidden treasures and the light, and "Many nations shall go and say, 'Come, let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, to the house of the God of Jacob...'" <note>Isaiah 2:3</note>.

And all of this is at the hour of the Priest, who is the mystery of that light; he increases it for her, and all of it is the mystery of the secret they have on all sides to illuminate her, for through the spirit of assistance, he increases it for her.

Rabbi Eleazar, Rabbi Isaac, and Rabbi Judah were walking on the way. Rabbi Eleazar said: "We must look into [the Torah] as we walk, so that merit shall not depart from us from within the words of Torah." Rabbi Judah said: "Who among us shall open the Torah with a matter of Law?"

Rather, at the time when he ascends to the level of peace and circles, then it is truth, the voice of one who humbles himself. And at the time when he is himself in distress and poverty, the Priest prepares him; he draws himself near and calls himself poor and the smallest of all. What is the reason? Because sometimes he rules, and sometimes he is in the humiliation of the poor. And in every vision, he rules over them constantly and they cannot prevail against him.

And King David humbled himself before the Holy One, Blessed be He, for whoever humbles himself before the Holy One, Blessed be He, He honors him above all. And because of this, the Holy One, Blessed be He, desired him in this world and in the world to come. In this world, as it is written: "For I will defend this city to save it, for My own sake, and for My servant David's sake" <note>2 Kings 19:34</note>. In the world to come, as it is written: "And they shall seek the Lord their God, and David their king; and shall fear the Lord and His goodness in the latter days" <note>Hosea 3:5</note>. You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah."**
> (Psalms 21:2-3) **O Lord, in Your strength the king rejoices, and in Your salvation how greatly he exults! You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.**

King David spoke this verse regarding the praise of the **Assembly of Israel** <note>the Shekhinah or Divine Presence</note>, for the Holy One, Blessed be He, rejoices with her in the power of **Freedom** <note>the Sephirah of Binah</note> which is called "Strength," as it is written: *The Lord will give strength to His people.* <note>Psalms 29:11</note> **"The king rejoices"**—this refers to the Holy One, Blessed be He, who is called "King," as it is written: *The Lord is King forever and ever.* **"And in Your salvation how greatly he exults"**—this is the salvation prepared for all those of the **Right Side** <note>the side of Mercy/Chesed</note>, which is the gathering and power of the Right. Another interpretation: **"How greatly he exults"**—the extra letter *Yod* <note>in the Hebrew word 'Yagil'</note> refers to the **Living Soul** <note>Chayah</note> of the spirit of the holy Covenant, which is the fortification of all, and everything is said regarding the life of the King. **"He asked life of You, and You gave it to him; length of days forever and ever."** From here we learn that King David had no life of his own at all, except that the primordial **Lovingkindness** <note>Chesed</note> gave to him from its own. And we have established that King David existed for seventy years, and those seventy years were given to him by the Holy One, Blessed be He, from the years of the **First Adam**; thus he existed and was given freedom in this world and the World to Come, and regarding this it says: *He asked life of You, and You gave it to him.* **"His glory is great through Your salvation; splendor and majesty You place upon him."** **"His glory is great"** because of the hidden **Living Soul** <note>Chayah</note>, as it is written: *Great is our Lord and of much power.* His life is called "Great," and this spirit is the strength of the great ones who are hidden, etc. And despite all this, the Living Soul is called "Great," as it is said: *Great is our Lord and of much power.* And the Holy One, Blessed be He, is called "Great," as it is written: *Great is the Lord and highly praised in the city of our God, His holy mountain.* Just as He is great, so is the city of our God, His holy mountain, for its produce is eternal blessings. **"For You set him to be a blessing"**—because this is the blessing for all worlds, and all blessings of all worlds flow and emerge from here. This is the Living Soul and the Spirit, as it says: *And you shall be a blessing,* for here dwell all the supernal blessings, and from here they emerge to all worlds, and therefore it is called "Blessing." **"You make him glad with joy"**—it is written here *You make him glad with joy* and it is written elsewhere *And Jethro rejoiced* <note>Exodus 18:9</note>, because from the side of the Holy One, Blessed be He, this joy spreads to the Assembly of Israel to strengthen her, like the spirit of the Right and its renewal; this is the renewal of the moon, as it is written: **"You make him glad with joy in Your presence."** **"In Your presence"**—just as our masters have said, like a bride who prepares herself with everything she needs, she is covered and a small child is born <note>a mystical metaphor for the emergence of new spiritual light</note>. And it is written: *To entreat the blessing.* Come and see: at that time when Moses erected the Tabernacle, he looked at all those works to see if they were done properly, and then he erected it. And all those works that were there, we find that each and every one was brought to Moses, and the spirit of his will proved to you, as it is written:

**"And they brought** the Tabernacle to Moses." Why did they bring the Tabernacle? Because there is a priestly reason for this: it is worthy for the female to be joined <note>to the male</note>, and therefore they brought the Tabernacle to Moses, just as a bride is brought to the house of the groom. For initially, it is necessary to bring the bride to the groom; the bride comes first, and afterward the groom comes to her, as it is written: *And he came to her,* and it is written: *And Moses came to the Tent of Testimony.* And here what is written? *And Moses was not able to enter the Tent of Meeting because the cloud rested upon it.* What is the reason? Because she was being prepared like a bride for her adornment, and she was beautified for her husband. And for this reason, the Living Soul is adorned below and her husband is above her. And because of this, *Moses was not able to enter the Tent of Meeting because the cloud rested upon it.* And for this reason, *they brought the Tabernacle to Moses.* What is then written? *And Moses saw all the work...*
