<meta>This page continues the mystical discourse on the construction of the Tabernacle (Mishkan) from the previous section of Parashat Pekudei. It focuses on the cosmic balance between the Side of Holiness and the "Other Side" (Sitra Achra), interpreting the physical assembly of the Tabernacle as a spiritual victory over the forces of darkness.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

->Pekudei<-

Behold, we have established that regarding all of them, the word "erecting" is not written. Rather, "and he gave/placed" is written to show what was necessary for them, because of the lower living beings. And we have learned that this is upon this, and this is upon this, and this is upon this <note>referring to the layered structure of the Tabernacle components</note>—it is written so. At that time, when this point was prepared to subdue the Other Side <note>original: *Sitra Achra*, the realm of evil/impurity</note>, it was not erased at all, for it will not be erased until that future time when it is erased from the world as has been stated. This was erected, and this was prepared.

**And he placed** the sockets <note>Exodus 40:18</note>; then they surrounded to strengthen this Side of Holiness and all its hosts. These supports were fixed, and all those of the Other Side went and were bent toward the great abyss, because this supreme Side of Holiness ascended, and they have no portion in that ascent. And then the Other Side went to be fixed and entered into that hole of the abyss. And if Israel had ruled at first, it <note>the Other Side</note> would not have been able to rule in the world anymore. And later, they also ruled, and darkened it for them at first. From that time, there was no counsel except to give a portion to that Other Side, all through the secret of the sacrifices, the coverings, and the scapegoat <note>original: *gilgul*, here referring to the ritual "rolling" or sending away of the goat</note>. And come and see: for this reason, the Burnt Offering <note>original: *Olah*, literally "that which ascends"</note> is called such, to subdue this side and to cause the Crown of Holiness to ascend. And for this reason, one measure is set against another, to fix this place. Come and see: "And Moses erected" <note>Exodus 40:18</note>—this is the Side of Holiness; and to fix the Other Side at its beginning. "And he placed"—for this Side of Holiness, and to weaken this Other Side from the start. "And he erected"—for this Side of Holiness, and to weaken this Other Side which is hollowed out. And later, he returned and "placed" for the bars, and later "erected." Come and see: so that its surrounding and its conclusion should stand. It begins with "erecting" and ends with "erecting," because in everything, the surrounding and the conclusion require "erecting." The surrounding of the Other Side is weakened, and this is the standing of the Side of Holiness, in order to be established and to ascend above, to become one bond as is fitting. For whenever Holiness rules and ascends, it is well hidden and draws down the spirit of the Point <note>a mystical Sephirah or focal point</note> that stands beneath the levels. Those in the Other Side are the head of the outer level, the head of the male, and he stands riding upon a camel <note>a traditional Zoharic image for the demonic forces of Samael</note>; they are the head of the vision of the knee that is commanded to spread out. For when the smoke emerges from within the powerful spirit, that smoke spreads out and goes, anger after anger, this upon this, and this rides and rules over this, in the manner of male and female, so that they are all a powerful anger. And all the surroundings of the smoke spread out, emerging from the anger like the pressure of a holy one to spread out. And later the smoke of anger spreads out in a crooked way, like a wise brain showing the head that emerges to spread out. It is a level pressed from within, ascending and descending, going and slaughtering, and so it is written. And the level stands to be delayed from that smoke that emerges from the anger, and they are all together over another place called the "Searchers of Death." And when the two of them join as one, they are "Searchers of the Void." We have established that there are two levels that join as one. This is the wave and the surrounding of the Lower Point which is carved on the outside, distant from the Holy Point where all dwells. And the Point is not found, it does not stand and is not seen in any form, and from it, an expansion spreads outward and downward, and it is fixed and not moved and not seen. This spreads downward to the right and to the left, and spreads like a vision within the darkness, facing the nose. And the words are joined, rolling down to the sand. This side spreads from the water and the power within it, a black color that is not truly black, for it has no color to be established like the side of the expansion. They stand in darkness, those who emerge in bitterness.

> They did not see one another, nor did anyone rise from his place for three days <note>Exodus 10:23, describing the Plague of Darkness in Egypt</note>

And it is written: "And the darkness shall be felt." <note>Exodus 10:21</note>

->236<-

<term>Side of Holiness</term> (Sitra de-Kardusha): The realm of divine light and purity.
<term>Other Side</term> (Sitra Achra): The realm of evil, shells (kelippot), and spiritual impurity.
<term>Male and Female</term> (Dechar ve-Nukva): The Zoharic concept that all forces, holy or unholy, exist in gendered pairs to produce offspring or effects.
<term>Great Abyss</term> (Tehoma Raba): The primordial depths where the forces of the Other Side are contained.
<term>Lower Point</term> (Nekuda Tata'ah): Often refers to the Shekhinah or the lowest manifestation of the divine in the world.
<term>Burnt Offering</term> (Olah): A sacrifice that is completely consumed by fire, symbolizing total ascent to God.
<term>Sacrifices</term> (Korbanin): Rituals used to draw down blessing or, as noted here, to appease/subdue the "Other Side."
<term>Darkness</term> (Chashochin): Not merely the absence of light, but a tangible spiritual substance associated with the Egyptian plagues and the Other Side.
<term>Expansion</term> (Pshitu): The process by which divine or spiritual energy flows from a source into a manifested form.

<summary>This page provides a mystical interpretation of the Tabernacle's assembly, explaining that the specific language of "placing" and "erecting" reflects a cosmic battle where the Side of Holiness subdues the Other Side. It describes the demonic hierarchies as "smoke" and "darkness" that are pushed back into the abyss through the construction of the holy sanctuary.</summary>
<keywords>Tabernacle, Mishkan, Moses, Sitra Achra, Holiness, Darkness, Exodus, Sockets, Sacrifices, Spiritual Warfare</keywords>

<meta>This page continues the mystical exposition of the Tabernacle (Pekudei), specifically focusing on the "Palaces" (Heikhalot) of the Other Side (Sitra Achra) which mirror the holy structures. It follows the previous discussion of how divine sparks are reflected or distorted in the lower realms.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

This hammer <note>original: *pattisha*; a mystical force that "strikes" to create or reveal forms</note> spreads out into several types, one within the other. From within that hammer, a single radiance emerges to spread out as is fitting for it, and this is the "downward gaze." This gaze spreads out and flies, emerging from the midst of judgment <note>original: *dina*</note>, and the vision of that azure color <note>original: *tekhla*</note> is what it gazes upon. This gaze spreads to the right and to the left, and from these two sides emerges a single color like silver—though not a precious silver—to spread as a silver hue. This gaze is included one within the other, and as it descends, the gaze spreads out. Two gazes stand at the head of Wisdom <note>original: *Chokhmah*</note>; they stand and reach out, spreading and bending a single shade of blue. From there and further down, that gaze stands and establishes itself, bending a single shade of "laughter" <note>original: *choka*; likely a reference to the deceptive joy of the lower forces</note>, which is the "flying one," and all is the secret of the gaze. From these two standing ones, there emerges a single established gaze, a "daughter of laughter," and all these colors are seen within it. This is the "guarantor" that increases the male to be received and to pair as one; upon this, all the known levels <note>original: *dargin*</note> stand.

->**Level**<-

The first level to it is the level of this Crown <note>original: *Keter*</note> of this gaze; this is a "pious one who is not pious" <note>original: *chasid de-la chasid*; a paradoxical term for a force that mimics kindness but lacks holy source</note> that rises into the hiddenness of this azure. This takes and includes a shade of green, like the shade of "laughter." These three colors are divided into several sides below, taken into the depths of the world. The azure color descends to the world and goes to several sides, but it does not spread [holily] in the world; rather, it causes the spirits of human beings to sin, acting as a tax <note>original: *karga*</note> to turn their paths aside and to establish them in their own [selfish] desires. Concerning this, it is written:
> There shall be no strange god in you, nor shall you prostrate yourself to a foreign god. (Psalms 81:10)
"Strange god" refers to the male [of the Other Side], and "nor shall you prostrate yourself to a foreign god" refers to the female <note>original: *nukba*</note>, for this "foreign" one is the female. This is the spirit that goes and establishes itself in the world, and because of this, her children are many, and she establishes them in [worldly] wisdom. The blue color—this color descends to strike at several sides, to "laugh" <note>deceive</note>, to kill, and to pair with its kind, and to overpower the strength of those who weep. Concerning this, it is written:
> If they say, "Come with us, let us lie in wait for blood, let us lurk for the innocent without cause." (Proverbs 1:11)
Because there are sinners of this kind who bite and kill without cause, and there are those who are burned in war. This one is from the side of the male, and that one is from the side of the female. Like a mountain, the male goes to bite his kind as we have said; the side of the female approaches the serpent to kill one another, and all these wars and killings all come from that side of the female. The black color stands as a weakened color; it descends to the world to be forgiven <note>or "to dissolve"</note> over all the simple ones and the stricken. They seize the bodies and the garments, and they are always wise to the strength of weeping. These three colors are divided into several sides of the world and spread through the weeping of the world. The azure color descends into the world, and this is the first color that emerges from the darkness that burst from that shell <note>original: *galda/kelipah*</note> they spoke of. To it belongs the spleen <note>original: *tachol*</note> which rides upon the camel <note>original: *gamal*; a reference to the arch-demon Samael</note> as has been said. This azure color is called the "shackle of the knee," and this is the spirit for the "sons of strength" to strengthen their power through their own will. Under it stand one thousand and six hundred damaging forces <note>original: *chabilin*</note> to provide a spirit for the bodies of the "sons of strength." For there is a spirit that goes through the world to execute judgment, and all those spirits that go about are seen in the coldness of the spirit. This spirit can take on all sides of colors and act through them in the manner of [dark] wisdom. Because this azure emerges from the spirit of the upper-lower <note>the lower aspect of the higher realm</note>, this first grace was not destroyed. Colors are divided from that first spirit to call out in song, but it does not give life to the levels of the hearts of the "sons of strength," nor is there life of wisdom or cheapness. It turns aside to the heart and to the lower ones in their desires, and it does not give life to that which melts from the azure upon the world. Concerning this, it is written:
> The foot shall trample it. (Isaiah 26:6)
Remember, the second spirit stands as the one that descends to strike and to cause sin, spreading to all sides. This is called "azure," and it descends and comes upon the "sons of strength." Once it enters, it is called "the silence of the azure."

<summary>This page describes the mystical emanation of "dark colors" (azure, blue, black) associated with the Sitra Achra (the Other Side). It explains how these forces mimic the holy Sefirot to lead humanity toward sin, violence, and selfish desire, specifically linking them to the "strange god" and the "spleen."</summary>

<meta>This page continues the discussion of the spiritual structures within the "Other Side" (the demonic or unbalanced realms) as described in the Zohar, specifically within the section of Pekudei. It follows the descriptions of the various palaces and grades of the lower realms.</meta>

## Pekudei

-> **Pekudei** <note>original: "Pekudei" - The name of the final Torah portion in Exodus, meaning "Accounts."</note> <-

And this is the mystery of the **Ancient One** <note>original: "Atik" - referring here to the most hidden aspect of the divine, though in this context it describes the reflection or "wrath" emanating from the highest levels into the lower realms</note> and it is the life-force of the lower realm, and in this place there is a cleaving. And it is a life-force of **wrath** <note>original: "rughza"</note> of the Ancient One that stands in crookedness, for if it ceases from all of them, it is because the life-force is the color of the appearance of the Ancient One, constant and killing until the morning. The wrath that descends stands as a wrath reversed from the first. It is a sickness, neither strengthening nor silencing until that wrath is revealed; and everything below is thus broken, everything below does not silence and is thus broken. And this is called the **fourth wrath**, a strong beginning, a broken bend; and upon this stands the life-force of wrath that turns from the first, and because of this, the life-force stands as a side apart from all of them, and therefore all of them are wrath in the first **grade** <note>original: "darga" - a level or step in the spiritual hierarchy</note>.

-> **Grade** <-

The second is a grade that emerges from **darkness** <note>original: "chashoka"</note>, and this is a dark color that stands from within this darkness, because everything stands from within darkness and stands as known grades, and this spreads downward into known grades. In this grade stand three striking sides, separating one from another, yet all are included one in another. And even though they hide one from another and pass one from another, they are all included one in another. And because of this, all known grades are on this side to deny <note>the truth</note>. From here emerge all those destroyers who stray in the world and perform oppression like a bridegroom over hidden deeds that were done within darkness in secrecy. They stray in the world and lodge together like a bridegroom, and because of this, all those who stray and perform oppression like a bridegroom, they all stand opposite human beings to constantly entice them toward those hidden sins of which they speak. And those who are called **Anger and Wrath** <note>original: "Af ve-Chemah" - two destructive angels</note> join with them and perform oppression upon human beings; a voice is made like a gnawing of other sicknesses of oppression as we have said.

This grade stands within darkness and is not a wrath of a spirit of sickness; and from within this grade separate several powerful ones, mighty ones standing beneath the **Crown of the Firmament** <note>original: "Keter de-Raki'a"</note>, the master called the **Firmament of Wisdom** <note>original: "Raki'a Chochmata"</note> of the life-force. And this firmament spreads over all those grades that are red like a rose, and these are called the **Arms** of this side. Beneath these, grades spread downward until they reach the descending grade, because those in the second grade emerge from within that Firmament of Wisdom and stray in the world—these to the right and these to the left. Those of the right separate into three sides which are three **knots** <note>original: "kitrin" - spiritual bonds or connections</note>, and those of the left separate into three sides which are three other knots.

The first knot stands above, and beneath it is darkness in a wrath that is strong; in it stands a molten knot of three dark colors, mixing one with another and included one in another. And it is a knot that is blocked, and God subdues it except at known times; for this is called "passing without cooling," because it does not cool except at the time when Israel offers a sacrifice below. For at that time, that wrath is cooled and subdued below, and its anger is weakened and it cannot curse or strengthen itself. And every beginning of this is then the second knot, which is in humility; this can cancel and subdue, and this knot is called **Indignation** <note>original: "Za'as"</note>. This is the second connection, which is a knot gathered under the "Other" <note>the Sitra Achra or unholy side</note> and leads all the other knots. And all the other knots are led by it, and all are strengthened by that knot which is the life-force that leads all matters of the world. Because everything joins in another grade to deny the body, then all matters and all thin veils descend to the world, and all that is above—they cannot curse one another. And all the grades are united in a cleaving to curse and to lead the world astray; and if one rides upon the other and joins one with another, he cannot curse. Come and see, every man was like the Garden of Eden to labor in the commandment of his Master beneath this side, and all those...

<meta>This page continues the Kabbalistic exposition of the "Sitra Achra" (the Other Side or the realm of impurity) within the section of Pekudei. ## Main Text (Zohar)

Those are the pure levels, and he <note>the personification of the evil inclination</note> rides upon that evil beast in order to lead them astray; for that beast which is <term>swift</term> <note>original: *kalil*</note> beneath him is crooked, acting to mislead human beings and to entice them, as it is written: 
> For the lips of a forbidden woman drip honey, and her speech is smoother than oil. <note>Proverbs 5:3</note>

And because of this, he does not grant strength, and the spirit makes a "living being" <note>a demonic entity</note> in the soul, and it is not a <term>bride</term> <note>original: *kallah*, here implying a holy union</note> that he cannot mislead. Therefore, whenever the <term>lower knot</term> <note>original: *kisetra* / *ketra*</note> is removed from connecting with the female <note>the feminine aspect of the unholy side</note>, then he is ready for all the pressures of the serpent. When he sees that it overpowers him, the nullification of them all joins together and is subdued by him, and he is able to lead [the person] astray. Because of this, they all join and are subdued by the spirit of the sacrifices that descend and ascend; the "fat" <note>the essence of the offering</note> rises to be crowned above and to be blessed from the Supernal Depth that illuminates all faces.

**The Third Knot:** This beast is powerful with extra strength and is called the <term>Sun-Serpent</term> <note>original: *chivi cheres*</note> because it strikes like the thorns of a palm branch to mislead those in distress and to create leeches for the Assembly of Israel. And the spirit of these three knots is that of which it is written: 
> He unleashed against them his hot anger, wrath, indignation, and hostility. <note>Psalm 78:49</note>

These are the three knots of the Right. The three knots of the Left all strengthen themselves as one; then that "spleen" is called the "Kingdom of Evil" because the spleen strikes and they exert themselves below. All those evil kings take strength—those who are hungry and pursue below as we have seen—and all of this is from the second level and the third level.

**The Fourth Level:** This level stands within the crookedness of anger, and its strength is called "Distressor," which is the body that stands between the two arms. Here there is that which flames in redness like a rose. From here, they hunger with strength to descend below, to empower themselves and to prepare blood; for this beast gives the secret and the dominion below to strengthen and prepare blood—a serpent that flickers through the body. This is needed in a way that the body of the soul does not need; in the trap, he does not make a "living being" except in the body. Because of this, all power and all strength go out from here to empower and to create a "living being" in the sleep-state, to weaken the female of the Balance from the male constantly. In every single level and every single knot, there are species and many biting destroyers, all of whom are led by their prophets below, and all are led because of them. They are the weapons within the female, and they all have a known level above by which they are led. Just as the Holy Upper Side has known Palaces <note>Heichalot</note> regarding the upper levels to be included one in another, so too below in reverse: the Other Side has levels regarding those Palaces of the female to be included one in another. In this level of the spirit of evil, evil species stand to descend and to hide; from here, those who execute harsh evil judgment take their strength to empower and to rest that spirit which they made. Because of this, all these levels are as we have established: lower Palaces for the [Other] Side in correspondence below. All of them are the portion of those who cling to the side of their path that stirs her up; and she sees the crown that belongs to the female to be empowered in the holiness of their Master. Righteous are they in this judgment and in the comfort below.

**The Fifth Level:** This level is divided into two levels, Right and Left, and these are called the "Thighs" <note>corresponding to the sefirot of Netzach and Hod in the unholy realm</note> which cling together to weaken and to pursue. For here is the strength of the pursuit of all illnesses and all evils that pursue after the guilty. And all this <margin>(The level of the Other Side)</margin> is not approached except through the moisture of the "Hofim" <note>unclean spirits</note>, and the wicked are graceful below to run and to weaken, and all those who search for "Horpis" <note>a demonic name or force</note>. Regarding this it is written: 
> Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of the heavens. <note>Lamentations 4:19</note>

This level is divided into two sides, to the Right and to the Left. Three knots to the Right and three knots to the Left <note>the text repeats "Right" in the original, likely a scribal error for Left</note>. And these are the knots, and they are the knots that are tied in them, looking to bind, because they are the upper knots.

## Main Text (Zohar)

->**Pekudei**<-
<note>The title of the Torah portion, meaning "Accounts."</note>

All the holy ones gaze into the internal light of the Body <note>The "Body" here refers to the central structure of the Divine emanations</note>, and all the "backwards" parts <note>The external or lower aspects of the spiritual realms</note> are like it, and they are all gathered below. What is the difference between this one and that one? Rather, the upper holy knots <note>The connections between Divine attributes</note> are all within the Spirit of **Loving-kindness** <term>Chesed: the attribute of expansive benevolence</term>. And since the Holy One, blessed be He, is within the Spirit of Loving-kindness, all the "backwards" parts are like it, as it is written. And these other knots of the "Others" <note>The Sitra Achra or "Other Side," representing the forces of impurity</note> are the lower holy ones; they all gaze backwards, and these are within the Spirit of **Wisdom** <term>Chokhmah: the attribute of intuitive insight</term>. Because of this, all the "backwards of the back" and this spirit are as we have established: Loving-kindness. And as His hand is planted, this one is on the side of God <note>original: "El," the Divine name associated with Chesed</note> and this one is on the side of Wisdom. And we call it thus: Loving-kindness and Wisdom ascend. The first knot stands within a black color inside the thick darkness <insert>or: within the hiddenness of the thick darkness</insert>. For behold, all the letters are beneath Wisdom, which stands over them; this is Loving-kindness. And this stands over those who are meritorious, even if they have no merits <note>meaning they are sustained by pure grace</note>, and there is no lower merit for them to be strengthened by. And other knots pursue the guilty who strayed from their paths from of old, and they pursue after them. And for all those who raised the letters <note>spiritual intentions</note> to be known, because all those below are made into one King over them, a holy one who descends from the side of **Power** <term>Gevurah: the attribute of judgment and restraint</term> and tramples a mark into them. And that mark is known above to all those masters of wrath. That mark is known to their prophets; those who are sealed for illness, he allots to them illnesses; those who are sealed for pains and for the cycle of punishments—all speak according to that mark. Because of this, all those knots stand backwards and step upon all those who go astray, and all those below are beaten by them. Similarly, the righteous and the pious who are ill—[the forces] pursue after them and allot to them [suffering] and rule over them, yet illnesses do not come to them from this side <note>meaning their suffering is not a punishment from the "Other Side"</note>. And if you say: from where do illnesses come to them? Come and see, it is written: "And the Lord desired" <note>original: "Vav Chefetz," a mystical interpretation of the Divine will</note>, for all of them are gracious. The "Vav of Desire" is engraved here at the gates of this opening, and it shall not be called "illnesses," nor "the Other," nor from the "Other Side"—rather, these are the "Sufferings of Love." And they all ascend according to the Holy Balance.

## Main Text (Zohar)

And because of this, he did not burn more than his straw, and upon this all the orders are toward the side of the **Shekhinah** <note>The Divine Presence, often viewed as the feminine aspect of God</note> in the world. Just as at times they were worthy, all of them were like the surrounding palaces of which we spoke. Rabbi Shimon stood and said: "Fortunate is your portion, **Adam the First Man**, for through him all creatures exist in the world. Ezekiel 28:13</note> like the appearance of copper, an eye like the clouds that covered the entire world, to behold the beauty of the Lord and to visit His palace. <note>Psalms 27:4</note> To behold the beauty of the Lord above, and to visit His palace below; to behold the beauty of the Lord like those seven heavens above, and to visit His palace like those seven heavens below."

And these stand one corresponding to the other, and all of them stood like the Garden of Eden. Those seven supernal holy canopies stood over you above to be crowned by them, and those seven lower ones stood for you to be adorned by them, and all of them to exalt you from your path to be perfect in everything. Until below, your feet were a crown of counsel in the hand, and you were sealed away from the Garden of Eden and caused death for yourself and for the whole world, because you abandoned those delights of above and below. And you sealed the crown of those in the impure ends to investigate the matter of the soul that is defiled by them. And the spirit rested when the matter rushed to see, and it is written: "In sorrow and in pain" <note>Cf. Genesis 3:17</note> it rushed until below. For all this is pious and surrounds to strengthen the world, and it entered into the **Holy Faith** and established above and below like those supernal firmaments and like those lower firmaments. Those lower ones are palaces for those supernal firmaments, to be grasped one in the other and to be bound one to the other, just as we have established regarding those palaces of which we spoke.

And even though we established this generally in the middle, and at times to explain words and to strengthen the vision in the valley properly, so that the companions should not err and should direct themselves together to the foundation, as it is written:
> For the ways of the Lord are right, and the just shall walk in them, etc. <note>Hosea 14:10</note>

-> **The Palace** <-

The first is the beginning within **Faith**, and this is the beginning of the mystery of Faith, and like the level in the window of Faith for the heart of truth. And they saw from within this the **Specularia** <note>A mystical mirror or lens through which the Divine is perceived</note> that does not shine. And because it is the first vision of Faith, it is written "Under the feet of the Lord" <note>Cf. Exodus 24:10</note> like the longing of that which is below, opposite the spirit. This is the beginning of all levels to ascend above, and the end of all levels to descend below. And because he erred in many trials, this beginning is the end of all levels that are needed, such as to be revealed below. And you were sealed from there below toward that place called "sin," and those who are pure are those who leave and are not corrected by this sin. Strength and a brother are there, all those palaces that are on the side of the "Chet" <note>The Hebrew letter associated here with 'Chet' (Sin)</note> which has an **impure palace**. All of them are impure to the visions that are attached to them. And regarding this it is written: "Sin stands for you," etc. And does the heart of truth need this? Rather, because he lacked all power above like those palaces, so that he would not be drawn after them like a passing river. For it is written:
> And he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered. <note>Genesis 9:21</note>

For all those who are bent who ascend, this appointee stands as a side, and many other appointees are with him. <meta>This page continues the discussion of the Heavenly Palaces (Heichalot) from the Zohar, specifically focusing on the mechanics of how prayers ascend or are rejected, and the profound significance of tears.</meta>

## Pekudei

->**Pekudei** <note>The name of the final Torah portion in Exodus, meaning "Accounts" or "Records."</note><-

The Masters of Vision <note>A term for mystics or those with spiritual insight.</note> say: This altar stands on this side. If a person is worthy to enter this gate, they ascend; but if they are not worthy, another appointee <note>Hebrew/Aramaic: *Memuna*—an angelic official or overseer.</note> who stands on the "Other Side" <note>The *Sitra Achra*, the realm of spiritual impurity or evil.</note> is there. To the right, there are many thousands and tens of thousands of "officers of the law" <note>Aramaic: *Gardinei Nimussin*—destructive angels who enforce strict judgment.</note> who resemble that holy appointee, but this other one is on the left side. He takes the soul up into those impure palaces, and all those officers of the law push it down until they lower it to Gehenna <note>Purgatory or the realm of punishment.</note>. It is cast away there for twelve months, which are the twelve months of "rectification" for that Other Side, for the merit of being cast out into their dwellings. In contrast, the holy appointee who stands over that [holy] gate takes all those prayers that pierce the air and the firmaments to rise before the King. If the person is worthy, there are many gates, and that prayer rises until all the prayers of the world are made into a crown on the head of the Righteous One <note>The *Tzadik*, often referring to the sefirah of Yesod or the foundational righteous soul of the world.</note>, as the sages have established.

And if the prayer of an individual ascends until it reaches the gate of this palace where this appointee stands: if that prayer is worthy to go up before the Holy King, he immediately opens the gate and brings it up. But if the person is not worthy, he pushes it outside, and it is pushed away and delivered to the world, remaining within the lower firmament of those lower firmaments that govern the world. In that firmament stands a certain appointee whose name is **Sahadiel** <note>Meaning "God is my witness."</note>. He is appointed over this firmament and takes all those prayers that were pushed away—those that were "wounded" prayers—and he guards them until that person returns to his Master as is proper and offers another, worthy prayer. When that worthy prayer ascends, the appointee Sahadiel takes the [previous] prayer and brings it up until it mixes with the worthy prayer. They ascend and mingle as one and enter before the King.

But sometimes, when that person's prayer is not purified and returns to the "Other Side," and he is found on that side, the appointee of that Other Side takes it. What a pity! Then that dark Other Side stands and rises, mentioning the sins of that person before the Holy One, blessed be He, to lead him astray above. Therefore, all prayers and all requests, when they ascend, they all stand before this palace. If the appointee stands at the gate of this palace above, he weighs the prayers to push them outside.

Above this gate, there is another gate that the Holy One, blessed be He, keeps for Himself. It opens three times a day and never closes. It stands for the "Masters of Repentance" <note>Those who have returned to the faith after sinning.</note> who shed tears in their prayers before their Master. All gates and openings are closed, except for these gates which are called the **Gates of Tears**. When this prayer of tears ascends through those gates, it is seen by that "Wheel" <note>Aramaic: *Ofan*—a high-ranking type of angel.</note> who stands over six hundred great and mighty living beings. He supports and takes this prayer with those tears. The prayer enters and is bound above, and those tears are engraved upon that gate. They are never destroyed; they are permanently engraved upon all those celestial curtains and are not erased <note>Marginal explanation or alternative version within the text</note> (Another version: they *are* erased). These are the tears that flowed above and below when the Holy Temple was destroyed, as it is written:
> "Behold, the Alerim <note>Angels of a high order.</note> cry without; the angels of peace weep bitterly." <note>Isaiah 33:7</note>
And those tears shed for the righteous and the worthy when they depart from the world—the angels take them all and arrange them like those tears shed over the destruction of the Holy Temple. Regarding this, it is written:
> "And the Lord God will wipe away tears from off all faces." <note>Isaiah 25:8</note>
Behold, these "faces" refer to those holy celestial curtains. And afterwards:
> "And the reproach of His people shall He take away from off all the earth; for the Lord hath spoken it." <note>Isaiah 25:8</note>
In this palace, there is a spirit called *Santaria*. In this spirit, a sapphire is seen sparkling in every direction. Within it is a living being that stands on two sides, with camps spreading out between them like a ladder, as they have established, with many sides and many colors.

<summary>This passage describes the spiritual journey of prayers through the heavenly palaces, explaining how the angel Sahadiel guards rejected prayers until they can be redeemed by repentance, and emphasizing that the "Gates of Tears" remain eternally open to the brokenhearted.</summary>

Colors flash from this light of the Right <note>The side of Mercy/Chesed</note>; all that upper firmament is a crown that gathers and emerges from Eden, covering the canopies above within the **Seventh Palace**. Once spirit is breathed into spirit and they are included as one, then a single light emerges that ascends and descends and settles upon four mountains of canopies. A single living being rules over them, called <term>Ziq Qachi</term> <note>A specific angelic spark or force</note> or <term>Ziq Kasir</term>, like a light that is hidden within a vessel and rules over all those canopies. All those prayers that are offered early—on this the people of Israel conclude their prayers—all of them tarry in this firmament. ## Main Text (Zohar)

-> Pekudei <note>The section of the Torah titled "Accounts"</note> <-

...of the heart, as it is written: *the cup of his fury, the cup of trembling.* <note>Isaiah 51:17</note> This is the cup of life from the side opposite to the Holy One, blessed be He. At all times, all the drops and husks <term>Kelipot; the shells of evil or impurity</term> of spirits, and all the sides of the husks, are likewise the "living creature" <note>original: Chayah</note> from the impure side. There are palaces and appointees, all of them prophets of impure spirits, and all impure sides. This corresponds to that, such as the Good Inclination and the Evil Inclination, and all is within one mystery.

This palace is called the **Palace of Splendor** <note>Heichal Zohar</note> because there is a spirit called **Churpania** <note>Sharpness or Keenness</note>, and its radiance is a splendor that does not change. It stands like a hidden light that shines from a shadow, and like a light that shines below. When the light strikes downward, a standing light is revealed upon it; the spirit stands in the likeness of the purity of a cloud. When it rolls, it then brings forth light in colors and splendors. So too, this spirit and this splendor is called the "Sharpness of Purity," and it is the radiance that illuminates this palace. It is bound to the first palace because that first spirit shines in its ascent like this spirit of hidden radiance. This spirit ascends above and descends below, as it is written:
> The joints of your thighs are like jewels
<note>Song of Songs 7:2</note>
And why does it say "the joints of your thighs"? Because there is another spirit that emerges from the side of Samael <note>The primary figure of evil/prosecution in Jewish mysticism</note> and is bound with it. Regarding this, it is written "joints" <note>plural</note>, referring to two. This spirit of Samael is called Hadrachniel, and they are included one within the other. Then they are all hidden strengths that consume everything. It is written:
> As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, etc.
<note>Ezekiel 1:28</note>
This first spirit, Churpaniel, of hidden radiance, is between the upper and the lower, and its radiance shines because of the **Chashmal** <note>A mystical "speaking silence" or amber-colored fire mentioned in Ezekiel's vision</note>. For its radiance is like the appearance of Chashmal, and at times it is the "Living Chashmal," because from it stand all those ranks of "living creatures" <note>Chayyot; a high order of angels</note>. For these living creatures speak, and they exist and do not exist. The "Sharpness of Chashmal" that we mentioned is how the living creatures are known to the world. When the world rejoices in goodness, then this spirit shines, and all life and all joy are found. For once merit emerges and the light of judgments [is mitigated], then this spirit is darkened, and your sign is:
> In the light of the king’s countenance is life
<note>Proverbs 16:15</note>
But when the world sins in judgment, then that other impure side rules and is strengthened, and those "living creatures" [of the other side] approach and are strengthened, and then the whole world stands in anger. We have learned that everything stands upon this spirit. And your sign is: "and the living creatures ran and returned" <note>Ezekiel 1:14</note>. Here stand all those hidden kingdoms of the righteous who ascend to appear before their Master and to stand before Him.

When a soul <note>Neshamah</note> ascends and comes to the palace, an appointee is prepared who is in charge of those garments and forms. For at the time a person performs the commandments <term>Mitzvot</term> of the Torah in this world, according to the way he exerted himself, so is made for him in this upper palace a garment to clothe himself in that world. When the soul ascends, that appointee takes her garment and goes with her until she reaches the **River of Fire** <note>Nehar di-Nur</note>. There the soul must bathe and be cooled. Sometimes that soul sinks there and is not honored and does not ascend until every day in the morning, when the spirit of the South side awakens. Then they all stand and are strengthened and say a song and sing, just like those angels whose dominion awakens and they are burned and then exist and are renewed as before, and they say a song and go their way. So too are those souls. 

Happy is the soul that ascends! And this is **Michael**, the righteous one, who takes her before the Master of All. This is that garment, and she is recorded and ascends to the offering by the hand of Michael the Priest, to stand continually all the days before the **Ancient of Days** <note>Atik Yomin; a name for the most hidden aspect of the Divine</note>. All these are the portion of this soul to stand in merit. Happy is he! This spirit of Churpania, which is sharp and radiant, rules over this palace above all others. This is when spirit is included in spirit, and they strike one another to be included as one. For those rulers were created, and others below them from the world, and these are the ranks of nine wings who are sanctified to their Master three times.

<meta>This page continues the mystical discourse on the Book of Exodus, specifically the portion of Pekudei. It focuses on the celestial mechanics of the Divine Chariot and the rewards for those who delve into the secrets of the Torah.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

->**Pekudei (Accounts)**<-

Blessed are those and blessed is their portion, those who are meticulous with the precise details of the words of the Torah, to know and to understand what stands to be found in this world and in the world to come. And for those who go to look outside <note>referring to those who seek external or superficial meanings</note> when they exchange even a single word in the Torah and do not seek its glory—to all of you, I have heard words that burn. The Six Orders of the Mishnah <note>The foundational code of Jewish Law</note> contain no word whose exchange does not endanger spirit with spirit; yet when they are unified as one, they shine. From the Holy Name goes forth a certain Living Creature <note>original: *Chayuta*, referring to the holy beings of Ezekiel's vision</note> that rules over those wings <note>original: *tarfei*, literally leaves or layers, here meaning celestial coverings</note> and four letters that hover. Beneath its voice, the splendors are subdued. Her name is *Piha* <note>perhaps "The Mouth," a personification of a specific spiritual gateway</note>, and she stands over all the mysteries of Wisdom <note>original: *Chochmah*</note>, and all those keys of Wisdom are found in her. And if Wisdom stands to be known, it is through the reed-pen <note>original: *kaneh*</note> given to human beings to pursue Wisdom, to know and to see. For when a person departs from this world, this Living Creature goes forth on four wings, flying and hovering before him. And all those "officers of the law" <note>original: *gardinei nimusin*, destructive angels of judgment</note> who are on the "Other Side" <note>the realm of evil/impurity</note> are unable to approach him. How many songs of praise ascend! And those wings, when they move and take delight, the seraphim are subdued by the goodness that goes forth from that opening of the firmament that extends over the whole world. This Holy Living Creature stands; when she is found, she ascends and carries the Prophet. Then she pours into him the spirit of Wisdom. According to the measure that he is meticulous in Wisdom and grinds it fine, so it is given to the Prophet. And if he is able to cleave to it, he sees; if not, she pushes him outside and he does not enter. She stands beneath that Palace in shame. And when they lift their wings, those wings beneath her tremble, then they all move their wings and dance for her. She is ignited but not consumed; she exists and yet does not exist. And so she is purified every day like a newborn. For those whose deeds are meritorious, she has a place to rest in that world. Those who exert themselves in Wisdom to gaze upon the glory of the exchanges—there is no measure to the prophecy of those who know Wisdom through the glory of the exchanges. One should not blemish his prayer, lest he withhold blessings from the world and be joined with that companion—the Sin of Error—who withholds blessings from the world and causes [harm] to come to all. 

In this manner, "And he remembers a companion." What is "And he remembers a companion"? This is one who follows the Other Side and pulls the "Serpent" <note>Nachash</note> toward him; an impure spirit <note>original: "Ruha Mesava"</note> rests upon him and he joins in that companionship of that "Evil Companion." And these "Companions" <note>Angels</note> stand constantly over a man like a new companionship for his benefit, to bring him rest and to benefit him. They are companions to sanctify the Name of their Master and to speak of Him, and they are found before Him constantly. And from here we emerge...

## Main Text (Zohar)

->**Pekudei**<-

There are four other supports besides those twelve we previously mentioned. Here, there are destructive forces and many hosts that stand against those who devise plans that are not on the proper path—even if they did not carry them out—and they receive their portion of the matter from above. Therefore, that plan and those hosts are called "Hollows" <note>original: "chalulin"</note>. Even though all of them are meant to be established, not every single one is appointed over known matters, and beneath these, there is no end to their number. These four stand at the four sides of the world; each one stands like a leaf that cannot be found, and these hosts are called "Lattices," as it is said: <note>referencing Song of Songs 2:9</note> **"peering through the lattices."** This refers to those four called Lattices: **Watcher, Watcher, Watcher, and Honor** <note>original: "Iriya, Iriya, Iriya, Yekara"</note>. These stand to look upon all those who perform good deeds and upon all those thoughts that are hidden from the Holy One, blessed be He, even if they were unable to be performed.

The **Watcher** stands on the **South** side. This one stands to look at all those who are hidden away and oppressed by men who have power over them, even though they cannot take anything from them. They also watch the path of grace and those who perform kindness for the dead <note>In Jewish tradition, "Chesed Shel Emet" or "True Kindness" refers to burial and honoring the deceased, as they cannot repay the favor</note>. They stand to see the deceased and the houses of mourning, to remember them for good and to engrave their image above, making a protective canopy for them below.

A **Watcher** stands on the **North** side. This one stands to look at all those who intended to do evil deeds but did not do them; [it is recorded] so that they do not come to sin or take hold of it.

**Honor** <note>original: "Yekara"</note> stands on the **West** side. It stands to look at all those who labor in the Torah and takes their images to the King of Freedom <note>a mystical reference to the Binah or the realm of liberation</note>. For all those who look upon this, when a person is ill and they are troubled over him, it is made known to him that [the Watcher] looks upon his merits and his deeds, and returns to them to have mercy on him. For whoever looks upon that sick person and considers his merits, he stands in prayer before the Holy One, blessed be He, and causes life to be found for him and for his spirit to be at rest. Regarding this, it is written:

> **“Happy is he who considers the poor; the Lord will deliver him in the day of evil.”** <note>Psalms 41:2</note>

What is meant by "the day of evil"? It is the day that [the Accuser] seeks to seize him. Rather, it is the day when that "Evil" <term>the Angel of Death or the Accusing Force</term> has permission to take his soul. "Happy is he who considers the poor"—this "poor" one refers to the sick person, just as you might say:

> **“Why are you so haggard [poor], O son of the king?”** <note>2 Samuel 13:4; using the word "Dal" to mean physically weak or diminished</note>

And because of this, "the Lord will deliver him in the day of evil." These are the ones who look upon that sick person to find rest for him from his sins before the Holy One, blessed be He, as we have established. This Palace stands over him to be found, and on the day when judgment rests upon the world, merit will be gathered, for "the Lord will deliver him in the day of evil." The day when the seal of judgment enters into that "Evil" to curse the world, all these stand to be found on the day of the Holy One’s wrath. When the Holy One, blessed be He, raises a cry over the world, and a voice like a **Shofar** <term>a ram's horn used for spiritual awakening</term> comes to be found, then all of them gather and stand before the Holy One, blessed be He. At that time, what is written?

> **“...looking through the windows, peering through the lattices.”** <note>Song of Songs 2:9</note>

From where do they look? From a narrow place where one sees and yet does not see everything that is needed. And afterward, "looking through the windows"—this is a place of greater vision, where the openings are opened for mercy upon all. When the Holy One, blessed be He, has pity on the world, He looks through these "windows" and "lattices" and has compassion on everything. Then, when **Honor** <note>Yekara</note> blasts that Shofar, that voice awakens the Supernal Voice which emerges from the Shofar of Life. It is comprised of fire, water, and spirit <note>the three primary elements in Kabbalah representing Judgment, Mercy, and Balance</note>. Then a herald goes out and proclaims in all the firmaments, saying:

> **“The voice of my beloved! Behold, he comes... looking through the windows, peering through the lattices.”** <note>Song of Songs 2:8-9</note>

Then all of them know that the Holy One, blessed be He, has pity on Israel. Those "Honors" <note>the angelic supports</note> return and complete their counsel on earth to awaken mercy from above. It is written:

> **“Happy is the people who know the joyful sound [the Teruah]...”** <note>Psalms 89:16</note>

## The First Palace

->**Purpose:** This palace stands to observe those righteous ones below; it is the palace that stands to observe the Spirit of Faith.<-

**The Entrance:** One gate stands in this palace, and one appointee is over it. That appointee is called **Sanurya**. This appointee stands at this entrance in order to find merit for the people before their Master, so that the **Other Side** <term>Sitra Achra; the realm of spiritual impurity or "the left side" that seeks to accuse humanity</term> shall not rule over them. Within this palace stands a single Spirit (Ruach) that is comprised of four spirits. It is comprised of four colors: white, red, green, and black. Fortunate is the spirit that stands comprised of all of them. He is called **Surya**, a great chief over all those matters that hang there, and all of them stand beneath him. From them, there are appointees under that Spirit who closes and opens all their keys; all of them are delivered into his hand. Three times a day, all those gates are included and stand beneath him, and from him they are nourished. This one stands in all the secrets of his Master; all the supernal treasures are delivered into his hand. This Spirit is not revealed, and because of this, this palace is called the **Palace of Love** (Heichal Ahavah), because here are hidden all the secrets of love for one who needs to cleave to Him. And here is the Spirit of which it is written: 
> "The Song of Songs, which is Solomon's" (Song of Songs 1:1)

This Spirit is the guardian of all supernal guardians, and he is not called "Guardian of Israel" but "Guardian of the Covenant," because here he is the guardian of all supernal treasures. A thousand treasures of his Master are hidden within him. From here go forth insights and mercies for those below because the Spirit is awakened in them. These colors within him are four, included one within the other. When they seek to be included as one, each one brings forth a holy matter called **Zohar** <term>Splendor or Radiance; the namesake of this mystical commentary</term>, and regarding this living creature it is written:
> "If the water was missing, let him bring a loaf to the priest" <note>original: a reference to the Mekhilta, a collection of legalistic biblical interpretation</note>

From this palace go forth all holy mercies that stand in the endurance of the supernal bonds. For the pious ones of the bonds go out to the path of mercy for the existence of the soul for all those sides that are below it when it descends. This is the Spirit of which it is written, "for by everything that proceeds out of the mouth of the Lord does man live," because in this palace stand all the souls and all the bodies that are destined to be stretched forth in time, from the day the world was created. Because of this, this palace holds all those souls that go out from that place that flows and emerges. Because of this, this palace does not stand forever in the firmament, and its waters are not destroyed, for the souls of Hebron <note>referring to the Patriarchs buried in the Cave of Machpelah in Hebron</note> did not enter here. And when those souls are completed, this will stand like a firmament, and then the King Messiah will come, and this palace will be awakened above and the palace will be awakened below. And in the secret of this palace it is written: "The light of the righteous is like the dust of the earth..." because this palace is that Spirit we mentioned. And this living creature that emerges, two lights, all of them are bound one to the other. Their portion is all **Shaddai** <note>original: "סדי"; one of the names of God, often translated as 'Almighty'</note>. If they search **Shaddai**, and those below are joined one to another, and above one to another, and it is called **Shaddai** because it emerges from the totality of this structure. And this diagonal joins all those mercies that stand below. The palace below is called **Merit** (Zakhuta) after the name of this Spirit we mentioned. This **Shaddai** nourishes all those below and all those palaces and all those who stand outside, who trust in this. They search the pegs of the Tabernacle as we have established. And for this, it is called **Shaddai**. And because it provides food for all those below, as much as it receives from the right side, there go forth those lights that search the **Flaming Sword which turns** <note>referring to the angelic defense of Eden in Genesis 3:24</note>, because it turns into several colors. And we have established that these awaken the palace in faithfulness to the world, and they are...

Dismissed...

<meta>This page continues the description of the heavenly realms. Having concluded the description of the first and second palaces, the text briefly explores the influence of the "Other Side" (the demonic realm) before ascending to the Third Palace of the holy side, which is the realm of Divine Will and Love.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

From the side of **Samael** <note>the primary accusing angel and personification of evil in Jewish mysticism</note>, when this spirit spreads out and blows strongly—following the way of all those "sides" <term>the Sitra Achra or "Other Side"</term> which are demons that push the weak to every side—just so, from that spirit they emerge to every side. They produce another "living creature" <note>original: "חיותא" (Chayuta); here referring to a spiritual entity or angelic/demonic being</note> that is appointed over those who are called **the flaming sword which turned every way** <note>Genesis 3:24; referring to the guards of Eden</note>. This is called a **Flame**, and it is appointed over the world. 

During a time when famine is seen in the world and the world is judged by it, then this living creature is appointed over the world. It brings forth a spirit of the altar for all those children of faith <note>the righteous</note> so that they shall not die in the famine. But it rages against all the others, for it comes from the **Other Side**. When it rules over the world with famine, it subdues two impure spirits called **Obstructer** <note>original: "Sod"; likely referring to an entity that blocks the flow of blessing</note> and **Famine**. This is the spirit that decrees, and the famine strengthens. These spirits stand in the world and create an accusation against human beings. One organizes and repeats the accusations, and the other devours like a **serpent** but tastes nothing, because the evil spirit rules the world. 

One living creature produces a certain longing <note>original: "kisufa"; literally 'shame' or 'longing/paling'</note> that emerges from the wings of the **Intermediate ones** <term>Beinonim; those whose deeds are balanced between merit and guilt</term>, who are said to change into many colors. These Intermediate ones are called **Seraphim** <note>literally "burning ones"</note>; they stand for a moment and then fly away.

In this palace, there are two pale <note>white</note> appointees who stand over a thousand and ten thousand myriads of angels called "the Overturners" and "the Strong," and others called **Pomegranates** <note>original: "Rimonim"; likely symbolizing those full of merit</note>. All of them stand in humility. These are for the benefit of the **Love** <term>Rechimuta</term> between Israel below and the Holy One, blessed be He, above. All of them awaken love and stand at a signal. When love is awakened from below to above, and from above to below, then this palace is filled with good wisdom, the wisdom of kindness, and hidden mercies. 

Then, the love from below is within the supernal love. This is what is meant when it is said that it covers and subdues two appointees called **Darkness** <note>original: "Chashka"</note> who are over the joy of the palace. These stand to watch over all those who unify the **Unification** <term>Yichud; the declaration of God's oneness</term> of their Master with love. They raise it up like a hammer-strike of love, and they rise and are bound above. And all those who perform **kindness** <term>Chesed</term> in the world—those kind deeds ascend and enter into this palace. They are crowned there and then ascend to be crowned within the **Supernal Kindness**. Concerning this it is written:
> "For Your kindness is great above the heavens." <note>Psalm 108:5</note>

In this palace it is also written:
> "Many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it..." <note>Song of Songs 8:7</note>

---

->**The Third Palace**<-

This is the palace called **The Palace of All Will** <term>Heichal d'Chela Ratzon</term>, where the spirit rests from the mouth of the Lord <note>original: "pi YHVH"</note>, the joy of the attachment of all. Here is the **Will of Wills** <note>original: "Re'u de-Re'u"; the highest, most essential desire of the Divine</note> when it rests, as it is written:
> "Your lips are like a thread of scarlet." <note>Song of Songs 4:3</note>

This is the will of the entire assembly that emerges from the voice of the mouth of the Lord. This palace is the Palace of Will, where all the prayers and all the requests of the world stand. Because the will of all wills, when they ascend, is found in the "No" <note>unclear; likely referring to the Ayn or the unknowable source</note>, as it is written, "And Jacob awoke" as a sign. At that time, when this is attached to that, it is called a **Time of Will** <term>Et Ratzon</term>. For then the shards are lifted, along with all the pale shards. 

When prayers ascend, then it is a "Time of Will" to be found. Concerning this it is written:
> "But as for me, let my prayer be to You, O Lord, in a time of favor." <note>Psalm 69:14</note>

For here, one is blessed with the other. In this palace stand six gates: four gates to the four directions of the world, one above, and one below. Within these gates, one spirit is drawn down, a great pressure over all of them, who is appointed over all these gates—and his name is a mystery. He is drawn down and appointed over all those supernal spirits that speak "mouth to mouth," which are the **Kisses** <note>original: "neshikin"; a metaphor for the union of divine levels</note> of one to the other, in the love of loves. These gates do not stand to be revealed. When they are opened, then all the palaces, all those spirits, and all those guards know that the Gates of Will are opened. They do not act because of the gates, but because of the will of the prayers, the will of the praise, and the will of the supernal holy crowns. This is the palace—whoever reaches this palace gathers and draws in love, and kisses like droplets in this palace...

<summary>This page describes the transition from the harsh judgments of Samael's realm to the Third Palace, the Palace of Divine Will. It emphasizes how human acts of kindness and prayer with love ascend to this realm to create a spiritual union or "kiss" between the earthly and divine levels.</summary>

<meta>This page continues the exploration of the Third Palace within the heavenly realms. While the previous page discussed the "Other Side" and the forces of famine and accusation, this page shifts to the holy side of this realm, describing the union of divine lights, the role of the great Archangels, and the mystical process of healing.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

-> Pekudei <-
<note>Pekudei is the final Torah portion of the Book of Exodus, focusing on the accounting of the Tabernacle's materials. In the Zohar, it serves as a basis for describing the "Palaces" of the spiritual world.</note>

This one with that one. And regarding this it is written: <note>Song of Songs 1:2</note> **"Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth..."** for there are no "kisses" of joy and desire of one with the other—delighting all together—except from a higher radiance. Come and see, and be strengthened by the word that is written: <note>Song of Songs 4:1</note> **"Behold, you are beautiful, my love,"** and it is written: <note>Song of Songs 4:3</note> **"Your lips are like a scarlet thread,"** and they are accustomed to answering like a voice, as it is written: <note>Song of Songs 1:16</note> **"Behold, you are beautiful, my beloved, yes, pleasant,"** and it is written: <note>Song of Songs 5:13</note> **"His lips are lilies, dripping flowing myrrh."** 

This spirit below holds in its hands all those souls that awaken a longing of love for the Above and the below as one. These are the "higher souls," such as <term>Rabbi Akiva</term> <note>a primary sage of the Mishnah and a central figure in Jewish mysticism</note> and his companions, who drew near to gaze upon the "male light" <note>the active, giving aspect of Divinity</note>. This is the light of the souls that are tested there and pass through it, as we have established. 

Come and see: This spirit brings forth twelve lights. All of them stand within the spirit that is beneath this spirit, corresponding to the four directions of the world. There are four higher lights that rule the four directions:

On the **South side** stands a higher light, the "Right" of the entire world. From this side, Israel strives to bring down Kindness <note>original: *Chesed*</note> into the spirit of faith. Look and see <term>Michael</term>, the great commander of the higher light that descends from the South side, for there the light stands in its full strength. This **Michael** is the "Light of the Right," the great advocate <note>original: *epitropos*</note> of Israel, because he stands at the "Eastern Connection" to look upon Israel. Then Michael argues for them and becomes their defender <note>original: *sanegor*</note> against the prosecution <note>original: *katigor*</note> of the "Other Side" <note>the demonic realm</note>. Through the clouds <note>spiritual coverings</note> of the children of Israel, they are saved from that accusation whenever the Right side of Jerusalem is strengthened; then the righteous prevail. Michael is the testimony of the East, and Michael's argument for Israel is recognized, and then He <note>God</note> treats them well with His right hand in the face of the enemy.

From the **North side** stands another light. This one stands to nullify harsh Judgment <note>original: *Din*</note>. Its greatness is inclined toward healing, for the "Priestly Gate" is open to those who enter from this side. They wait for that healing, and when judgment comes, they find support here. This light on the North side performs judgment, but it is not handed over to the "Other Side" <term>Sitra Achra</term>, because all the judgments performed by it are for the sake of **healing** <note>original: *asvuta*</note>. It is like a compress wrapped around a wound; it performs kindness through those entries. <term>Gabriel</term> <note>the Archangel of Strength and Judgment</note> is this light on the North side. In every place he reaches, he brings kindness, because Strength <note>original: *Gevurah*</note> is included within both sides <note>Mercy and Judgment</note>. Therefore, he strikes and heals. On this side stands the spirit of which it is written: <note>Psalms 103:17</note> **"But the kindness of the Lord is from everlasting to everlasting upon those who fear Him..."** These are the "suffering of love" <note>original: *yissurin de-rachamuta*</note>, which are entirely found on this side and that side.

On the **East side** stands another light. It stands over all matters of healing, like Michael before the sick. All those below who are ill are brought near at certain times to those "drops" <note>of light</note> that are drawn from the realm of faith. They are hidden from the world every single day so that healing may be completed according to the command of the King. This light is <term>Raphael</term> <note>the Archangel of Healing</note>. Although we have placed him on the "other side" <note>referring to a different structural layout elsewhere</note>, here he takes hold of this side and that side—the side of Michael and the side of Gabriel. This is the healing that comes at the hour when a person is judged in the Heavenly Court <note>original: *Heichala de-Bei-Dina*</note> to be punished; he then precedes the judgment with healing. This healing emerges from a state of "constriction" <note>original: *de-chiku*</note> because it emerges from two sides. This constriction comes from the Left side, but the healing comes from the Right side. 

Therefore, when a sick person is given healing, it comes to them out of great distress. So it is on the **West side**. Although Raphael is in the East, it is established that the West side is also for healing. They assist one another, but the source is from the East, as from there it is drawn downward. In this side is a single light, and joy is found there. It is the "freedom of the child," included in the "Priestly" aspect, and it stands as a forgiveness for all. It has three sides for every two, because each one is a pioneer, included in the scales of balance...

<summary>This page describes the Third Palace of the heavenly realm, focusing on the Archangels Michael, Gabriel, and Raphael as manifestations of Divine Mercy, Judgment, and Healing across the four cardinal directions. It explains how even divine judgment (Gabriel) and suffering can be a form of "healing" intended to purify the soul.</summary>
