<meta>This page continues the discussion of the celestial Palaces (Heikhalot), shifting from the general structure of the Third Palace to the "Four Foundations" (Elements) that support these realms. It explores the mystical journey of the soul through these elements, specifically referencing the famous Talmudic account of the four sages who entered the "Pardes" (the Divine Orchard) and the varying fates they met based on their spiritual alignment.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

-> Pekudei <-

For these are the **four lower foundations** <note>original: "arba yesodin tatin"; the four elements of Fire, Water, Air, and Earth</note> upon which everything hangs and stands. All of them are bound one to another. From them, waters of ice and a sword descend below and flow into the spirit. There are twelve walls standing beneath these, within that spirit we mentioned. Within that spirit, they ascend into all these twelve, and they are called "those who have hope," for there are other supports for them to exist in all, and all of them are completed as one. All are specified, three for each side. These four pillars stand to raise and lower this Palace above, after it is called "spices," to be joined and clung to one another as one. Beneath these are many levels upon levels, all of which emerge from them. These are the lower foundations: some from the side of **Water**, some from the side of **Fire**, some from the side of **Spirit**, and some from the side of **Earth**.

In this same manner, we have learned: there are four wings to the **Pardes** <note>original: "Pardes"; literally "Orchard," referring to the highest realm of mystical ascension</note>, and all were clarified for this place. These are the four foundations, and each one is bound in its place: this one on the side of Fire, this one on the side of Water, this one on the side of Spirit, and this one on the side of Earth. All were submerged in their own foundation. As we have walked with that "faithful messenger" who comes from the right side and clings to his days, he ascended above. When he reached this place called the **Palace of Love** <note>original: "Heikhal Ahavah"</note>, he clung to it with the "legs of his heart." He saw the Palace standing, covered, to be joined with the Palace above, like the "chariot of Hezekiah." Then he gazed into the **Spirit of Faith**. They ascended and saw Love, and he took it like the chariot of Hezekiah. Then he gazed into the Spirit of Faith and his "opening" <note>likely referring to a spiritual perception or orifice</note> was in this ice and sword, and all were his portion.

All those others <note>referring to the sages who failed the ascent</note> descended below, each one being delayed by that foundation which descends downward. One was weakened below on the side of the **spleen** <note>associated in medieval medicine/mysticism with melancholy and the "Other Side"</note>; a blockage whispered within him, and he did not ascend. He encountered that **Other Side** <note>original: "Sitra Achra"; the realm of evil or impurity</note> which is called "Another God" <note>original: "El Acher"</note>. Repentance was withheld from him, and he was driven away because he clung to it. For this reason, he is called **Acher** <note>original: "Acher"; "The Other," the name given to the sage Elisha ben Abuyah after his apostasy</note>, as we have established. 

Another entered into the foundation of **Earth** and dwelt there. He reached the boundaries of the Earth which belong to that Other Side; he was stirred by that dust and died. Concerning this, it is written:
> **"Precious in the eyes of the Lord is the death of His pious ones."** <note>Psalm 116:15</note>

Another saw and entered into the foundation of **Spirit** (Air). He encountered a "strange spirit" that reached the side of impurity. Because of this, he was struck by it and his mind was not restored; all [the lights] were hidden from his eyes. Regarding this, Solomon said:
> **"There is a vanity which is done upon the earth: that there are righteous men to whom it happens according to the work of the wicked..."** <note>Ecclesiastes 8:14</note>

This is because they went and entered into these levels and were delayed. Come and see: because **Rabbi Elazar** <note>The text says "Rabbi Elazar," but the context of the Pardes story usually identifies the survivor as Rabbi Akiva</note> ascended above as is fitting, he entered in peace and departed in peace. He went and labored and was not harmed, as it is written:
> **"From men of Your hand, O Lord, from men of the world, whose portion is in life..."** <note>Psalm 17:14</note>

Until when will these be entangled among the "slain of the worlds"? Fortunate are the righteous who do not lose their hope because they were delayed. Come and see: "From men of Your hand, O Lord, from men of the world, whose portion is in life"—here are two sides: "Your hand, O Lord" and "the world." "Your hand, O Lord" refers to the Holy One, Blessed be He, and the assembly that enters before Him. "From men of the world" refers to the Other Side of the body... as it is written: "and man is no longer wise with... the world."

Come and see: the assembly of these is for the observation of the **Holy Spirit** for those ten lower spirits as is fitting. Their body was delivered to the other kingdom; each one took his portion... And come and see: the head and beginning of faith is within **Thought** <note>original: "Machshava"; the Sefirah of Hokhmah/Wisdom</note>. The **Lamp of Darkness** <note>original: "Bozina de-Kardinuta"; the primordial, powerful spark of creative energy that carves out the structures of existence</note> struck, and the lamp ascended like stars; it threw sparks to three hundred and twenty sides and refined the waste from within Thought. It was clarified—behold, look at these—so that they are found seeing the support, and it pushes when it ascends as one in the intellect...

<summary>This page explains how the four physical elements (foundations) act as spiritual gateways or Palaces, illustrating the dangers of mystical ascent through the story of the four sages in the Pardes, where only the one aligned with "Faith" survives unscathed.</summary>
<keywords>Four Foundations, Elements, Palace of Love, Pardes, Acher, Elisha ben Abuyah, Rabbi Akiva, Lamp of Darkness, Machshava, Other Side, Sitra Achra</keywords>

--- Page 511 ---
<meta>This page continues the exploration of the spiritual realms following the discussion of the four foundations. It moves from the internal moral state of a person—comparing the "poor and wise youth" (the good inclination) to the "old and foolish king" (the evil inclination)—to the physical-spiritual mechanics of the First and Second Heavenly Palaces (Heichalot). It emphasizes how actions in the physical world, like Sabbath joy and charity, resonate in the celestial structures.</meta>

## Main Text (Zohar)

-> Pekudei <-

Just as a guard fulfills his duty and departs, so too is the eye focused on the goal, for the benefit of wisdom which blinds the [outwardly] seeing. **Better is a poor and wise youth** <note>Ecclesiastes 4:13; traditionally interpreted by the Zohar as the Good Inclination (*Yetzer HaTov*), which is 'poor' because it has no power of its own in the body initially.</note> for it is not just to eat, drink, and be merry, but rather to labor in the fullness [of Torah]. Come and see the lack of a Priest, for the children under the sun [are as nothing], and **I praised the dead who have already died** <note>Ecclesiastes 4:2</note>. Does King Solomon really praise the dead? Rather, "I praised the dead" refers to the joy of the Holy King at a time when hardship rules the world. In those days, of all the deeds a person performs, nothing is better "under the sun" <note>Ecclesiastes 3:12</note> than to rejoice, a joy found in that building where he is given a portion in the **World to Come** <note>original: "Alma d'Ate"; the afterlife or the future state of spiritual perfection</note>. What is the meaning of "it is our portion in our labor"? See, the **Holy One, blessed be He** <note>original: "Kudsha Brich Hu"</note>, considers it "ours," and honor is with Him above in the World to Come. See, when the Holy One, blessed be He, sees one who eats, drinks, and rejoices, whoever desires to eat and drink [for the sake of Heaven] is "ours" to the Holy One, blessed be He. In that portion, He gives him double upon double for everything he desired. Through these two—[the body and the soul]—a person follows the Holy One, blessed be He, for all of life is for him to trust. And when he desires [joy] on Sabbaths, festivals, and holy days, he holds everything for the Holy One, blessed be He, and everything is [as if] **He who is kind to the poor lends to the Lord, and He will repay him for his deed** <note>Proverbs 19:17</note>. Because of this, this is the Name and this is the matter of Life, and this is Death; this is Good and this is Evil; this is **Eden** <note>Paradise</note> and this is **Gehinnom** <note>Purgatory/Hell</note>.

Everything exists in opposition, one against the other. Because of this, their souls were established in this matter, and the beast in its place. And when those ten who investigated <note>Likely a reference to the Ten Martyrs or the sages who entered the Pardes</note> were destroyed, they were from the **Other Side** <note>original: "Sitra Achra"; the realm of impurity or evil</note>, and another place of holiness was prepared. Because of this, everything stands before the Holy One, blessed be He, and is made as is fitting. In this **Palace** <note>original: "Heichala"</note> stand those twelve [pillars]; these four are above and eight are with them—children—for each one carries two with him, just as they are the circuit of the twelve tribes [banners]. And so it is in the desert below unto infinity; all the **faithful** <note>original: "meheimna"</note> levels. From this [Palace] emerge all those halls and all those desires of desires that were made in love. And when they ascend into this Palace, all are rectified in the Holy One, blessed be He. Every day and every time they are recorded, they are joined; then He and everything holy, the Holy One, blessed be He, delights in the assembly of the righteous. What is this delight? It is that they bring those records close, and they are first to receive the pleasure. Regarding this it is written: **Then you shall delight in the Lord** <note>Isaiah 58:14</note>.

This Palace was established so that all those lower Palaces are included within it. This is the **First Palace** where that **Spirit** <note>original: "Ruach"</note> we mentioned stands. All those living beings that are supported [by it] are "crowns" supporting the East side, crowns supporting the South side, crowns supporting the West side, and crowns supporting the North side. These are the supports, and they are called the "pegs" <note>original: "yatidot"; referring to the structural supports of the Tabernacle</note> and they stand outside. When the King enters, he takes those pegs and they are uprooted from their places. There are cords that laugh [vibrate] and other supports apart from those pegs we mentioned. That First Spirit, which is inside the **Second Holy Palace**, enters and is included within that second one. The Second Spirit, within which they laugh, calls to the supports on the Eastern side, [the ones] that support from the outside upon twelve thousand **ministers** <note>original: "memanim"; angelic or spiritual overseers</note>, all of whom are called the "pegs of the Tabernacle." This one is to the right and that one to the left, leaning and supported upon twelve thousand other ministers. All of them are "pegs," as we said. Other ministers are supports appointed to the Southern side, one for its assistance and one for its sides; each and every one over twelve thousand other ministers. They are never removed from their dominion. All of these are ministers over the existence of the world. These are the "laughing ones" who stand in the existence of those who were poured out in the weighing, like a chain of males and females, one with the other. And these are called "kings" <note>original: "melochi"</note>. Regarding this it is written in [the Book of] Kings above, but it is not those of whom it is written "kings" as we have said. All these laugh and ascend one with the other, and no one ascends higher than the other; they ascend and join as one, and they are called a "male company."

<summary>This page interprets biblical verses about human joy and charity as spiritual "loans" to God that build the soul's portion in the afterlife. It then provides a structural mapping of the First and Second Heavenly Palaces, describing their angelic ministers, supports, and the "pegs" that hold the celestial Tabernacle together.</summary>

<meta>This page continues the description of the heavenly Palaces (Heikhalot) within the section of Parashat Pekudei. It transitions from the conclusion of the First Palace’s structural details into the descriptions of the Second and Third Palaces. ## Main Text (Zohar)

->**Pekudei**<-

<note>original: "Pekudei"; meaning "Accountings," the name of the final Torah portion in the Book of Exodus.</note>

Male and female act as one, and because of this, there is a partnership above. Even though at times a matter is assisted [from elsewhere], this commandment is exceedingly great, and they are joined as one; and regarding this, we have established it. There are other appointees to the **North** side who are two supports: <term>Pethahiel</term> <note>The "Opener of God."</note> and <term>Atriel</term> <note>The "Crown of God."</note>. Each one is appointed over twelve thousand others, and they are the "pegs of the Tabernacle." All the others, as we have said, are appointees. There are two other supports to the **West** side: <term>Pedahiel</term> <note>The "Redeemer of God."</note> and <term>Tanihiel</term> <note>The "Consoler of God."</note>. ## The Union of the Palaces

And this shall be joined with that so as to become a single voice in perfect unity, as is fitting. And all of it is the portion of one who knows the secret of the whisper <note>Refers to the silent or whispered prayers/meditations that effect changes in the upper worlds.</note> as it appears to him properly. Their portions are shared in this world and in the world to come. Concerning this it is written: **Behold my servant, whom I uphold...** <note>Isaiah 42:1</note>. Praised are the righteous who know the mercies of the Holy One, blessed be He, and who labor in the Torah day and night; for they know how to unify [the worlds]. The Holy One gives to everyone who knows how to unify His holy name properly, and all of it is his in this world and in the world to come. The binding of all these palaces shall be thus bound together.

<term>Jacob</term> <note>Jacob represents the Sefirah of Tiferet (Beauty/Balance) and acts as the central pillar that unifies the different spiritual directions.</note> is the binding of all faith; a spirit that stands to receive their spirit from below. All of them are spirit, and this is the fifth of the spirits. 

The <term>Third Palace</term> contains those sides where spirit cleaves to spirit, and they are all "kisses from the kisses of His mouth" <note>A reference to Song of Songs 1:2, symbolizing the highest level of spiritual union or 'dveikut'.</note>. Every side is meant for the lower spirit to cleave to the upper spirit, and these sides are hidden so that the spirit below may bind with the spirit above. When spirit cleaves to spirit, then the hidden upper spirit dwells upon this lower spirit. Until this is awakened to bind spirit to spirit, these sides surround the union, and the other "edges" <note>original: "seifin"; refers to the extremities or extensions of the divine light.</note> shine as an addition, and one spirit cleaves to the other. Then all the edges move and all their parts are bound, group to group.

And if you ask: who awakens the lower edges? Behold the upper edges! The edges are constantly awakening toward the higher ones. When it is time for this to be like a light, the flame of wisdom below always awakens toward the white flame above <note>The "white flame" often represents the Sefirah of Keter or Chesed—pure, undifferentiated mercy.</note> in order to cleave to it and be protected under it. And this spirit [says]: **O God, keep not thou silence; hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.** <note>Psalm 83:2</note>. 

When <term>Jacob</term> takes everything into the <term>Second Palace</term>, he is then called by the complete, supernal Holy Name. And if you say "complete in everything," see this: only when all these palaces are completed is the whole called by the full name **YHVH Elohim** <note>The Lord God; the combination of the name of Mercy (YHVH) and the name of Judgment (Elohim).</note>. This is the complete name. Until these palaces are joined to one another with a voice, the name is not called complete. When all are joined as one, these within those, then everything ascends from the shadow and from below, and the light of the whole is above as one. It dwells over everything to bind all as one, so that all becomes one.

The spirit of the King, <term>Jacob</term>, takes four sides and includes them within himself. He hovers over them, for we have established that this matter concerns another spirit that stands between two worlds. This spirit of all, when Jacob takes this palace—which is the **Sixth Palace**—he takes and includes within himself all those four sides, the four kings <note>Likely referring to the four "camps" of the Shekhinah or the four archangels.</note>, and all of them cleave to this palace. In the realm of separation, they are called as it is written: **and from there it was parted, and became into four heads** <note>Genesis 2:10</note>. Jacob takes these four heads, these four sides; he takes this palace. 

Then this palace is called <term>V’YHVH</term> <note>original: "And the Lord"; the addition of the letter 'Vav' (meaning 'and') signifies the inclusion of the Heavenly Court or the attribute of Mercy acting through Judgment.</note> when it is for good, as it is said: **And the Lord went before them by day** <note>Exodus 13:21</note>, and **And the Lord said: Shall I hide from Abraham...?** <note>Genesis 18:17</note>. 

And when <term>Isaac</term> <note>Representing Gevurah (Strength/Judgment).</note> is joined in the palace of the House of Judgment that searches for merit, then the whole is called <term>V’YHVH</term> to punish the wicked, as it is said: **And the Lord rained upon Sodom...** <note>Genesis 19:24</note>. All this is in one spirit, as is proper. When Jacob takes this palace, then the whole is called **Rejoice in the Lord, O ye righteous** <note>Psalm 33:1</note>, and "the voice of the turtle-dove is heard in our land" <note>Song of Songs 2:12</note>; this is a time of favor. 

From here onward, the palaces circle to join and bind one to another. Even though we have learned of the Southeast and so on, here they are all seen as one in the spirit of a single cleaving. From here, <term>Abraham</term> <note>Representing Chesed (Kindness/Grace).</note> begins on the right side, searching for love—the secret of which we have spoken. He takes the palace that searches for love; then he renews the intention, and all good things are suspended there to provide for and nourish everything from here. When they see the arrangement is prepared and they are suspended within supernal love, then this palace is called <term>Shaddai</term> <note>The Almighty; traditionally associated with the Sefirah of Yesod, which channels sustenance to the world.</note> as is fitting, and through it, the entire world is satisfied.

## The Palace of Merit

-> Pekudei <-
<note>Hebrew: "Accountings," the name of the Torah portion.</note>

When the world was created, it could not endure and would not remain standing until this palace was revealed through the longing of **Abraham** <note>In the Zohar, Abraham represents the quality of Chesed (Loving-kindness or Mercy).</note>. Once Abraham was revealed in this palace, it was then possible for the world to have a purpose—to be nourished by him and to be sustained. For this reason, it is not enough to simply call out; it is not enough for all things to be within it; rather, the Holy One, blessed be He, desired to dwell within it and to be established through it, as it is written:
> **That you may suck and be satisfied with the breast of her consolations, that you may drink deeply and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.** <note>Isaiah 66:11</note>
• For "her consolations" and "the abundance of her glory" both refer to the vision of this palace. In such a time, it is written that there is a living "Fortune" <term>Mazal</term> <note>Mazal here refers to the divine flow or influence that "drips" from the higher realms.</note> for Abraham the Beloved. He enters the opening because he has emerged into the vision of the "Fortune" of the Holy One, blessed be He. This is the place where those who are worthy awaken all the judgments of the world. These judgments are the **Left Arm** <note>Symbolizing Isaac and the attribute of Gevurah (Strength/Judgment).</note>, which is the root of all judgments; all judgments are awakened from it. The Living Vision and the Holy Union of this palace, which is called **Merit** <term>Zakhuta</term>, exist to connect the Spirit in the proper likeness. Everything is Truth, from the single structure of this vision of the Higher Judgment, and the marks of the judgments stand within it. This is the ancient place where the Holy Masters search and ascend, for there is no "face" that turns away from the vision above, and the vision is perfected as Judgment below. "All this is because there is a God who judges in the earth." <note>Psalm 58:12</note>. Those who are poor of spirit ascend there, and they all become a single vision.

In this palace, **Isaac** <note>Representing the attribute of Judgment.</note> is awakened, and all seventy-two "coverings" are included within him. Through them, all the judgments below are revealed, as it is written:
> **The matter is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones.** <note>Daniel 4:14; original Aramaic: "Bi-gezerat irin pitgama..."</note>
This is because they all stand within this "watcher" <term>Ir</term>.
> **The city of the Lord of Hosts, the city of our God.** <note>Psalm 48:9; The Hebrew word for city, "Ir," is spelled the same as "Watcher," an angel.</note>
Each of those celestial palaces is called a "city," for each is a "Watcher and a Holy One." These "Watchers" stand within the palace, residing in the city, and they search within it. This palace is included within Isaac, and all of it is within the Palace of Abraham, because the **Right** (Mercy) is included in the **Left** (Judgment). Come and see: each one is included in its fellow. We have established that when Abraham bound Isaac <note>The Akedah (Binding of Isaac) from Genesis 22.</note>, it was to include him within himself, so that the Left would be included in the Right, and the Right would be found presiding over the Left.

Even though the Holy One commanded Abraham to offer his son—who represents Judgment—and to prevail over him, He did not command Isaac directly, only Abraham. Because of this, it was found that Judgment was sweetened by Kindness <term>Chesed</term>, and all became one, included within each other. Here, the lower palaces are included in their Masters. When Isaac takes hold of this palace, the entire vision becomes a "Place of Goodness" through Merit. Therefore, a person who is purified should be purified through merit, because this is the Supernal Spirit, the perfection of the place. For there is no perfection of the Spirit except through Merit.

All of this is the complete vision of **Faith** <term>Meheimanuta</term> <note>This refers to the unified system of the Sefirot, the divine attributes.</note>, just as it is above in the Spirit below. We have explained and intended this to bury Judgment in the face of Merit. For when the place stands in Merit, the whole vision is in a single, perfect union, and the lower world is in perfection. Then, "her time shall not be diminished" <note>Exodus 21:10</note>, for the Accuser has no permission to deviate or to bring charges against the world. At that time, everything is in a single unity as is proper. Therefore, it is necessary for us to arrange our judgments in their proper order, unlike the people of Esau <note>In Kabbalah, Esau/Edom represents Judgment that is not tempered by Mercy.</note>, for they have no portion in our Crown of Faith, as it is written:
> **He has not dealt so with any nation; and as for His judgments, they have not known them.** <note>Psalm 147:20</note>
From the side of the "Other Side" <term>Sitra Achra</term>, anyone who has judgment without merit included in it is a vision of lack, which diminishes the Spirit of Faith and causes a clinging to that side where there is judgment without merit.

Come and see: when the **Sanhedrin** <note>The high court of seventy-one elders in ancient Israel.</note> sat below to judge capital cases, they were required to open the proceedings with "Merit" <term>Zakhuta</term> <note>Talmudic law requires that the defense (merit) be heard before the prosecution (judgment) in capital cases.</note>. This was in order to include merit within judgment. Furthermore, they are called "Vindicators of Merit." It is a strength below to be able to write and judge with merit, holding the staff to eventually complete the judgment from a place of righteousness, showing that merit is included in judgment, both above and below. Judgment within merit is the perfection of judgment; without this inclusion, there is no perfection. Because of this, he arranged and established...

## The Palace of Merit

-> Pekudei <-
<note>Hebrew: "Accountings," the name of the Torah portion.</note>

And they are joined as one. If there is no merit <note>original: "zakhuta"</note>, there can be no completion or wholeness. The portion of the meritorious is that the Holy One, blessed be He, gave them the Torah—a perfect wholeness and a path of truth, mirroring the pattern of the supernal realms above. Come and see: those who judge must first seek out merit so that all aspects may be included within one another. The witnesses testify, and the judges turn the judgment toward merit to integrate everything. This is done so that the **Other Side** <term>Sitra Achra</term> <note>The realm of evil or "the other side" of holiness in Kabbalistic thought.</note> does not take control. For as long as merit is found, the Other Side—which is called **Guilt** <note>original: "Chova"</note>—cannot attach itself to Judgment and become empowered. When Guilt attaches to Judgment, it creates a fierce wrath known as **Konam** <note>A term used in vows, here implying a binding, harsh restriction or anger.</note>.

Because of this, on the day of **Rosh Hashanah** <note>The Jewish New Year and Day of Judgment</note>, people must strive to incline the scales toward merit within the judgment, so that guilt does not prevail. Therefore, we require Merit and Judgment to exist as one for the sake of completeness. When the Other Side rules, there is "peace" in a negative sense—a peace of accusation and contention. This results in the **Four Capital Punishments** <note>The four methods of execution used by the ancient High Court (Sanhedrin).</note>. But when the side of Merit rules, all is life, peace, tranquility, loving-kindness, and mercy.

When the Other Side attaches to Judgment, accusation rules through the Four Capital Punishments of the Court: **Stoning, Burning, Slaying, and Strangulation** <term>Skila, Sreifa, Hereg, and Chenek</term>. These are all the dominions of the Accuser. **Stoning** corresponds to the "stone of stumbling." **Burning** corresponds to the "mighty fire" of destruction. **Slaying** corresponds to the "consuming sword," as it is said: *It shall consume flesh* <note>Exodus 15:9</note>; this is the side of Cain, the master of "all flesh." **Strangulation** <note>original: "Chenek"</note> is like the "exchanging knife" that rules over choking and swallowing, leaving nothing behind but a barren mountain. That "curse of God" rules from the side of the gates of darkness. Thus, one side is for good and the other for evil.

Israel requires the secret of **Faith** <term>Meimanuta</term> to protect themselves, so that the side of Faith may rule and give no mention or power to the Other Side. Those who merit this in this world and the world to come are those of whom it is written:
> **Your people shall all be righteous...** <note>Isaiah 60:21</note>
Just as there are supernal colors on the "Two Thighs" <note>Referring to the Sefirot of Netzach (Victory) and Hod (Splendor), which support the divine structure.</note> that support the Holy Torah, so too in this Palace there are two spirits—the Sun and the Moon. These correspond to the two lower "thighs" that support the supernal palaces called the **Oral Torah** <term>Torah she-be-Al Pe</term>. Just as there are supports for the **Written Torah** <term>Torah she-bi-Khtav</term>, there are supports for the Oral Torah, and they are included in one another. When these two lower supports join, they reflect the supernal patterns and draw down a spirit of life.

When they are joined, they stand in a holy place called "Straightforward" <note>original: "Nokhach"</note>, for all the holy hosts stand there, and all are called by the name of **Metatron** <note>The highest Archangel and "Prince of the Presence" in Jewish mysticism.</note>. Comfort and ease descend from that side. Even though we say that within that holy sign stands a messenger who reflects all things, the "thighs" that stand outside are what we call the **Baraita** <term>External Teachings</term> <note>The Baraitot are teachings of the Sages not included in the primary Mishnah.</note>, for the Baraita is found "outside." The **Mishnah** <term>Matnitin</term> is the secret of that which stands within; there, the root of all is taught. Regarding this secret, it is said: *Your father-in-law will bring you to the house and teach you.* This is the spirit of the Mishnah. When it enters the light and emerges from the house of the **Holy of Holies** <term>Kodesh HaKodashim</term>, it is written "he shall teach us." This spirit is called a "covering" or "tapestry" <term>Masechet</term> <note>A pun on the word Masechet (Tractate), linking it to the Hebrew word for a woven covering or molten image (Masecha).</note>, as it is said: *He spread this Torah as a covering.* Therefore, while the Baraitot are the "thighs" and contain secrets not permitted to be revealed—because they are not "sealed"—the secret is only for the eyes of the wise.

Woe to me if I reveal! Woe to me if I do not reveal! <note>A recurring Zoharic phrase expressing the tension between the danger of disclosing divine secrets and the necessity of teaching them.</note> For this is a supernal secret of the Holy One, blessed be He, written within. The "House of Running" stands in the days of the world to parallel the world above. Everything is found within the Holy of Holies, the place where the hidden mystery resides...

## The Secret of the Temples and the Foundation

-> Pekudei <-

In the scroll of the world, at the time of completion. But afterward, sins caused the inner mysteries to be overturned and they were pushed away from the **First House** <note>The First Temple of Jerusalem, associated with the Sefirah of Binah or Understanding.</note> and so on. When the **thighs** <note>original: "yarkhin"—referring to the Sefirot of Netzach and Hod, which act as the supports of the divine structure.</note> were judged, they stood outside, far from the secret of the divine paths, and they were drawn into the millstones of the **Second Temple**. They stood as "outer houses," and between them were the inner chambers, surrounded like the **Holy of Holies**. These are the essence of the Second Temple, but they were destined to be broken like the external creation because the "thighs" were displaced from the camp. A flaw was found, which is the secret of what is written: "For from the lower number comes the Torah." 

Later, when sins caused the dominion of the Second Temple to be removed, it leaned toward the **Left Side** <note>The side of Gevurah (Severity) and potential judgment.</note>. Why was the First House characterized by perpetual peace? Because it belongs to the **King of Peace** <note>A title for the Sefirah of Tiferet or the Holy One, Blessed be He.</note> continually. But the Second Temple did not have such peace, because the **Arlah** <term>Arlah</term> <note>Literally "foreskin," but in Kabbalah it refers to the "husks" or "shells" of impurity (Kelipot) that block holiness.</note> was hidden within it, acting as a constant accuser. The priests were prepared to subdue the accuser within this *Arlah*, to exchange the "circumcision" for the "accusation" <note>This refers to the spiritual labor of removing impurity through ritual service.</note>, so that it could rest upon the Second Temple, all according to the proper mystery.

Later, sins caused that *Arlah* to rule, and they were pushed out of the Second Temple to the exterior. They descended to the depths of the thighs below, until they were cast down to the **feet**. And when they dwell in the feet, then **His feet shall stand on that day** <note>Zechariah 14:4. This verse is traditionally associated with the era of the Messiah and the ultimate redemption.</note> and so on. Everything will be overturned to its proper state as is fitting. Even though they were pushed away, they were never fully removed from Him; they remained joined to Him. One who knows how to measure the dimensions of the Palace—reaching from the thighs to the feet—can know the calculated end of the exile below. 

A final wind blows between the "movers of the field" <note>A metaphor for the students of the Torah or the angelic forces.</note>, all within the supernal mystery. All these creations, all these structures, and all these hosts stand in their proper places. Some are outside, corresponding to the depths of the thighs that go outward and downward. All of them are the investigators of the **Oral Torah** <note>original: "Torah she-be-al peh"</note>, and all are recorded, and the males are drawn forth. When the exile ends at the reaching of the feet, then "His feet shall stand as on that day," and that spirit of impurity—the *Arlah*—will be removed from the world. Israel will be clarified as is fitting, found in their proper state. For that *Arlah* suppressed them below until it was closed off; but when the sign of this *Arlah* is repaired and removed from the world, then Israel will look as one, and then **Jacob** <note>original: "Yaakov"—etymologically linked to "Ekev," the heel.</note> will be like that "Eye and Heel" <note>original: "Ayin ve-Ekev"</note>, and no accuser will be found against them. At that time, the redemption of Israel will be in this world and the world to come.

**Joseph the Righteous** <note>The biblical Joseph, who in Kabbalah represents the Sefirah of Yesod (Foundation).</note> is the **Pillar of the World**. Within him, the Throne is hidden and concealed. His throne stands in the **Seventh Palace**. Even though many desire this palace, for the **Sapphire Stone** <note>referring to the "Sapphire Pavement" in Exodus 24:10.</note> is within his domain, it is he who prepares it. 

But come and see the joy of those who desire it: when the two levels below are joined, they are separated from one another from a distance—from the bone of **Luz** <note>A legendary indestructible bone or a mystical city, both representing the point from which resurrection begins.</note>—and they stand in the thighs like deep hollows. That which they investigate is considered "small" in comparison. From them and downward is the shell of Luz, until it reaches the feet at the exit from the lower Palace, which is called **the likeness of a pavement of sapphire** <note>Exodus 24:10.</note>. All the thighs are completed as one, and all the levels are prepared like many branches over this place. It is made into a house from the "Luz" of Joseph the Righteous. Let there be peace for all, let all [conflict] be nullified, because everything is to repair the Assembly; everything returns, daughter to her chest, in concealment. 

Come and see: when Joseph the Righteous stands to repair everything, then all [the accusers] will be nullified. When he is joined with the Palace, then all the sources of joy and the supernal will are awakened. They are all in one will, ready to rejoice above and below in one proper desire. All the lower beings stand like a plant, as it is written: **The righteous is the foundation of the world** <note>Proverbs 10:25</note>. Upon this Foundation <term>Yesod</term>, this world stands. For the Sapphire Palace does not stand in its permanence until this Joseph the Righteous repairs it. When he is repaired, everything is repaired at the head of the Foundation and all the windows. Regarding this, it is written "And He created," because this stands upon the Foundation. After the Foundation is repaired, everything is established

## Main Text (Zohar)

-> **Pekudei** <note>The name of the Torah portion, meaning "Accounts" or "Records."</note> <-

Those who approach it remain within the **supernal hiddenness**. This is the upper world that ascends and is crowned by its own supernal will within the concealment of all concealments, which is not known at all; there is no one who can stand and know it. It is a covering spread out from the "mouth" within the concealment of those things which are sealed. The **Mercy Seat** <note>original: *Kaporet*—the golden lid of the Ark of the Covenant.</note> is spread within the supernal hidden ones that are closed and sealed from the side of the hidden and concealed ones. 

And hidden from the Mercy Seat is a place, secret and concealed, to hide within it in secrecy the supernal greatness—the **Spirit of Life**—through the hand of that river that flows and goes out <note>This "river" usually represents the flow of divine emanation from the higher Sefirot.</note>, and one river called the "Source of All," whose waters never cease forever. And when this "eye" <note>A metaphor for divine providence or the source of light.</note> is open and hides all that holy greatness from above, it is the place of the **Holy of Holies**, as it is written: *And you shall put...* <note>Exodus 26:33: "And you shall put the veil under the clasps, and bring in the ark of the testimony there within the veil; and the veil shall separate for you the holy place from the most holy."</note> 

Those living **male principles** <note>original: *dechurin*</note> are filled, coming toward the **female principle** <note>original: *nukba*</note> who becomes pregnant and is filled by the male. Then, they receive all these living spirits and holy souls that are destined for the world; they are conceived there for the entire duration required and are delayed until the "drop" <note>The seminal drop of divine influence.</note> reaches its fullness. Then all those souls are poured out and they arrive and are called "the world" just as they were previously. At that time, it is prepared: *O Lord, according to Your works.* 

In this Palace stand delights and provisions for the spirits of their souls below, the work of the building of Eden <note>Referring to the Garden of Eden as a spiritual structure.</note>. Here is the "bosom of the generation of all" and the fruit of all, to join everything together as one and to be one bond of all in a single unity. It stands thus: for when all the drops and the upper ones join as one, and one as is fitting, they have no offspring and no delight except in the unity of this Palace; everything depends upon this "table." 

When they are called here to the completion of a single unity, then all the light of the drops, and all the light that covers, and all that was in their hearts, are freed and filled. Happy is the portion of one who knows how to arrange the arrangements and prepare the preparations for the meal in this world and in the world to come! And then all judgments and all evil decrees are removed and nullified from the world. 

This Palace is the **Palace of Pleasure**, the **Palace of Delight**, the Palace that is hidden below, upper and lower as one. It receives all the light of the **Supernal Lamp** <note>original: *Botzina Ila’a*—a term often used for the highest source of illumination or the soul of the teacher.</note> that shines for all and fixes everything as is fitting in perfect unity. Because of this, this Palace is the holiness of the concealment of all that is never revealed. 

Beneath all the hidden things, this is hidden and concealed to be a lasting **Covenant** <note>original: *Brit*—referring to the Sefirah of *Yesod*, which acts as the channel of procreation and connection.</note>, keeping everything as one—male and female—to be complete. This Palace is called the **Covenant of Life**, and of it is said "all the earth" <note>Referencing the verse "The Lord of all the earth."</note> because this is the place from which all souls go out to the world. It provides unity below, so that the unity of the **Holy One, blessed be He**, may be found from above to below, giving power to the **Righteous One** <term>Tzaddik</term> <note>The Tzaddik is the earthly counterpart to the Sefirah of Yesod (Foundation).</note>. For they go out from the Righteous One, and his eyes are revealed; and afterward they go out from the Righteous One, and his eyes are like the crown that goes out from there. 

This **Ark of the Covenant** <note>The text reads *Charon*, likely a variant or error for *Aron* (Ark).</note> grasps all; and from then and afterward, they go out from it, and his eyes look below. And his eyes are like this Ark of the Covenant so that all hidden things are included from above and from below, to be complete from all sides. 

**Come and see:** the source of the male never separates from the male forever. Because of this, this is the place of the completion of all, standing as the [foundation of] the whole body to be complete in general as is proper. Everything is a unity and a bond as one, so that upper and lower are one bond. All the ends are not separated from one another, and everything is found covered and protected. Regarding this we have learned: "One who conceals his bed..." <note>A Talmudic idiom for modesty in marital relations, here applied to the hiddenness of divine unions.</note> This is the correction of the "gaze of the coverings," to join everything as one and to find everything covered in a proper cleaving, as the verse says. 

Precisely there, and not... <unclear>illegible</unclear>. Two are lacking: Jacob [is lacking] and Joseph shall succeed below. Two "smiles" <note>The Aramaic *tiyuchta* can mean a smile or an opening/space.</note>: one is the lower Palace and one is this Palace of which it is written. Generations above are like these... as it is written: *And he was buried.* The "smile" below is like this smile of which it is written, *Joseph*, on the lower sides. The "basin of the flanks" is like the Ark.

## Main Text (Zohar)

-> **Pekudei** <note>The name of this Torah portion, meaning "Accounts."</note> <-

These are the impressions of the spirit that come from the side of Jacob. When the blood <note>original: *dama*—this may refer to the life-force or a specific mystical purification</note> is washed above to cleave to Him, it is <margin>purified/shined</margin> through those yearnings that strive for it within those **Spirits of Life** <note>original: *rucha d'chayye*</note> above, to be purified by them. The purification of Joseph is found below with the assistance of the **Female** <note>original: *Nukva*—referring to the Shekhinah, the Divine Presence</note>, for this **Palace** <note>original: *Heikhala*</note> includes spirits and gathers them to the lower level to ascend through it. These two sides are divided into two distinct aspects. The side of Jacob spreads out and gives strength to conquer those sixty <note>The text reads *sarei* or *sadi*, but contextually refers to the 60 mighty ones or channels</note> who are filled from that Spirit of Life. And it gives <gloss>strength</gloss> to those holy kings who are living and endure forever, who stand in the Law <note>original: *nimusa*</note> below to purify the inhabitants of the world. Therefore, these two sides stand—one above and one below—the one to be purified above and the one to exist below, each one as is fitting. Because of this, everything is one, and it is a single **Living Spirit**.

Despite all this, Joseph provides nourishment to the entire "body" <note>In Kabbalah, the "body" refers to the collective structure of the Sefirot or the community of Israel</note> and raises it up, striking the Spirit of Life to cleave to Jacob. And when everything is joined as one, those sixty channels <note>original: *zanki*</note> are filled for all. Because of this, everything is one, and all the portions are seen by those who know how to tie the **knots** <note>original: *kitrin*—referring to the binding of spiritual forces</note> and unify the **unification** <note>original: *yichuda*</note> by permission of the King, as is proper. This is done to join limb to limb, spirit to spirit, all in one general inclusion, so that all becomes one as it should be.

Come and see: when this Palace provides for the holy spirits and all those **Chariots** <note>original: *ratichin*—the angelic forces that "carry" the divine throne</note>, they are all unified as one and are found to be a single bond. These are the supports for the hidden unification, like the bond of all, as they said: to be bound together so that everything is complete in the perfection of **Male and Female** <note>original: *Dechar u-Nukva*</note> as one. This is the "Sacrifice," and there is no part of it that is not fitting for that smoke which ascends. Here it is proven in the bond of unification with an inner **Will** <note>original: *re'uta*</note>. By this decree, this Palace includes everything, palace within palace, spirit within spirit, until they both join limb to limb to be included as one, as is proper. For when everything is compressed together, the upper limbs into the lower ones, then the Most High of all is awakened and ascends through them all and illuminates them all. Then both the upper and lower beings are blessed.

And from that which is not known until the most hidden point—the Will that is never grasped—everything then ascends to the **Infinite** <note>original: *Ein Sof*</note> to be bound in a single knot. That hidden splendor, which is the covering of the highest concealment, ascends and illuminates everything. For this splendor above is the concealment of the "Fountain of Life" <note>original: *metzuna d'chayya*</note> that includes everything. It is hidden in that Will of **Thought** <note>The Sefirah of Chokhmah/Wisdom</note> to be opened within it. When the splendor from below stands and ascends, it is absorbed into it. Thus, everything is to be bound, joined, and blessed as a single **Unification**.

This is established as we have said: palaces within palaces, the lower within the upper, the spirit of Male and Female as one, a supernal splendor, a splendor of the hidden which is even more concealed. That which is concealed includes all, becoming more and more hidden until everything is properly immersed in a single unification. Because of this, Moses knew how to arrange the order of his Master better than all the people of the world. He needed to prolong the bond, as we have established:

> *Please, God, please heal her.* <note>Numbers 12:13. Moses' prayer for his sister Miriam. In Kabbalah, the brevity of this prayer suggests a direct connection to the highest source without need for long mediation.</note>

We have learned: one who prolongs his prayer in exile and gazes into it... I have come to the writing of the **Heart** <note>original: *Lev*</note>. Regarding this Heart, it is written:

> *And a good heart has a continual feast.* <note>Proverbs 15:15</note>

Because joy is the place that needs to be bound, and not to be prolonged, for everything stands above... so as not to draw it out but to bind it in the supernal bond, so that all becomes one.

One. And once it is bound as one, it does not need to extend or strengthen itself among the lower beings. This Name is above; this Name is in its perfection; this Name is below. The mystery of the "Living Spirit" <note>original: *Ruach d'Chayah*</note> of the Holy Name is one spirit of the whole upper world, according to the "Hiddenness of Hiddenness" <note>original: *Stimu d'Stimuta*—the most concealed aspect of Divinity</note> that is upon it and ascends. And the "Living Spirit" is one in the lower world, in the hiddenness of hiddenness of the spirit of the upper holy writing that is upon it. We have established that from this miracle, **four chariots** emerge, because each one is divided into four. Every chariot is four when the levels are observed, and thus all of them are "four within four," like the spirit of the Holy Name which is one. We see the chariots that stand and move as one, and they are called: **Lion, Eagle, Cherub** <note>The faces of the Chariot; usually Lion, Eagle, Ox, and Man</note>. These are nothing other than upper spirits, and there are lower ones. They stand on three sides and emerge from... <margin>from the portion of the south</margin> ...in the storm, and the Throne is the Assembly <note>The *Knesset Israel* or Shekhinah</note>. And these are the chariots that emerge from the portion of the south, for in them is the first proof. We see four chariots emerging from those two spirits, right and left, from the Assembly to the Sapphire, as we have said. These two spirits we mentioned are called "Two Mountains," and they are called as one. From these two spirits, which are called <note>Zechariah 6:1</note> **"Mountains of Brass,"** those four chariots we mentioned emerge in that division of the side that was fixed in the North, the destroyer that covers it. All of them are thousands upon thousands in the world, in the "Spirit of Redness" <note>referring to the attribute of Judgment</note>, because there is a chariot on horses that... <unclear>כסלי</unclear> ...it. And this is the Holy Name that is included in the name... <unclear>יול"ה כ"ח</unclear> ...as we established, that the portion is included in the name... <unclear>יול"ה כ"ח</unclear> ...and the living creature is its unification. It is said: **"God"** <note>original: *Elohim*</note> is not included in another name because there is <note>Jeremiah 10:10</note> **"the Living God and King."** It spreads to many sides and is neither gathered nor spread—the Name that includes every name: ... <unclear>יול"ה אל"ה וחי"ה</unclear> ...like the spirit below in the spirit of the Holy Name. By it, the Priest knew how to combine all its sides until the Name ascended in many directions, in **forty-two shades** <note>A reference to the mystical 42-letter Name of God</note>, in the partnership of the first merit of this Living Creature. It includes every name, and this Name includes every name. These judgments stand in these letters; all those extensions connect and go out and enter into the **Crown** <note>Keter</note> when it is gathered and spread. By the first merit, the letters are combined in the dwelling, and the letters ascend and go out below; by the spirit of these, it travels below, and these are chastened for the Upper Holy Ones.

## Main Text (Zohar)

->**Pekudei** <note>original: *Pekudei*—meaning "Accounts," the title of this Torah portion (Exodus 38:21–40:38).</note><-

To speak according to the order of the spirit of the letters, to provide wings for the unification of the letters, just as the Priest knew how to provide wings for the Names through the letters, which are many. **And the hands of a man were under their wings** <note>original Hebrew: *ve-yedei adam mitachat kanfeihem* (Ezekiel 1:8). In Kabbalah, "wings" often represent the movement of spiritual forces, while "hands" represent the reaching out of the Divine to receive human effort.</note>—all of them. These "hands" have been established as the spirits, appointees, those who turn, and those who wrap. These are the Cherubim, the Living Creatures (*Chayot*), and those who turn; all have wings, and hands beneath their wings to receive prayers and to receive those who return in repentance. These hands are "tunnels" <note>original: *chatirin*—a mystical concept of hidden passages in the heavens through which prayer and repentance can bypass spiritual obstacles.</note> and merits to receive human beings in their prayers and requests, to open gates to receive them, to speak, to tie spiritual bonds, and to fulfill their will. These hands stand for human beings to provide them with grace and favor. These are holy Names that rule over every single level, so that human beings can be established above in their prayers and requests at all the upper gates. Through this, the lower beings rule above, and this is the secret of: **Your hands have made me and fashioned me** <note>original: *yadekha asuni vi-yekhunnenu* (Psalm 119:73)</note>, which refers to these holy Names.

And the Lord said to Moses: "Stretch out your hand toward the heavens" <note>Exodus 10:22</note>. How could a human stretch his hand toward the heavens? Rather, this refers to the "windows" <note>original: *charkhin*</note> of everything, where one leans and brings down goodness from above to below. "Your hand" refers to the "tunnel" <note>original: *chatra*</note> of your own level, which is called by its name. This is the herald that supports the Holy One, and all those above and below are protected and sustained by these Names. Here, human beings ascend to the High Palaces <note>original: *Heikhalin*—the celestial halls or structures through which the soul or prayer travels.</note>, and there is nothing that is not within the hands. Blessed are those who know how to arrange the unification of their words as is proper, and to stand with the truth so they do not stray from the spirit of faith.

Come and see: within these Palaces, there is a High Spirit within the faith. All are linked and balanced, one with the other, to be included within each other for good, to be strengthened and sweetened so that bitterness is turned to good. At the hour when these upper Palaces are completed and arranged one with the other, the prayers and requests of one who knows how to arrange them ascend to be strengthened above, as is fitting. And these are the seven dwellings <note>original: *ha-ba’arot*—likely a variation referring to the structures or "burnings" of light</note> prepared below for the House of the King.

**The First Palace** <note>original: *Heikhala Kadmaa*</note>: A place of white light and pure brilliance, a beauty of pure white that is good, containing two sides, as we have established, the Right and the Left. It is white and vast. **How manifold are Your works, O Lord! In wisdom You have made them all** <note>Psalm 104:24</note>. All are turning wheels of the word, and this is the secret of the Image, etc. The Exalted King, the Holy Name is unified therein. All of the Holy Name is weighed in the crowns of the Names, and this secret ascends in whiteness and has been hidden since the days of old.

**The Second Palace** <note>original: *Heikhala Tinyana*</note>: This is "Blessed is the Great in Knowledge" <note>original: *Barukh Ghedol De’ah*</note>, the mysteries that include small letters. Here is the group that says "Holy" and "Blessed." Here the Living Creatures say: **Holy, and Blessed be the glory of the Lord from His place** <note>Ezekiel 3:12</note>.

**The Third Palace** <note>original: *Heikhala Talitaha*</note>: This is "Blessed in Pleasantness," may He be blessed.

**The Fourth Palace** <note>original: *Heikhala Revi’aha*</note>: Which sanctifies goodness every day continually, the work of creation. For here the lights and the pure words of those who desire life are rolled around, renewed as in the beginning, to be sustained in the world. This is the light of the spirit of life, as we have said.

**The Fifth Palace** <note>original: *Heikhala Chamishaha*</note>: The palace that investigates the world... **Who chooses His people Israel in love**. This is the palace for the eternity of the world... in the way that is fitting, all within the law, through this spirit.

**The Sixth Palace** <note>original: *Heikhala Shetitaha*</note>: Compassion and goodness, established and enduring. It is purified so as not to separate these palaces from one another, for they are like a drop of desire joining as one, to be tied to one another in the spirit of the holy Names that rule over each one.

**The Seventh Palace** <note>original: *Heikhala Shevi’aha*</note>: A spirit that dwells in awe, and no voice is heard. Here is the Will of the Heart <note>original: *re’uta de-liba*—the highest form of intent</note> to focus and to raise the Will upward until the Infinite <note>original: *Ein Sof*—the boundless, unknowable Godhead</note>, and to tie the bond of the firmament. Everything becomes one, from bottom to top and from top to bottom, to bring down all the blessings as is fitting from the Source of Life. This is the seventh level above, and this is the *Shekhinah* <note>The Divine Presence, viewed as the feminine aspect of God.</note>, the Will of the Heart, and the prayer of the letters of the seven high holy Names.

<meta>This page continues from the previous discussion regarding the ascent of prayer. ## Main Text (Zohar)

The **Seventh Palace** <note>original Aramaic: *Heikhal Shvi’ah*. This is the highest of the seven lower celestial palaces, serving as the interface between our realm of action and the higher divine emanations.</note> is a vision of the **Source of Life**. This is the first palace, hidden from all, looking from above to below; yet it is the seventh from below to above, so that they may join one with the other—the seventh with the seventh. It stands below to receive the joy that enters the Upper Palace. 

**"Blessed"** <note>original: *Baruch*—the opening word of most Jewish blessings.</note> is the **will** <note>original Aramaic: *re'uta*—meaning "desire" or "intent." In Kabbalah, the "will" is the driving force that connects the human heart to the divine levels.</note> of all the lower realms; all of them are satisfied, appeased, and reconciled. Within all these palaces, the will of the **Spirit of the Holy of Holies** dwells in tranquility. Thus, the word "Blessed" is used for all kinds of directions, blessings, and saturations that are completed within them. It is a place crowned with hiddenness, where all are sealed. When the letters arrive, there is no place that contains them from above <note>the scribe marks a secret/mystery here: <note>original: *ס'* likely an abbreviation for *Sod* (Secret)</note></note> except by hiding them in a treasury. 

This is the secret of the Name **Y-H-W-H**. And when a vision of longing <note>original: *kissufin*—the soul's yearning for God</note> takes hold of it, it ascends to be crowned above. This is the secret of what is written: **I will lift the cup of salvations** <note>Psalm 116:13. In Kabbalah, the "cup" represents the feminine divine presence, the *Shekhinah*, receiving the "wine" of divine flow.</note> to the King. And then, "everything she says shall be given to her." This is the secret of the words **Blessed are You** <note>original: *Baruch Atah*—the start of the Amidah prayer. "You" (*Atah*) is understood as a direct address to the *Shekhinah*.</note>. One must be found in this state, to bind the "will" in this secret. 

**The Lord our God** <note>original: *Y-H-W-H Eloheinu*</note>—this is the binding of the Upper King above. When He dwells within this "King," then everything she [the *Shekhinah*] says shall be given to her. This is the Spirit that is prepared to bless her. 

This is the secret of **God of Abraham, God of Isaac, and God of Jacob**. Just as a father’s love for his children is not found from below, so too kindness is never found wanting. He takes hold of them and guards them so that they may be blessed. Each one must be mentioned individually, and eventually, they are all gathered as one and crowned with **Kindness** (*Chesed*). 

**The great, mighty, and awesome God**—here they are all as one, to ascend above. At first, the flow was from above to below, but now it is from below to above, to include them all in Kindness. Because it says "The great, mighty, and awesome God," they are all included in Him. 

And then: **Supreme God, who bestows good kindnesses** <note>original: *El Elyon gomel chasadim tovim*. This continues the first blessing of the Amidah.</note>. All those from below are like this; they ascend together to be blessed there. Eventually, He surrounds them and embraces them. When they are blessed from the "Body" <note>likely referring to the central pillar of the Sefirot, *Tiferet*</note>, they are found as the **Shield of Abraham** <note>original: *Magen Avraham*—the conclusion of the first blessing.</note>. Here, everyone is blessed as is fitting. 

Come and see: the "seventh" is the **Spirit of the Upper King**. All are crowned by it here, as we have said, and included in it. Until now, they have been perfected, and it is necessary to show them this Palace. When he brings them forth with blessings—these "children" in the evening—then she [the *Shekhinah*] takes hold of them with all those blessings. Even though the palaces are included within palaces, now they are joined together in a vision of blessings. 

When one says **King, Helper, Savior, and Shield**, he then brings them forth from the blessings. This Seventh Palace stands in the Spirit of the Upper Holy Name, using the cipher **KUZU BOKSAS** <note>original: *כוז"ו ברכס"ו*—a gematria/letter substitution (Temurah) for the names *YHVH Eloheinu YHVH*. These names are often found on the back of a Mezuzah scroll.</note>. **Kindness** (*Chesed*), **Power** (*Gevurah*), and **Justice** (*Mishpat*) are all as one. And that Spirit is the **Spirit of the Living God**. These letters **A-H-Y-W** <note>original: *אהי"ו*—a divine name associated with the flow of life</note> encompass them, and from them emerge all the kindnesses. This is what is blessed through the Priest, and it is called "Blessing." 

Once he says: **Blessed are You, Lord, Shield of Abraham**, she [the *Shekhinah*] has taken hold of the blessings from the treasury in the spirit of the palace. Contentment and protection are found to bind them in the love of the blessings of the Right Hand <note>The "Right Hand" always symbolizes the attribute of *Chesed* (Kindness/Grace).</note>. Thus, it is necessary to go from above to below—to first bless palace within palace as we said. 

And now, when the blessings are found, a window opens from before these. Even though she was there at the beginning, once the blessings are established from the side of the Right Hand, the Palace is strengthened to turn toward the "Left Side" <note>The "Left Side" represents *Gevurah* (Might/Judgment).</note>. In this spirit comes **Might** (*Gevurah*). This is the "union of one" and the "recognition of two" merits. Since the blessings are found to be included in **Mercy** (*Rachamim*), and the "silver" side is found entirely as one: **He who resuscitates the dead, supports the fallen, and heals the sick** <note>original: *Mechaye metim, somekh noflim, ve-rofe cholim*—the second blessing of the Amidah.</note>. 

This is through the spirit of the Holy Name called *Abradus* <note>a mystical name of an angel or spiritual force</note>. This spirit is within the letters of the Name called **Elohim**. These letters ascend to be crowned above as **The Living God and Eternal King** <note>original: *Elohim Chayim u-Melekh Olam*</note>, and are received below.

## Main Text (Zohar)

-> Pekudei <-

To spread below; and because of these three times <note>Refers to the thrice-repeated "Holy, Holy, Holy" in the Kedushah prayer.</note> that they say [Holy], the portions ascend below on the side of the Levites <note>original: *בסטרא דלוי*. Thus, "Blessed" is established, and "Holy" is established, and "Holy" is prepared. This is why one says: **"You are Holy"**.

And the word **"You"** <note>original: *Attah*. In Kabbalistic thought, "You" is a direct address that reveals the hidden "He" (the Infinite) into a present relationship.</note> is perfected in holiness; it appears and drips—this is the Explicit Name <note>The Tetragrammaton, Y-H-W-H.</note>. **"You"** is established in every place where Unity <note>original: *Yichuda*. Likely referring to the unification of the divine attributes or the Name itself.</note> is found. In the path of truth, there is holiness and an "addition of holiness"; the "addition of holiness" is the main essence, more than everything else. Because of this, in all of them it is written **"You"**, and even more so here in this place of holiness and the addition of holiness: **"You are Holy"**. This is holiness and the support of holiness, an addition of holiness and holiness every day. These are the secret of the upper holinesses that are within the Name [Y-H-W-H]. All of them are sanctified from this "addition," for the first holiness has an addition of holiness to sanctify all those circles we mentioned and to crown everything from above. From all of them, they merit to be bound in one bond, and they are: **"Blessed are You, Lord, the Holy God."**

Therefore, He is called "Awesome," and the bond of them all is in one unity. It is the portion of whoever knows how to arrange the praises of his Master in this way—to be blessed until this point of cleavage <note>original: *deveikut*—mystical attachment or communion with God.</note>, where blessings and holiness are as one. All of them are anointing oils <note>Representing the flow of divine abundance (*Shefa*).</note>. They do not remain below but ascend as a request. This is the beginning of what a person must bring into his occupation: to know the matters of his Master in order to establish his desire toward Him and not be separated from Him. A person must strengthen himself in the holiness of His holy Name to be crowned by it. This is the beginning of the blessings and sanctifications, following the pattern of the Holy Book <note>The Torah.</note>. The letter *Yod* [י] is holy in its holiness, and these other letters <note>The letters of the Divine Name or the Hebrew alphabet used in prayer.</note> proceed from it. These other letters are joined—the male to the female <note>A common Zoharic metaphor for the balancing of active and receptive spiritual forces.</note>. So too are the upper sanctifications, the secret of holiness. These other letters are called "Dew," the "Dew of Heaven" <note>The word for Dew, *Tal* (טל), has the numerical value of 39, which connects to the Name of God.</note>, the spirit that gathers the letters. For here below, they all stand by count; yet it is not a mere count, but a sign. Because of this, one must be bound to the holiness of his Master and not be separated from Him.

When the beginning of the letters goes to show his desire toward Him, all fear shall spread... <unclear>v-ir v-ir</unclear>... and he shall inherit from the letters that which is necessary to do. All the letters shall be for a crown to arrange the order we spoke of. In this way, all his goodness shall be in supplications and requests before his Master, and he should not test himself. This is the portion of whoever knows how to arrange this order to walk in the straight way as is fitting. In this way... <term>Chesed</term> <note>the attribute of Loving-kindness</note> is in the forehead, and they are as one; the spirit of the wings and the pinions <note>angelic metaphors</note> are in the South, East, West. And the West is like "Mora"—thus everything is tied together as one. This unity of the letters is for those who know how to arrange their prayers as is proper, to be tied to them and to draw near to be included within them below. He shall be meritorious in his portion in this world and in the World to Come—the Crown that concludes the letters.

The Body <note>The central column of the Sefirot, often associated with the torso/Tiferet.</note> is like all the crowns in the holiness of everything. It is that which goes and sustains the letters and the order, so that blessings and sustenance are found below in the Palace. It hangs down to the bottom... like the matters of the "Stations" <note>original: *Ma'amadot*—referring to the divisions of Israelites who stood watch during Temple sacrifices.</note>. These are the supports of the body, starting below the torso: the two thighs <note>The Sefirot of Netzach (Victory) and Hod (Splendor).</note> until they reach his knees. These are the spirit of the "Stations" that stand upon the knee. And here, let there be the spirit of the two thighs, starting until the knees from above... and the Kingdom <note>Malchut</note> is the herald of the letters that are called together as one holy community. This is the "Spirit of the Swim" which is called "The Bride." This is the ascent... and this is the "Upper Spirit of the Creatures" that we mentioned. And when he reaches the knees and bows: **"Blessed are You, Lord"**. The source of the star is established, and he stands here to restore the creatures, to return and be blessed as one in the established Palace.

## Main Text (Zohar)

-> Pekudei <-

This arrangement below is for the purpose of depositing souls within it, to ascend and be joined in the vision of a dream. **Modim** <note>original: *מודים*. This is the "Thanksgiving" blessing of the Amidah prayer, where the worshiper bows.</note> is meant for bending the knees, to give thanks for the souls, as we say: "for our souls which are deposited with You." Refers to the twenty-two letters of the Hebrew alphabet, which are the building blocks of creation.</note>. Similarly, this is called "God, the Lord" <note>original: *אל אלהים*. *El Elohim*.</note> who is blessed above all these levels. He knows; this is the matter we learned regarding the bowing below. Inside and below, this is the secret of the soul after the souls have ascended into them. We need to find these blessings in this way because [holiness] is not commonly found in this world or the world to come [without them]. The lower Palace is the sum of everything below. Here there is "Peace, peace" above, peace below, peace on all sides, peace in the upper half, and peace in the lower half. And this is the lower half, which is the lower Palace. This is like a connection, in the middle, and He engraved a "Cinnor" <note>original: *כנור*. This matter is "Peace" in all those Palaces and in all those supernal lights, so that everything becomes one within Him—peace, goodness, and blessing. 

When one is pulled from this Palace to go outside, he should incline himself like a cantor who departs from the King’s company. These are the Palaces, and he should rejoice before all; he should rejoice because before him is the law to take the "crown" of the goodness of blessings that flow from the radiance of the morning. This is when he is [departing] from the King's Palace, for at that time he is bowing before the King. Everything is bound in all these sides of holiness, unity, blessings, and sanctity. An "addition of holiness" <note>original: *תוספת קדושה*. An extra measure of divine light drawn down during specific parts of the prayer.</note> is called out to the upper half, and it is said to them: "Write this man down!" They open the window called the "Watchers of my Name" <note>original: *חוסני שמי*. Literally "the strength of my Name," interpreted as angelic guardians who attend to the prayer.</note>. Who are the Watchers of His Name? They are those who wait and focus on the mystery of prayer in the Palaces, to tie the knots and unify everyone in a single unity. These Watchers of His Name are all [active] even in dark times. Then it is written of him: **"Sanctify yourselves and you shall be holy"** <note>Leviticus 11:44</note>, and they labor for him above and below.

But one who is not [focused] and does not bind the Holy One, Blessed be He—the camps of angels distance themselves from him and despise his prayer. He does not care for the glory of his Master; it would have been better for him had he not been created. And the Holy One, Blessed be He, says: 
> **"Write this man childless"** <note>Jeremiah 22:30</note>
He did not merit his days, and this [merit] is hidden from the life of the one who will see. Here, everything is closed above and below. The spirit of the Holy Name rules above, desiring and shattering: "The Lord, the Lord, a God merciful and gracious." Here is the Holy Spirit to be sanctified in those below, like a crown; they are given to those who bow in the holiness of unity as mentioned. After he finishes, he steps back on his feet <note>Refers to the three steps taken backward at the end of the Amidah.</note> away from his debts, so that no "accuser of the mouth" <note>original: *פטר דפומא*. The realm of impurity or demonic forces.</note> is subdued, and his existence is blessed from the King's house. He merits his portion—those who are sanctified in this world of exile, as we said. He ties the knots, unifies the unifications, and focuses on everything, turning neither right nor left. His prayer shall not return empty. The Holy One, Blessed be He, decrees, and the Righteous one annuls [if needed]. Regarding this it is written: **"Your father and mother shall be glad, and she who bore you shall rejoice"** <note>Proverbs 23:25</note>. He has a portion in this world and the world to come. In the evening, he is protected, as it is written:
> **"She rises while it is yet night, and gives food to her household and a portion to her maidens"** <note>Proverbs 31:15</note>
From that secret of blessings, holiness, and the addition of holiness that she takes for all. In the evening, she divides the spoil and covers the portion of all—even a portion for the Other Side, a portion for the "back" <note>original: *חולקא דאחורא*. Referring to the "sparks" or "husks" that are given a small amount of energy to prevent them from attacking the holy realm.</note>. This spirit is a "pleasing aroma" of faith. The portion of the impure Other Side consists of all those sins and all those errors of the man who tied the knots of unity; [the sins] that were added to them all rest upon the Other Side. They are the portion and inheritance of the impure Other Side.
